```h
// ng2 - Ninja Gaiden II static recompilation
//
// Aspect Ratio (aspect.cpp).

#pragma once

#include <cstdint>

namespace ng2::aspect {

// The game's 16:9 float, which the camera's projection is built with.
constexpr uint32_t kConstantAddress = 0x8228EBFC;

// The chosen aspect: 0 16:9, 1 16:10, 2 21:9, 3 32:9, 4 4:3 (out of range: 0).
uint32_t AspectIndex();

// The aspect the picture is shown at (16:9 unless set otherwise).
float Aspect();

// The gameplay HUD was drawn in the last 2D pass.
bool HudShown();

// How much 2D is squeezed along x and y (1: not), about the centre of the
// game's 1280x720 space, for the presenter to stretch back.
float SqueezeX();
float SqueezeY();

// The constant's page was made writable (else the 3D stays 16:9).
void SetConstantWritable(bool writable);

// The window's size, from the presenter (21:9 follows its exact shape).
void SetWindowShape(uint32_t width, uint32_t height);

}  // namespace ng2::aspect
```

`src/cheats.cpp`:

```cpp
// ng2 - Ninja Gaiden II static recompilation
//
// The Cheats page of RECOMP SETTINGS (recomp_settings.cpp).
//
// Infinite Health: damage to a character goes through sub_82412508 (r3 a
// record whose first word is the character), and the damage that lowers its
// most health (the red end of the bar) through sub_82412EA8 and
// sub_824131E0. Each gives none when the byte at 0x83CB5992 is 1 (anyone),
// or 2 and the character is the player (two of the character's own flags,
// and in sub_82412508 the record's +10 being 0). It is set to 2 for those
// calls only, so enemies still take theirs.
//
// Infinite Ninpo: a character's ninpo is a u16 at +0x5942 (200 a charge),
// its most at +0x5940. A cast spends as usual, and the player's ninpo is
// filled back to its most each frame in play (CheatsFrame, from the frame's
// start). (A cost of 0 instead left the HUD
// showing a charge spent: its gauge plays a cast's drain itself and only
// shows the charges again when it sees the ninpo go up.)
//
// Unlock Difficulties: sub_823E1098(clears, d) says difficulty d is open
// (some difficulty at or above d - 1 cleared). The New Game path list
// (sub_8366F4D0) asks it for Mentor and Master Ninja; the answer is yes for
// those two calls. Mission Mode doesn't ask: choosing a mission
// (sub_823E4758) sets how many difficulties it offers (1, 2, 3 or 4) from
// the mission's record in the profile (cleared flags 0x10..0x80 in byte 7
// of [0x84C559E0] + 1016 + 8 * mission), except for missions whose table
// entry (0x83B2E334 + 12 * mission) is 3, which offer one. A hook right
// after the count is set raises it to 4.
//
// Unlock Costumes: the costume list (sub_823E1448) adds a costume per
// difficulty the same check says is cleared; it is yes there too.
//
// Neither writes the unlocks to the profile (a game played on a difficulty
// or in a costume they open is saved as usual): switched off, the menus
// are as before.

#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstring>

#include <rex/cvar.h>
#include <rex/hook.h>
#include <rex/logging.h>

#include "aspect.h"
#include "gpu/guest.h"

REXCVAR_DEFINE_BOOL(cheat_infinite_health, false, "Cheats", "The player takes no damage");
REXCVAR_DEFINE_BOOL(cheat_infinite_ninpo, false, "Cheats", "Casting ninpo doesn't spend it");
REXCVAR_DEFINE_BOOL(cheat_unlock_difficulties, false, "Cheats",
                    "Every difficulty in New Game and Mission Mode");
REXCVAR_DEFINE_BOOL(cheat_unlock_costumes, false, "Cheats", "Every costume");

namespace {

constexpr uint32_t kNoDamage = 0x83CB5992;
constexpr uint8_t kPlayerOnly = 2;

// A damage function with the player's no-damage flag set.
void WithoutPlayerDamage(PPCContext& ctx, uint8_t* base, void (*damage)(PPCContext&, uint8_t*)) {
  uint8_t* flag = ng2::guest::Virtual(kNoDamage);
  uint8_t game = *flag;
  bool ours = REXCVAR_GET(cheat_infinite_health) && game == 0;
  if (ours) {
    *flag = kPlayerOnly;
  }
  damage(ctx, base);
  if (ours && *flag == kPlayerOnly) {
    *flag = game;
  }
}

}  // namespace

REX_EXTERN(__imp__sub_82412508);
REX_HOOK_RAW(sub_82412508) {
  WithoutPlayerDamage(ctx, base, __imp__sub_82412508);
}
REX_EXTERN(__imp__sub_82412EA8);
REX_HOOK_RAW(sub_82412EA8) {
  WithoutPlayerDamage(ctx, base, __imp__sub_82412EA8);
}
REX_EXTERN(__imp__sub_824131E0);
REX_HOOK_RAW(sub_824131E0) {
  WithoutPlayerDamage(ctx, base, __imp__sub_824131E0);
}

// The player's record is the first of the characters' 24-byte records; the
// game reads its character straight from 0x84C3DC60. The game's own test that
// a record's character is the player (sub_82412508): the record's +10 is 0,
// the character's +0x59D3 isn't 0xFF and its +0x59BF is 0.
constexpr uint32_t kPlayerRecord = 0x84C3DC60;
constexpr uint32_t kNinpo = 0x5942, kNinpoMost = 0x5940;

void FillPlayerNinpo();
bool HudInPlay();  // extras.cpp

// The New Game path list is made with the title menu (sub_8366F4D0, at
// 0x853A3470, after the menu's entries: Acolyte and Warrior, then Mentor
// and Master Ninja if open, their count at +8208). It is always made with
// all four, and the count follows the setting (CheatsFrame): the paths the
// profile has opened, or all of them, at once either way.
constexpr uint32_t kPathCount = 0x853A3470 + 8208;
constexpr uint32_t kProfile = 0x84C559E0;
bool g_allPathsAsked = false;  // while the list is made
uint32_t g_allPaths = 0, g_openPaths = 0;

// The unlock check, by caller (its return address).
REX_EXTERN(__imp__sub_823E1098);
REX_HOOK_RAW(sub_823E1098) {
  uint32_t from = uint32_t(ctx.lr);
  bool paths = from == 0x8366F874 || from == 0x8366F8A8;
  bool costumes = from == 0x823E1714 || from == 0x823E174C || from == 0x823E1784 ||
                  from == 0x823E17BC;
  if ((paths && g_allPathsAsked) ||
      (costumes && REXCVAR_GET(cheat_unlock_costumes))) {
    ctx.r3.u64 = 1;
    return;
  }
  __imp__sub_823E1098(ctx, base);
}

// Around the title menu's builder (recomp_settings.cpp's hook): all four
// paths asked for, then the ones open without the cheat counted.
void CheatsTitleMenu(PPCContext& ctx, uint8_t* base, void (*build)(PPCContext&, uint8_t*)) {
  g_allPathsAsked = true;
  build(ctx, base);
  g_allPathsAsked = false;
  g_allPaths = ng2::guest::Load32(kPathCount);
  // The paths open without the cheat (Master Ninja only after Mentor, as
  // the list has them).
  uint32_t profile = ng2::guest::Load32(kProfile);
  uint32_t open = 2;
  if (profile && g_allPaths == 4) {
    PPCRegister r3 = ctx.r3, r4 = ctx.r4;
    for (uint32_t difficulty : {2u, 3u}) {
      ctx.r3.u64 = profile + 720, ctx.r4.u64 = difficulty;
      __imp__sub_823E1098(ctx, base);
      if (ctx.r3.u32 == 0) {
        break;
      }
      open++;
    }
    ctx.r3 = r3, ctx.r4 = r4;
  }
  g_openPaths = std::min(open, g_allPaths);
}

// Mission Mode: r11 the difficulties offered, r31 the mission screen
// (+4: the mission). ng2_codegen.toml places it at 0x823E4A80.
void Ng2MissionDifficulties(PPCRegister& r11, PPCRegister& r31) {
  constexpr uint32_t kMissionTable = 0x83B2E334;  // 12 bytes a mission
  constexpr uint32_t kFixedDifficulty = 3;
  constexpr uint32_t kAll = 4;
  if (!REXCVAR_GET(cheat_unlock_difficulties)) {
    return;
  }
  uint32_t mission = ng2::guest::Load32(r31.u32 + 4);
  if (mission < 100 && ng2::guest::Load32(kMissionTable + 12 * mission) != kFixedDifficulty &&
      r11.u32 < kAll) {
    // The screen keeps the count at +48 (the choice, its cursor's wrap);
    // r11 places the cursor once.
    r11.u64 = kAll;
    uint8_t* count = ng2::guest::Virtual(r31.u32 + 48);
    count[0] = 0, count[1] = 0, count[2] = 0, count[3] = uint8_t(kAll);
  }
}

// Each frame (perf_overlay.cpp's frame start): Infinite Ninpo keeps the
// gauge full.
void CheatsFrame() {
  // Unlock Difficulties: the New Game paths shown (on the title menu: in
  // play the list is gone, and it is made again with the next title menu).
  // Stopped once play starts (the HUD drawn, or its functions run with the HUD
  // hidden).
  if (ng2::aspect::HudShown() || HudInPlay()) {
    g_allPaths = 0;
  }
  if (g_allPaths >= 2 && g_allPaths <= 4) {
    uint32_t count = REXCVAR_GET(cheat_unlock_difficulties) ? g_allPaths : g_openPaths;
    if (ng2::guest::Load32(kPathCount) != count) {
      uint32_t value = rex::byte_swap(count);
      std::memcpy(ng2::guest::Virtual(kPathCount), &value, 4);
    }
  }
  // In play only: before it the record holds something else.
  if (REXCVAR_GET(cheat_infinite_ninpo) && (ng2::aspect::HudShown() || HudInPlay())) {
    FillPlayerNinpo();
  }
}

// The player's ninpo to its most (a cast's spend, a frame in play).
void FillPlayerNinpo() {
  uint32_t player = ng2::guest::Load32(kPlayerRecord);
  if (player < 0x40000000u || player >= 0xA0000000u ||
      ng2::guest::Virtual(kPlayerRecord)[10] != 0 ||
      ng2::guest::Virtual(player)[0x59D3] == 0xFF || ng2::guest::Virtual(player)[0x59BF] != 0) {
    return;
  }
  uint16_t most = ng2::guest::Load16(player + kNinpoMost);
  if (most && most <= 0x2000 && ng2::guest::Load16(player + kNinpo) < most) {
    uint16_t value = rex::byte_swap(most);
    std::memcpy(ng2::guest::Virtual(player + kNinpo), &value, 2);
  }
}
```

```cpp
// ng2 - Ninja Gaiden II static recompilation
//
// Keyboard and mouse. The SDK's keyboard-and-mouse driver plays as a pad (its
// keybind_* settings: a list of keys per button; a key may be in two lists,
// pressing both buttons, as the game's two-button actions need). This game's
// keys, for the settings the player hasn't set (the game's own actions, from
// its Controller Settings, in brackets):
//
//   W A S D    left stick (move)          mouse       right stick (camera)
//   left mouse, J   X (quick attack)      right mouse, K   Y (strong attack)
//   Space      A (jump)                   E           B (projectile weapon)
//   F          Y + B (ninpo)              C           A + X (water run)
//   Shift      LT (block)                 Q, middle mouse   RT
//   R          LB                         V           RB
//   Z / X      stick clicks               Tab         BACK
//   Escape     START                      arrows      d-pad
//   Return, Backspace: A and B too (menus)
//
// Whichever of the keyboard and a pad was used last is the one in use (the
// SDK's input system); the button prompts follow it (gpu/prompts.cpp), the
// mouse moves the camera only then, and the pointer is hidden while a pad
// is in use. (Shift can be bound: SDK patch 0017.)

#include "controls.h"

#include <atomic>
#include <utility>

#include <rex/cvar.h>
#include <rex/input/input_system.h>
#include <rex/input/mnk/mnk_input_driver.h>
#include <rex/logging.h>
#include <rex/runtime.h>
#include <rex/ui/window.h>
#include <rex/ui/windowed_app_context.h>

namespace ng2::controls {

namespace {

rex::ui::WindowedAppContext* g_appContext = nullptr;

}  // namespace

void SetAppContext(rex::ui::WindowedAppContext* context) {
  g_appContext = context;
}

Device ActiveDevice() {
  auto* runtime = rex::Runtime::instance();
  auto* input = runtime ? static_cast<rex::input::InputSystem*>(runtime->input_system()) : nullptr;
  if (!input) {
    return Device::kUnknown;
  }
  switch (input->ActiveKind(0)) {
    case rex::input::DeviceKind::kXbox: return Device::kXbox;
    case rex::input::DeviceKind::kPlayStation: return Device::kPlayStation;
    case rex::input::DeviceKind::kNintendo: return Device::kNintendo;
    case rex::input::DeviceKind::kKeyboard: return Device::kKeyboard;
    default: return Device::kUnknown;
  }
}

void ApplyDefaults() {
  static constexpr std::pair<const char*, const char*> kDefaults[] = {
      {"mnk_mode", "true"},
      {"mnk_mouse", "true"},
      {"keybind_a", "Space,C,Return"},
      {"keybind_b", "E,F,Backspace"},
      {"keybind_x", "LMB,J,C"},
      {"keybind_y", "RMB,K,F"},
      {"keybind_left_trigger", "Shift"},
      {"keybind_right_trigger", "Q,MMB"},
      {"keybind_left_shoulder", "R"},
      {"keybind_right_shoulder", "V"},
      {"keybind_lstick_up", "W"},
      {"keybind_lstick_down", "S"},
      {"keybind_lstick_left", "A"},
      {"keybind_lstick_right", "D"},
      {"keybind_lstick_press", "Z"},
      {"keybind_rstick_up", "Numpad8"},
      {"keybind_rstick_down", "Numpad5"},
      {"keybind_rstick_left", "Numpad4"},
      {"keybind_rstick_right", "Numpad6"},
      {"keybind_rstick_press", "X"},
      {"keybind_dpad_up", "Up"},
      {"keybind_dpad_down", "Down"},
      {"keybind_dpad_left", "Left"},
      {"keybind_dpad_right", "Right"},
      {"keybind_back", "Tab"},
      {"keybind_start", "Escape"},
  };
  for (auto [name, value] : kDefaults) {
    const auto* info = rex::cvar::GetFlagInfo(name);
    if (info && info->source == rex::cvar::Source::kDefault) {
      rex::cvar::SetFlagByName(name, value);
    }
  }
}

void Frame() {
  // The mouse moves the camera (and is captured) only while the keyboard and
  // mouse are in use: a pad player's pointer is left alone, and a key or a
  // click hands the camera back to the mouse. The pointer is hidden while a
  // pad is in use. The driver hides it while it captures and, on releasing,
  // puts back what it found, so the pointer is checked again on the UI
  // thread on a change and twice a second: hidden while a pad is in use,
  // auto-hidden while the keyboard is and the driver isn't capturing.
  static std::atomic<bool> queued{false}, keyboardInUse{false}, overlayOpen{false};
  static Device last = Device::kUnknown;
  static bool lastOverlay = false;
  static uint32_t frames = 0, soon = 0;
  // Nothing used yet (at start, or a pad of no known kind): no mouse look,
  // as with a pad. An overlay of the SDK's open (F3, F4): the pointer free
  // and shown for it.
  Device device = ActiveDevice();
  auto* runtime = rex::Runtime::instance();
  auto* input = runtime ? static_cast<rex::input::InputSystem*>(runtime->input_system()) : nullptr;
  bool overlay = input && input->IsOverlayOpen();
  bool keyboard = device == Device::kKeyboard && !overlay;
  rex::input::mnk::SetMouseLookActive(keyboard);
  keyboardInUse.store(keyboard);
  overlayOpen.store(overlay);
  if (device != last || overlay != lastOverlay) {
    soon = 10;  // the next frames too, after the driver's own release
  }
  last = device;
  lastOverlay = overlay;
  bool now = soon > 0 || ++frames % 30 == 0;
  if (soon > 0) {
    soon--;
  }
  if (!now || !g_appContext || queued.exchange(true)) {
    return;
  }
  g_appContext->CallInUIThreadDeferred([] {
    queued.store(false);
    bool keyboard = keyboardInUse.load();
    auto* runtime = rex::Runtime::instance();
    auto* window = runtime ? runtime->display_window() : nullptr;
    if (!window) {
      return;
    }
    using Visibility = rex::ui::Window::CursorVisibility;
    if (overlayOpen.load()) {
      if (window->GetCursorVisibility() != Visibility::kVisible) {
        window->SetCursorVisibility(Visibility::kVisible);
      }
    } else if (!keyboard) {
      if (window->GetCursorVisibility() != Visibility::kHidden) {
        window->SetCursorVisibility(Visibility::kHidden);
      }
    } else if (!window->IsMouseCaptureRequested() &&
               window->GetCursorVisibility() == Visibility::kHidden) {
      window->SetCursorVisibility(Visibility::kAutoHidden);
    }
  });
}

}  // namespace ng2::controls
```

`src/cpu_handover.cpp`:

```cpp
// ng2 - Ninja Gaiden II static recompilation
//
// The packages carry the game twice: built for any x86-64 PC since about
// 2009 (x86-64-v2: SSE4.2), and for AVX2 machines (x86-64-v3: AVX2, FMA, BMI;
// the Steam Deck, any Ryzen, Intel since Haswell). The first is started; on a
// CPU with all of x86-64-v3 it hands over at once, before anything else runs,
// to the second next to it (ng2-avx2, ng2-avx2.exe), with the same
// arguments and environment. NG2_NO_AVX2=1 keeps the first.

#include <cstdlib>

#if !defined(__AVX2__) && (defined(__x86_64__) || defined(_M_X64))

#include <cstdint>
#include <cwchar>
#include <filesystem>
#include <string>

#if defined(_WIN32)
#include <intrin.h>
#include <windows.h>
#else
#include <cpuid.h>
#include <unistd.h>

#include <fstream>
#include <iterator>
#include <vector>
#endif

namespace {

void Cpuid(uint32_t leaf, uint32_t sub, uint32_t r[4]) {
#if defined(_WIN32)
  int out[4];
  __cpuidex(out, int(leaf), int(sub));
  for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
    r[i] = uint32_t(out[i]);
  }
#else
  __cpuid_count(leaf, sub, r[0], r[1], r[2], r[3]);
#endif
}

// All of x86-64-v3, and the OS saving the AVX registers.
bool HasX86_64V3() {
  uint32_t r[4];
  Cpuid(0, 0, r);
  uint32_t maxLeaf = r[0];
  if (maxLeaf < 7) {
    return false;
  }
  Cpuid(1, 0, r);
  uint32_t ecx1 = r[2];
  bool fma = ecx1 & (1u << 12), movbe = ecx1 & (1u << 22), osxsave = ecx1 & (1u << 27),
       avx = ecx1 & (1u << 28), f16c = ecx1 & (1u << 29);
  Cpuid(7, 0, r);
  uint32_t ebx7 = r[1];
  bool bmi1 = ebx7 & (1u << 3), avx2 = ebx7 & (1u << 5), bmi2 = ebx7 & (1u << 8);
  Cpuid(0x80000000u, 0, r);
  bool lzcnt = false;
  if (r[0] >= 0x80000001u) {
    Cpuid(0x80000001u, 0, r);
    lzcnt = r[2] & (1u << 5);
  }
  if (!(fma && movbe && osxsave && avx && f16c && bmi1 && avx2 && bmi2 && lzcnt)) {
    return false;
  }
  uint32_t lo, hi;
  __asm__ volatile("xgetbv" : "=a"(lo), "=d"(hi) : "c"(0));  // XCR0
  (void)hi;
  return (lo & 6) == 6;  // XMM and YMM state
}

struct Handover {
  Handover() {
    const char* off = std::getenv("NG2_NO_AVX2");
    if ((off && *off && *off != '0') || !HasX86_64V3()) {
      return;
    }
#if defined(_WIN32)
    wchar_t self[MAX_PATH] = {};
    if (!GetModuleFileNameW(nullptr, self, MAX_PATH)) {
      return;
    }
    std::filesystem::path other = std::filesystem::path(self).parent_path() / L"ng2-avx2.exe";
    std::error_code ec;
    if (std::filesystem::path(self).filename() == other.filename() ||
        !std::filesystem::exists(other, ec)) {
      return;
    }
    SetEnvironmentVariableW(L"NG2_NO_AVX2", L"1");  // (the other never hands over again)
    // The command line as given, its first word (the program) replaced.
    std::wstring line = GetCommandLineW();
    size_t rest = 0;
    if (!line.empty() && line[0] == L'"') {
      rest = line.find(L'"', 1);
      rest = rest == std::wstring::npos ? line.size() : rest + 1;
    } else if (size_t n = std::wcslen(self);
               line.size() >= n && _wcsnicmp(line.c_str(), self, n) == 0 &&
               (line.size() == n || line[n] == L' ' || line[n] == L'\t')) {
      rest = n;  // the program's own path, unquoted, spaces and all
    } else {
      rest = line.find(L' ');
      rest = rest == std::wstring::npos ? line.size() : rest;
    }
    std::wstring command = L"\"" + other.wstring() + L"\"" + line.substr(rest);
    STARTUPINFOW startup = {};
    startup.cb = sizeof(startup);
    PROCESS_INFORMATION process = {};
    // In a job closed with this process: ended (Task Manager, a launcher), so is the other.
    HANDLE job = CreateJobObjectW(nullptr, nullptr);
    if (job) {
      JOBOBJECT_EXTENDED_LIMIT_INFORMATION limits = {};
      limits.BasicLimitInformation.LimitFlags = JOB_OBJECT_LIMIT_KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE;
      SetInformationJobObject(job, JobObjectExtendedLimitInformation, &limits, sizeof(limits));
    }
    if (!CreateProcessW(other.c_str(), command.data(), nullptr, nullptr, TRUE, CREATE_SUSPENDED,
                        nullptr, nullptr, &startup, &process)) {
      SetEnvironmentVariableW(L"NG2_NO_AVX2", nullptr);
      return;
    }
    if (job) {
      AssignProcessToJobObject(job, process.hProcess);
    }
    ResumeThread(process.hThread);
    CloseHandle(process.hThread);
    WaitForSingleObject(process.hProcess, INFINITE);
    DWORD code = 0;
    GetExitCodeProcess(process.hProcess, &code);
    ExitProcess(code);
#else
    std::error_code ec;
    std::filesystem::path self = std::filesystem::read_symlink("/proc/self/exe", ec);
    if (ec) {
      return;
    }
    std::filesystem::path other = self.parent_path() / "ng2-avx2";
    if (self.filename() == other.filename() || access(other.c_str(), X_OK) != 0) {
      return;
    }
    setenv("NG2_NO_AVX2", "1", 1);  // (the other never hands over again)
    std::ifstream in("/proc/self/cmdline", std::ios::binary);
    std::string all((std::istreambuf_iterator<char>(in)), std::istreambuf_iterator<char>());
    std::vector<char*> argv;
    std::string program = other.string();
    argv.push_back(program.data());
    bool first = true;
    for (size_t at = 0; at < all.size();) {
      size_t end = all.find('\0', at);
      if (end == std::string::npos) {
        end = all.size();
      }
      if (!first) {
        argv.push_back(all.data() + at);
      }
      first = false;
      at = end + 1;
    }
    argv.push_back(nullptr);
    execv(program.c_str(), argv.data());
    unsetenv("NG2_NO_AVX2");  // (execv failed: the first build carries on)
#endif
  }
};

Handover g_handover;

}  // namespace

#endif

```

`src/debug_waits.cpp`:

```cpp
// ng2 - Ninja Gaiden II static recompilation
//
// NG2_DEBUG_WAITS=1: a debugging aid for stalls. Reports guest waits
// (WaitForSingleObjectEx wrapper 8383E698) still blocked after 5 s or that
// took over 2 s, with the handle's last SetEvent caller, failed semaphore
// releases, and the state of the game's job system (control block
// 83C07CF0: submit 822F2688, worker run 822F2870), which is how the
// opening's stall (a lost semaphore wake-up in ReXGlue) was found.

#include <chrono>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <mutex>
#include <thread>
#include <unordered_map>

#include <rex/hook.h>
#include <rex/logging.h>

#include "gpu/guest.h"

namespace {

bool Enabled() {
  static const bool enabled = [] {
    const char* v = std::getenv("NG2_DEBUG_WAITS");
    return v && v[0] == '1';
  }();
  return enabled;
}

struct LastSet {
  uint32_t caller = 0;
  uint64_t count = 0;
  std::chrono::steady_clock::time_point when;
};
std::mutex g_mutex;
std::unordered_map<uint32_t, LastSet> g_sets;

struct Waiting {
  uint32_t handle, caller;
  std::chrono::steady_clock::time_point start;
  bool reported = false;
};
std::unordered_map<uint64_t, Waiting> g_waiting;  // by wait id
uint64_t g_submits = 0, g_runs = 0;
std::string g_runLog[8];
uint64_t g_runLogNext = 0;
uint32_t g_lastRunner = 0;
std::chrono::steady_clock::time_point g_lastSubmit, g_lastRun;
uint64_t g_nextWait = 0;

// Every 5 s: waits still blocked after 5 s, once each.
void Watchdog() {
  for (;;) {
    std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::seconds(5));
    std::lock_guard lock(g_mutex);
    auto now = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
    for (auto& [id, wait] : g_waiting) {
      if (wait.reported || now - wait.start < std::chrono::seconds(5)) {
        continue;
      }
      wait.reported = true;
      auto& set = g_sets[wait.handle];
      REXLOG_WARN("wait: blocked on handle {:#x} from {:#x}; last set from {:#x} ({} sets)",
                  wait.handle, wait.caller, set.caller, set.count);
      std::string jobs;
      for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
        jobs += fmt::format(" {:08x}", ng2::guest::Load32(0x83C07CF0 + i * 4));
      }
      REXLOG_WARN("wait: job control 83C07CF0:{}", jobs);
      auto ms = [&](std::chrono::steady_clock::time_point t) {
        return std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(now - t).count();
      };
      REXLOG_WARN("wait: submits {} (last {} ms ago), runs {} (last {} ms ago, worker r3 {:#x})",
                  g_submits, ms(g_lastSubmit), g_runs, ms(g_lastRun), g_lastRunner);
      for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
        REXLOG_WARN("wait: run {}", g_runLog[(g_runLogNext + i) % 8]);
      }
    }
  }
}

}  // namespace

// SetEvent(handle)
REX_EXTERN(__imp__sub_83833380);
REX_HOOK_RAW(sub_83833380) {
  if (Enabled()) {
    std::lock_guard lock(g_mutex);
    auto& set = g_sets[ctx.r3.u32];
    set.caller = uint32_t(ctx.lr);
    set.count++;
    set.when = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
  }
  __imp__sub_83833380(ctx, base);
}

// WaitForSingleObjectEx(handle, timeout, alertable)
REX_EXTERN(__imp__sub_8383E698);
REX_HOOK_RAW(sub_8383E698) {
  if (!Enabled()) {
    __imp__sub_8383E698(ctx, base);
    return;
  }
  uint32_t handle = ctx.r3.u32, timeout = ctx.r4.u32, caller = uint32_t(ctx.lr);
  auto start = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
  uint64_t id;
  {
    std::lock_guard lock(g_mutex);
    static std::once_flag once;
    std::call_once(once, [] { std::thread(Watchdog).detach(); });
    id = g_nextWait++;
    g_waiting[id] = {handle, caller, start};
  }
  __imp__sub_8383E698(ctx, base);
  {
    std::lock_guard lock(g_mutex);
    g_waiting.erase(id);
  }
  auto waited = std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - start;
  if (waited > std::chrono::seconds(2)) {
    std::lock_guard lock(g_mutex);
    auto& set = g_sets[handle];
    REXLOG_WARN("wait: handle {:#x} timeout {:#x} from {:#x} took {} ms; last set from {:#x} "
                "({} sets, {} ms before the wait ended)",
                handle, timeout, caller,
                std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(waited).count(), set.caller,
                set.count,
                std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(
                    std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - set.when)
                    .count());
  }
}

// ReleaseSemaphore(handle, count, &previous): log failures.
REX_EXTERN(__imp__sub_83833948);
REX_HOOK_RAW(sub_83833948) {
  uint32_t handle = ctx.r3.u32, count = ctx.r4.u32, lr = uint32_t(ctx.lr);
  __imp__sub_83833948(ctx, base);
  if (Enabled() && ctx.r3.u32 == 0) {
    static int reports = 0;
    if (reports++ < 10) {
      REXLOG_WARN("wait: ReleaseSemaphore({:#x}, {}) from {:#x} failed", handle, count, lr);
    }
  }
}

// The job system: submit (822F2688) and a worker's run (822F2870).
REX_EXTERN(__imp__sub_822F2688);
REX_HOOK_RAW(sub_822F2688) {
  __imp__sub_822F2688(ctx, base);
  if (Enabled()) {
    std::lock_guard lock(g_mutex);
    g_submits++;
    g_lastSubmit = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
  }
}
REX_EXTERN(__imp__sub_822F2870);
REX_HOOK_RAW(sub_822F2870) {
  using ng2::guest::Load32;
  if (!Enabled()) {
    __imp__sub_822F2870(ctx, base);
    return;
  }
  uint32_t worker = ctx.r3.u32;
  uint32_t before[6] = {Load32(worker), Load32(worker + 4), Load32(0x83C07CF0 + 8),
                        Load32(0x83C07CF0 + 12), Load32(0x83C07CF0 + 36), Load32(0x83C07CF0 + 24)};
  {
    std::lock_guard lock(g_mutex);
    g_runs++;
    g_lastRun = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
    g_lastRunner = worker;
  }
  __imp__sub_822F2870(ctx, base);
  {
    std::lock_guard lock(g_mutex);
    g_runLog[g_runLogNext++ % 8] = fmt::format(
        "worker {:#x} id {} slot {} pop {} count {} mask {:#x} done {} -> pop {} done {}", worker,
        before[0], before[1], before[2], before[3], before[4], before[5],
        Load32(0x83C07CF0 + 8), Load32(0x83C07CF0 + 24));
  }
}
```

`src/dlc.cpp`:

```cpp
// ng2 - Ninja Gaiden II static recompilation

#include "dlc.h"

#include <cstring>
#include <fstream>
#include <string>
#include <system_error>

#include <rex/filesystem.h>
#include <rex/logging.h>
#include <rex/system/kernel_state.h>
#include <rex/system/xam/content_device.h>
#include <rex/system/xam/content_manager.h>

namespace ng2::dlc {
namespace fs = std::filesystem;
using rex::X_RESULT;

namespace {

constexpr uint32_t kTitleId = 0x544307D5;
constexpr uint32_t kMarketplaceContent = 2;

uint32_t BigEndian32(const unsigned char* p) {
  return uint32_t(p[0]) << 24 | uint32_t(p[1]) << 16 | uint32_t(p[2]) << 8 | p[3];
}

// Where InstallContent puts a package (and whether it is still there).
bool Installed(rex::system::xam::ContentManager* content, const fs::path& package) {
  rex::system::xam::XCONTENT_AGGREGATE_DATA data;
  data.device_id = static_cast<uint32_t>(rex::system::xam::DummyDeviceId::HDD);
  data.content_type = rex::system::XContentType::kMarketplaceContent;
  data.title_id = kTitleId;
  data.xuid = 0;
  data.set_file_name(rex::path_to_utf8(package.filename()));
  return content->ContentExists(0, data);
}

std::string Stamp(const fs::directory_entry& entry) {
  std::error_code ec;
  auto size = entry.file_size(ec);
  auto time = entry.last_write_time(ec).time_since_epoch().count();
  return std::to_string(size) + " " + std::to_string(time);
}

std::string ReadMarker(const fs::path& path) {
  std::ifstream file(path);
  std::string line;
  std::getline(file, line);
  return line;
}

}  // namespace

// A game, title update or save copied in with the packages is not DLC.
bool IsGameDlc(const fs::path& path) {
  std::ifstream file(path, std::ios::binary);
  unsigned char header[0x364] = {};
  if (!file.read(reinterpret_cast<char*>(header), sizeof(header))) {
    return false;
  }
  bool stfs = !std::memcmp(header, "LIVE", 4) || !std::memcmp(header, "PIRS", 4) ||
              !std::memcmp(header, "CON ", 4);
  return stfs && BigEndian32(header + 0x344) == kMarketplaceContent &&
         BigEndian32(header + 0x360) == kTitleId;
}

void InstallPackages(rex::system::KernelState* kernel_state, const fs::path& game_root,
                     const fs::path& user_root) {
  const fs::path dir = game_root / "dlc";
  std::error_code ec;
  if (!kernel_state || !fs::is_directory(dir, ec)) {
    return;
  }
  const fs::path markers = user_root / "dlc_installed";
  fs::create_directories(markers, ec);

  // Package folders as the console keeps them (544307D5/00000002/<id>) work
  // too, so the files are found at any depth.
  auto* content = kernel_state->content_manager();
  for (auto it = fs::recursive_directory_iterator(
           dir, fs::directory_options::follow_directory_symlink, ec);
       !ec && it != fs::recursive_directory_iterator(); it.increment(ec)) {
    const auto& entry = *it;
    if (!entry.is_regular_file(ec) || !IsGameDlc(entry.path())) {
      continue;
    }
    const fs::path marker = markers / entry.path().filename();
    const std::string stamp = Stamp(entry);
    if (ReadMarker(marker) == stamp && Installed(content, entry.path())) {
      continue;
    }
    auto result = content->InstallContent(entry.path());
    if (result != X_ERROR_SUCCESS) {
      REXLOG_ERROR("DLC: cannot install {} ({:08X})", rex::path_to_utf8(entry.path()), result);
      fs::remove(marker, ec);  // tried again next time, over the partial copy
      continue;
    }
    std::ofstream out(marker);
    if (!(out << stamp << '\n')) {
      REXLOG_WARN("DLC: cannot write {}; it will be installed again", rex::path_to_utf8(marker));
    }
    REXLOG_INFO("DLC: installed {}", rex::path_to_utf8(entry.path().filename()));
  }
}

}  // namespace ng2::dlc

```

```h
// Downloadable content: the packages in the game folder's dlc/ installed

#pragma once

#include <filesystem>

namespace rex::system {

// This game's downloadable content: an STFS package (LIVE, PIRS or CON) of
// content type 2 for title 544307D5.
bool IsGameDlc(const std::filesystem::path& path);

// Installs every content package (STFS LIVE/PIRS/CON file) under
// <game_root>/dlc that isn't installed yet. A marker per package in
// <user_root>/dlc_installed records the size and time of the installed copy,
// so a replaced package is installed again.

                     const std::filesystem::path& game_root,
```

`src/extras.cpp`:

```cpp
// ng2 - Ninja Gaiden II static recompilation
//
// Extras (RECOMP SETTINGS' Extras page) and three more cheats: this port's
// own versions of options of alicenotmech's Ninja Gaiden II Master Edition,
// whose patch showed where in the game (Title Update 3) each one acts.
//
// Skip Death Screen: the death sequence (sub_82442E18) waits 12 frames
// where it waits 120 and 1 where it waits 30, the GAME OVER caption
// (sub_836A3508 from sub_83695B20) isn't started, and once the game over
// menu (0x85366170, state +0x524) is up Start is pressed for the player.
//
// Auto Chapter Screen: the chapter card (0x8532D850, state +0x480: 1-3 its
// intro, 4 waiting, 5 pressed, then 6 and 7) skips the wait for its intro and
// is pressed on, as the mission briefing (state 3 of 0x85022DA8 +0x54) is.
// Both press Start in the pad state (sub_822F2E38, just before the four
// pads are merged).
//
// HUD: Hidden skips the HUD's draw functions; Fade Out draws the health and
// ninpo gauges, the ammo counter and the enemy gauge with the HUD's alpha
// (0x853264AC) scaled by one that rises while fighting (hurt, a button held,
// a lock-on, an enemy within 15 units, or the HUD back after a pause) and
// falls three seconds after.
//
// Post-Effects off: the post passes' mask (0x84C55758, read by sub_83648E50)
// loses the blur bits (0x400, 0x10000; 0x1000 unless 0x4000 is also set),
// and the white flash (sub_836FB7A8 from sub_8269CF98) isn't started.
//
// Smooth HUD and Menus: the 2D sprites near 1:1 scale take the game's
// filtered sprite path (sub_83803400) too, as the others do.
//
// Hi-Res Font: the font's glyphs are rasterised at twice their size and
// their metrics halved (read at start: glyphs already made keep their size).
//
// Cheats: All Weapons and Ninpo puts every weapon and ninpo (Level 1 or 3)
// and full ammo in the save's inventory (save +0x30: 128 slots of id, count,
// flags) at a new game and at each stage's start; All Crystal Skulls counts
// all 30 as found; Max HP and Ninpo reads the life and ninpo upgrades as
// full when a stage's character is made from the save.

#include <algorithm>
#include <atomic>
#include <chrono>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstring>

#include <rex/cvar.h>
#include <rex/hook.h>
#include <rex/ppc/context.h>

#include "gpu/guest.h"

REXCVAR_DEFINE_BOOL(skip_death_screen, false, "Extras",
                    "Straight to the game over menu after dying, without the death screen");
REXCVAR_DEFINE_BOOL(auto_chapter_screen, false, "Extras",
                    "Chapter cards and mission briefings go on by themselves");
REXCVAR_DEFINE_INT32(hud_mode, 0, "Extras", "0: shown, 1: fades out when not fighting, 2: hidden");
REXCVAR_DEFINE_BOOL(post_effects, true, "Extras", "The blur and white flashes (off: none)");
REXCVAR_DEFINE_BOOL(smooth_hud, false, "Extras", "The HUD's and menus' pictures always filtered");
REXCVAR_DEFINE_BOOL(hires_font, false, "Extras",
                    "Text drawn from glyphs twice the size (from the next start)");
REXCVAR_DEFINE_INT32(cheat_all_weapons, 0, "Cheats",
                     "0: off, 1: every weapon and ninpo at Level 1, 2: at Level 3");
REXCVAR_DEFINE_BOOL(cheat_all_skulls, false, "Cheats", "All 30 crystal skulls count as found");
REXCVAR_DEFINE_BOOL(cheat_max_health_ninpo, false, "Cheats",
                    "Life and ninpo upgrades full from the start");

namespace {

using ng2::guest::Load16;
using ng2::guest::Load32;
using ng2::guest::LoadFloat;

void Store8(uint32_t address, uint8_t value) {
  *ng2::guest::Virtual(address) = value;
}
void Store16(uint32_t address, uint16_t value) {
  value = rex::byte_swap(value);
  std::memcpy(ng2::guest::Virtual(address), &value, 2);
}
void Store32(uint32_t address, uint32_t value) {
  value = rex::byte_swap(value);
  std::memcpy(ng2::guest::Virtual(address), &value, 4);
}
void StoreFloat(uint32_t address, float value) {
  uint32_t bits;
  std::memcpy(&bits, &value, 4);
  Store32(address, bits);
}
void ScaleFloats(uint32_t address, uint32_t count, float scale) {
  for (uint32_t i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    StoreFloat(address + 4 * i, LoadFloat(address + 4 * i) * scale);
  }
}

constexpr uint32_t kStart = 0x10;  // the pad's Start bit

// Skip Death Screen and Auto Chapter Screen.
constexpr uint32_t kGameOverState = 0x85366694;  // 2: its menu is up
constexpr uint32_t kChapterCardState = 0x8532DCD0;
constexpr uint32_t kChapterCardIntro = 0x84C3F060;  // 1 while its intro must play
constexpr uint32_t kBriefingState = 0x85022DFC;     // 3: waiting

// HUD.
constexpr uint32_t kHudAlpha = 0x853264AC;
constexpr uint32_t kDevice = 0x859EEBC0;      // + 0x40A0: the HUD's frame count
constexpr uint32_t kPlayerHealth = 0x85660E0E;
constexpr uint32_t kHeldButtons = 0x83C08100;  // all pads'
constexpr uint32_t kLockOn = 0x83B3CB80, kBossGauge = 0x8532E2AC;
constexpr uint32_t kCharacters = 0x8565B4F0, kCharacterSize = 0x5B10;
constexpr uint32_t kCharacterHealth = 0x591E, kCharacterX = 0x270, kCharacterZ = 0x278;
constexpr float kNear = 15.0f;
constexpr int kHoldFrames = 180;

// Post-Effects off.
constexpr uint32_t kPostPasses = 0x84C55758;

// Cheats.
constexpr uint32_t kSave = 0x83BD2488;         // the save's state, while playing
constexpr uint32_t kEquipped = 0x85660E3E;     // the player's item in hand
constexpr uint32_t kInventory = 0x30, kSlots = 128;

// Every weapon and ninpo, and the ammo, as the inventory holds them: id,
// count, flags (the weapons' level, less one; 0x10: ammo, only added; 0x40:
// taken away at a stage's start unless in hand).
struct Item {
  uint16_t id;
  uint8_t count, flags;
};
constexpr Item kLevel1[] = {
    {0x0C, 1, 0}, {0x11, 1, 0}, {0x12, 1, 0}, {0x13, 1, 0},  {0x14, 1, 0},    {0x15, 1, 0},
    {0x18, 1, 0}, {0x01, 0, 0x40}, {0x06, 1, 0}, {0x52, 1, 0}, {0x92, 1, 0},  {0x53, 1, 0},
    {0x00, 1, 0}, {0x23, 30, 0x10}, {0x22, 1, 0}, {0x93, 1, 0}, {0x25, 30, 0x10},
    {0x94, 100, 0x10}, {0xA0, 1, 0}, {0x05, 1, 0},
};
constexpr Item kLevel3[] = {
    {0x07, 1, 2}, {0x0C, 1, 2}, {0x11, 1, 2}, {0x12, 1, 2}, {0xCC, 1, 2},    {0x14, 1, 2},
    {0x15, 1, 2}, {0x18, 1, 2}, {0x01, 1, 0x40}, {0x06, 1, 2}, {0x52, 1, 2},  {0x92, 1, 2},
    {0x53, 1, 2}, {0x00, 1, 0}, {0x23, 30, 0x10}, {0x22, 1, 0}, {0x93, 1, 0}, {0x25, 30, 0x10},
    {0x94, 100, 0x10}, {0xA0, 1, 0}, {0x05, 1, 0},
};

// The item's own slot (even used up: but for item 0, whose id an empty slot
// also has), and the first empty one (count 0, as the game's).
void FindSlots(uint32_t slots, uint16_t id, uint32_t* found, uint32_t* free) {
  *found = *free = 0;
  for (uint32_t s = 0; s < kSlots; s++) {
    uint32_t slot = slots + 4 * s;
    uint8_t count = *ng2::guest::Virtual(slot + 2);
    if (Load16(slot) == id && (count > 0 || id != 0) && !*found) {
      *found = slot;
    } else if (count == 0 && !*free) {
      *free = slot;
    }
  }
}

// Fills the live save's inventory; stageStart: at a stage's start (else a
// new game's save or a save loaded). What it gives stays, as items found:
// switched off, it gives no more.
void GiveAllWeapons(bool stageStart) {
  int32_t level = REXCVAR_GET(cheat_all_weapons);
  uint32_t save = Load32(kSave);
  if (level <= 0 || (save >> 16) != 0x859E) {
    return;
  }
  const Item* items = level == 1 ? kLevel1 : kLevel3;
  size_t count = level == 1 ? std::size(kLevel1) : std::size(kLevel3);
  uint32_t slots = save + kInventory;
  for (size_t i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const Item& item = items[i];
    if (item.count == 0) {
      continue;
    }
    uint32_t found, free;
    FindSlots(slots, item.id, &found, &free);
    if (item.flags & 0x40) {
      // (Level 3: the plain Dragon Sword goes, for the True one, unless in
      // hand)
      if (stageStart && found && Load16(kEquipped) != item.id) {
        Store16(found, 0), Store8(found + 2, 0), Store8(found + 3, 0);  // (empty, as the game's)
      }
      continue;
    }
    bool ammo = item.flags & 0x10;
    uint8_t flags = item.flags & 0xF;
    if (found) {
      uint8_t* bytes = ng2::guest::Virtual(found);
      bytes[2] = std::max(bytes[2], item.count);
      if (!ammo) {
        bytes[3] = std::max(bytes[3], flags);
      }
    } else if (free) {
      Store16(free, item.id), Store8(free + 2, item.count), Store8(free + 3, flags);
    }
  }
}

// The HUD's fade: its alpha, and the frames left before it falls.
float g_hudFade = 1.0f;
int g_hudHold = kHoldFrames;
uint32_t g_hudLastFrame = 0;
uint16_t g_hudLastHealth = 0;

bool Fighting() {
  uint32_t device = Load32(kDevice);
  uint32_t frame = device ? Load32(device + 0x40A0) : 0;
  uint32_t last = g_hudLastFrame;
  g_hudLastFrame = frame;
  if (frame - last > 30) {
    return true;  // the HUD back after a while (a pause, a cutscene)
  }
  uint16_t health = Load16(kPlayerHealth);
  uint16_t lastHealth = g_hudLastHealth;
  g_hudLastHealth = health;
  if (health < lastHealth || (Load32(kHeldButtons) & 0x3EF) || Load32(kLockOn) ||
      Load32(kBossGauge)) {
    return true;
  }
  float x = LoadFloat(kCharacters + kCharacterX), z = LoadFloat(kCharacters + kCharacterZ);
  for (uint32_t k = 1; k < 16; k++) {
    uint32_t enemy = kCharacters + k * kCharacterSize;
    if (Load16(enemy + kCharacterHealth) == 0 || Load32(enemy + kCharacterX) == 0) {
      continue;
    }
    float dx = LoadFloat(enemy + kCharacterX) - x, dz = LoadFloat(enemy + kCharacterZ) - z;
    if (dx * dx + dz * dz < kNear * kNear) {
      return true;
    }
  }
  return false;
}

void UpdateHudFade() {
  if (Fighting()) {
    g_hudHold = kHoldFrames;
    g_hudFade = std::min(g_hudFade + 1.0f / 15.0f, 1.0f);
  } else if (--g_hudHold < 0) {
    g_hudHold = 0;
    g_hudFade = std::max(g_hudFade - 1.0f / 60.0f, 0.0f);
  }
}

// A HUD part: drawn, hidden, or drawn with the fade's alpha.
std::atomic<int64_t> g_hudCalledMs{0};

void HudPart(PPCContext& ctx, uint8_t* base, void (*draw)(PPCContext&, uint8_t*), bool fades,
             bool update = false) {
  g_hudCalledMs.store(std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(
                          std::chrono::steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch())
                          .count(),
                      std::memory_order_relaxed);
  int32_t mode = REXCVAR_GET(hud_mode);
  if (mode == 2) {
    return;
  }
  if (mode != 1 || !fades) {
    draw(ctx, base);
    return;
  }
  if (update) {
    UpdateHudFade();
  }
  float alpha = LoadFloat(kHudAlpha);
  StoreFloat(kHudAlpha, alpha * g_hudFade);
  draw(ctx, base);
  StoreFloat(kHudAlpha, alpha);
}

bool HiResFont() {
  static const bool on = REXCVAR_GET(hires_font);
  return on;
}

}  // namespace

// The game asked for its HUD in the last frames (drawn or not: the HUD option
// hidden), so it is in play.
bool HudInPlay() {
  int64_t now = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(
                    std::chrono::steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch())
                    .count();
  return now - g_hudCalledMs.load(std::memory_order_relaxed) < 100;
}

// The pad state, before the four pads are merged: r5 the first pad's words.
void Ng2ExtrasPad(PPCRegister& r5) {
  bool press = false;
  if (REXCVAR_GET(skip_death_screen) && Load32(kGameOverState) == 2) {
    press = true;
  }
  if (REXCVAR_GET(auto_chapter_screen)) {
    uint32_t card = Load32(kChapterCardState);
    if (card == 3) {
      if (Load32(kChapterCardIntro) != 1) {
        Store32(kChapterCardState, 4);
      }
    } else if (card == 5 || Load32(kBriefingState) == 3) {
      press = true;
    }
  }
  // Into every pad's words (0x44 apart): the game over menu reads the
  // player's own pad, not the merged one.
  if (press) {
    for (uint32_t pad = 0; pad < 4; pad++) {
      for (uint32_t w = 0; w < 5; w++) {
        uint32_t word = r5.u32 + 0x44 * pad + 4 * w;
        Store32(word, Load32(word) | kStart);
      }
    }
  }
}

// Skip Death Screen: the death sequence's waits (just loaded).
void Ng2DeathWait(PPCRegister& r29) {
  if (REXCVAR_GET(skip_death_screen)) {
    r29.u64 = 12;
  }
}
void Ng2DeathFade(PPCRegister& r10) {
  if (REXCVAR_GET(skip_death_screen)) {
    r10.u64 = 1;
  }
}
// True: the GAME OVER caption isn't started.
bool Ng2DeathCaption() {
  return REXCVAR_GET(skip_death_screen);
}

// HUD.
#define NG2_HUD_PART(name, fades, update)          \
  REX_EXTERN(__imp__##name);                       \
  REX_HOOK_RAW(name) {                             \
    HudPart(ctx, base, __imp__##name, fades, update); \
  }

// Max HP and Ninpo leaves the save alone: the game copies the character
// back into the save (sub_83755D20(save): health at +0xC04 current and
// +0xC06 most, then eight segments of current and most from +0xC08 (only the
// first used: a Life of the Gods raises its most, which a full bar refuses,
// so the item is kept); ninpo +0xC28 current, +0xC2A most). With the cheat
// on, the save's own most values are put back after it, and the currents
// kept within them (a save point's refill stays full).
// The save is kept as long as the character was made with the cheat on, even
// if it was turned off since (else its full bars would go into the save).
constexpr uint32_t kSaveHealth = 0xC04, kSaveSegment = 0xC08, kSaveNinpo = 0xC28;
std::atomic<bool> g_maxMade{false};
REX_EXTERN(__imp__sub_83755D20);
REX_HOOK_RAW(sub_83755D20) {
  uint32_t save = ctx.r3.u32;
  if (!g_maxMade.load() || (save >> 16) != 0x859E) {  // (the character's own maxima otherwise)
    __imp__sub_83755D20(ctx, base);
    return;
  }
  constexpr uint32_t kFrom = kSaveHealth, kTo = 0xC2C;  // health and ninpo
  uint8_t before[kTo - kFrom];
  std::memcpy(before, ng2::guest::Virtual(save + kFrom), sizeof(before));
  __imp__sub_83755D20(ctx, base);
  uint16_t health = Load16(save + kSaveHealth), segment = Load16(save + kSaveSegment);
  uint16_t ninpo = Load16(save + kSaveNinpo);
  std::memcpy(ng2::guest::Virtual(save + kFrom), before, sizeof(before));
  Store16(save + kSaveHealth, std::min(health, Load16(save + kSaveHealth + 2)));
  Store16(save + kSaveSegment, std::min(segment, Load16(save + kSaveSegment + 2)));
  Store16(save + kSaveNinpo, std::min(ninpo, Load16(save + kSaveNinpo + 2)));
}

// Max HP and Ninpo: the upgrades as a stage's character is made from the
// save (just loaded).
void Ng2MaxHealth(PPCRegister& r10) {
  g_maxMade.store(REXCVAR_GET(cheat_max_health_ninpo));
  if (REXCVAR_GET(cheat_max_health_ninpo)) {
    r10.u64 = 3600;
  }
}
// The health bar's other segments (1-7, current and most; 0xFFFF: unused):
// unused, so the first one's 3600 is the whole bar.
void Ng2MaxHealthSegment(PPCRegister& r10) {
  if (REXCVAR_GET(cheat_max_health_ninpo)) {
    r10.u64 = 0xFFFF;
  }
}
// (the ninpo the character starts with, and its most)
void Ng2MaxNinpo(PPCRegister& r10) {
  if (REXCVAR_GET(cheat_max_health_ninpo)) {
    r10.u64 = 2000;
  }
}
```

`src/frame_wait.cpp`:

```cpp
// ng2 - Ninja Gaiden II static recompilation
//
// Two of the game's busy-waits, which on the 360 had hardware threads to
// themselves and here hold whole cores: on a 4-core handheld they take CPU
// time from the threads they wait for.
//
// The main loop (sub_822F34C0) hands each frame to the render thread, then
// spins until the render thread has taken it (lwz r11 of 0x84C53430 until
// it reads 0): nearly all of the main thread's time on a fast PC.
//
// The render thread's frame limiter (sub_822F0BF8) spins until the vblank
// count (0x84C55B50, from the vblank interrupt) is the word at 0x84C5342C
// past where it started, with the PowerPC low-priority hint in the loop.
//
// When the game asks for fewer frames than vblanks (the word at 0x84C5342C:
// 2 on the game over screen), the limiter reads the count (sub_822F02D8)
// once to start, then until it has moved on by that many. On the console the
// frame's work before it fits in a vblank, so it starts in the vblank the
// last wait ended in and every frame takes exactly 2. Here Present can wait
// on the host display's vsync, which isn't in step with the guest's vblanks,
// and push the start a vblank or two late: that frame took 3 or 4 (27 fps,
// not 30, uneven). A start up to the interval past the last wait's end
// counts from that end, so a frame takes the interval unless its own work
// took longer than that (where the console would also run late).
//
// Both back off: a few pause instructions, then yields, then short sleeps (yields on
// Windows, whose sleeps are whole milliseconds).

#include <chrono>
#include <cstdint>
#include <thread>

#if defined(__x86_64__) || defined(_M_X64)
#include <immintrin.h>
#endif

#include <rex/hook.h>

#include "gpu/guest.h"
#include "gpu/video.h"

namespace {

// One step of a spin; a new wait (a gap since the last step) starts over.
void Backoff() {
  using clock = std::chrono::steady_clock;
  thread_local uint32_t spins = 0;
  thread_local clock::time_point last;
  auto now = clock::now();
  if (now - last > std::chrono::microseconds(500)) {
    spins = 0;
  }
  spins++;
  if (spins < 64) {
#if defined(__x86_64__) || defined(_M_X64)
    _mm_pause();
#endif
  } else if (spins < 256) {
    std::this_thread::yield();
  } else {
#if defined(_WIN32)
    // MSVC's sleep_for rounds up to whole milliseconds (Sleep(1), 1-2 ms): too coarse here.
    std::this_thread::yield();
#else
    std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::microseconds(50));
#endif
  }
  last = clock::now();
}

}  // namespace

// Before the compare: r11 is the handoff word, 0 once the frame is taken.
void Ng2FrameHandoffWait(PPCRegister& r11) {
  if (r11.u32 != 0) {
    Backoff();
  } else {
    ng2::video::NoteFrameTaken();  // (NG2_LATENCY_LOG)
  }
}

void Ng2VblankWait() {
  Backoff();
}

// The limiter's reads of the vblank count: its start (returning to 822F0C40)
// and each check in its loop (to 822F0C4C).
REX_EXTERN(__imp__sub_822F02D8);
REX_HOOK_RAW(sub_822F02D8) {
  constexpr uint32_t kStart = 0x822F0C40, kCheck = 0x822F0C4C, kInterval = 0x84C5342C;
  static uint32_t lastEnd = 0;
  static bool waited = false;
  uint32_t lr = uint32_t(ctx.lr);
  __imp__sub_822F02D8(ctx, base);
  if (lr == kStart) {
    // Up to the interval since the last wait ended: blocked, not slow.
    uint32_t interval = ng2::guest::Load32(kInterval);
    if (waited && ctx.r3.u32 - lastEnd <= interval) {
      ctx.r3.u32 = lastEnd;
    }
  } else if (lr == kCheck) {
    lastEnd = ctx.r3.u32;  // the last check is the one the wait ended on
    waited = true;
  }
}
```

`src/gameplay.cpp`:

```cpp
// ng2 - Ninja Gaiden II static recompilation
//
// The Gameplay page of RECOMP SETTINGS (recomp_settings.cpp).
//
// Skip Cutscenes: the game lets a cutscene be skipped (Start or A, mask 0x110
// in the pad's newly pressed buttons) only once it has been seen. Both of
// its checks read the event's id (u16 0x84C3F0B4) and a seen byte: movies
// in the event-script command sub_8365E760 (0x84C3EC4F + id; skipping sets
// the 30-frame fade-out), real-time cutscenes in the event-script loop
// sub_83655B98 ([0x84C559E0] + 104 + id, below 384). Both run as script
// code that yields each frame, so the bytes are set from the input update
// (sub_822F2E38, once a frame, before the scripts) on a frame a skip button
// is pressed while a cutscene runs (a movie on the host player, or a script
// with a skip argument: u16 0x84A69AD4), and put back the next frame: the
// profile isn't changed. A script that can't be skipped at all (its skip
// argument 0) still can't.
//
// Skip Intro: the boot movie (NinjaVI.wmv, the first movie played) isn't
// opened by the host movie player (src/movie), so it ends at once.

#include "gameplay.h"

#include <cstdint>
#include <iterator>

#include <rex/cvar.h>
#include <rex/hook.h>

#include "gpu/guest.h"
#include "gpu/video.h"
#include "movie/movie.h"

REXCVAR_DEFINE_BOOL(skip_intro, false, "Gameplay", "Skip the opening movie at launch");
REXCVAR_DEFINE_BOOL(skip_cutscenes, false, "Gameplay",
                    "Any cutscene can be skipped, seen or not");

namespace {

using ng2::guest::Load32;
using ng2::guest::Virtual;

constexpr uint32_t kEventId = 0x84C3F0B4;        // u16
constexpr uint32_t kMovieSeen = 0x84C3EC4F;      // + id
constexpr uint32_t kMovieSeenCount = kEventId - kMovieSeen;  // room before the id
constexpr uint32_t kScriptSkip = 0x84A69AD4;     // u16: the running script's skip argument
constexpr uint32_t kProfile = 0x84C559E0;        // -> profile
constexpr uint32_t kCutsceneSeen = 104;          // profile + id
constexpr uint32_t kCutsceneCount = 384;
constexpr uint32_t kPadIndex = 0x84C3DA3E;       // u8: the player's pad
constexpr uint32_t kPadPressed = 0x83C07FF8;     // + pad * 0x44: newly pressed
constexpr uint32_t kSkipButtons = 0x110;

uint16_t EventId() {
  const uint8_t* p = Virtual(kEventId);
  return uint16_t(p[0] << 8 | p[1]);
}

bool SkipPressed() {
  uint32_t pad = *Virtual(kPadIndex);
  return pad < 4 && (Load32(kPadPressed + pad * 0x44) & kSkipButtons) != 0;
}

// Seen bytes set for a skip press, put back the next frame.
struct Forced {
  uint32_t address;
  uint8_t was;
};
Forced g_forced[2];
uint32_t g_forcedCount = 0;

void Force(uint32_t address) {
  uint8_t* byte = Virtual(address);
  if (*byte == 0 && g_forcedCount < std::size(g_forced)) {
    g_forced[g_forcedCount++] = {address, *byte};
    *byte = 1;
  }
}

void PutBack() {
  for (uint32_t i = 0; i < g_forcedCount; i++) {
    uint8_t* byte = Virtual(g_forced[i].address);
    if (*byte == 1) {
      *byte = g_forced[i].was;
    }
  }
  g_forcedCount = 0;
}

uint16_t Load16(uint32_t address) {
  const uint8_t* p = Virtual(address);
  return uint16_t(p[0] << 8 | p[1]);
}

}  // namespace

namespace ng2::gameplay {

bool SkipIntro() {
  return REXCVAR_GET(skip_intro);
}

}  // namespace ng2::gameplay

// The input update, once a frame: the pads read, the scripts still to run.
REX_EXTERN(__imp__sub_822F2E38);
REX_HOOK_RAW(sub_822F2E38) {
  PutBack();
  __imp__sub_822F2E38(ctx, base);
  ng2::video::NoteInputRead();
  if (!REXCVAR_GET(skip_cutscenes) || !SkipPressed()) {
    return;
  }
  // Only while a cutscene runs: a movie on the host player, or a script
  // whose cutscene can be skipped at all.
  uint16_t id = EventId();
  if (ng2::movie::AnyPlaying() && id < kMovieSeenCount) {
    Force(kMovieSeen + id);
  }
  uint32_t profile = Load32(kProfile);
  if (Load16(kScriptSkip) != 0 && profile && id < kCutsceneCount) {
    Force(profile + kCutsceneSeen + id);
  }
}
```

`src/gpu/d3d_hooks.cpp`:

```cpp
// ng2 - Ninja Gaiden II static recompilation
//
// Hooks on the game's D3D library (XDK 2.0.6683; addresses and signatures in
// docs/d3d-map-*.md). With the native renderer the original still runs, so
// the D3D library's bookkeeping stays intact; the renderer reads the device
// state at these points, and native_gpu.cpp does the GPU side the game can see
// (fences, callbacks, the flip). Otherwise they only call the original.

#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>
#include <atomic>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <chrono>
#include <thread>

#include <mutex>
#include <string>
#include <unordered_set>
#include <rex/hook.h>
#include <rex/runtime.h>
#include <rex/system/xmemory.h>
#include <rex/logging.h>

#include "guest.h"
#include "native_gpu.h"
#include "video.h"

namespace {

struct Counters {
  std::atomic<uint32_t> draws{0};
  std::atomic<uint32_t> clears{0};
  std::atomic<uint32_t> resolves{0};
  std::atomic<uint32_t> swaps{0};
};
Counters g_counters;
std::chrono::steady_clock::time_point g_lastReport = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();

// NG2_D3D_STATS=1: log D3D call counts once a second.
bool StatsEnabled() {
  static const bool enabled = [] {
    const char* v = std::getenv("NG2_D3D_STATS");
    return v && v[0] == '1';
  }();
  return enabled;
}

void ReportStats() {
  auto now = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
  if (now - g_lastReport < std::chrono::seconds(1)) {
    return;
  }
  g_lastReport = now;
  REXLOG_INFO("d3d: {} swaps, {} draws, {} clears, {} resolves in the last second",
              g_counters.swaps.exchange(0), g_counters.draws.exchange(0),
              g_counters.clears.exchange(0), g_counters.resolves.exchange(0));
}


// NG2_DRAW_STACKS=1: each distinct chain of guest callers that leads to a
// draw, logged once (return addresses: the caller's, then up the stack's
// back chain, where each function saves its LR 8 bytes below its caller's
// frame). Finds what draws a picture the 2D pass doesn't.
void LogDrawStack(PPCContext& ctx, const char* kind) {
  static const bool on = std::getenv("NG2_DRAW_STACKS") != nullptr;
  if (!on) {
    return;
  }
  static std::mutex mutex;
  static std::unordered_set<std::string> seen;
  std::string key = fmt::format("{:08X}", uint32_t(ctx.lr));
  auto* memory = rex::Runtime::instance()->memory();
  auto readable = [&](uint32_t address) {
    uint32_t protect = 0;
    auto* heap = memory->LookupHeap(address);
    return heap && heap->QueryProtect(address, &protect) &&
           (protect & rex::memory::kMemoryProtectRead);
  };
  uint32_t sp = ctx.r1.u32;
  for (int depth = 0; depth < 10 && sp && readable(sp); depth++) {
    uint32_t next = ng2::guest::Load32(sp);
    if (!next || next <= sp || next - sp > 0x100000 || !readable(next - 8)) {
      break;
    }
    key += fmt::format(" {:08X}", ng2::guest::Load32(next - 8));
    sp = next;
  }
  std::lock_guard lock(mutex);
  if (seen.insert(key).second) {
    REXLOG_INFO("draw stack {}: {}", kind, key);
  }
}

}  // namespace

// DrawVertices(dev, prim type, start vertex, vertex count)
REX_EXTERN(__imp__sub_83761EA8);
REX_HOOK_RAW(sub_83761EA8) {
  g_counters.draws++;
  LogDrawStack(ctx, "vertices");
  uint32_t device = ctx.r3.u32, primitive = ctx.r4.u32, start = ctx.r5.u32, count = ctx.r6.u32;
  __imp__sub_83761EA8(ctx, base);
  if (ng2::video::IsNativeRenderer()) {
    ng2::video::OnDraw(device, primitive, start, count, false, 0);
  }
}

  __imp__sub_83762290(ctx, base);

  }
}

// Clear(dev, count, rects, flags, color, f1 z, stencil)
REX_EXTERN(__imp__sub_8375E2E0);
REX_HOOK_RAW(sub_8375E2E0) {
  g_counters.clears++;
  // The float takes r8's slot, so stencil comes in r9.
  uint32_t device = ctx.r3.u32, count = ctx.r4.u32, rects = ctx.r5.u32, flags = ctx.r6.u32;
  uint32_t color = ctx.r7.u32, stencil = ctx.r9.u32;
  float z = float(ctx.f1.f64);
  // The game builds the rects below its stack pointer, where the call itself
  // writes: copy them first.
  int32_t rectData[ng2::video::kMaxClearRects][4];
  if (!rects) {
    count = 0;
  } else if (count > ng2::video::kMaxClearRects) {
    // More than we keep: their bounding box (more cleared, nothing left stale).
    int32_t box[4] = {INT32_MAX, INT32_MAX, INT32_MIN, INT32_MIN};
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      box[0] = std::min(box[0], ng2::guest::LoadS32(rects + i * 16));
      box[1] = std::min(box[1], ng2::guest::LoadS32(rects + i * 16 + 4));
      box[2] = std::max(box[2], ng2::guest::LoadS32(rects + i * 16 + 8));
      box[3] = std::max(box[3], ng2::guest::LoadS32(rects + i * 16 + 12));
    }
    std::copy(box, box + 4, rectData[0]);
    count = 1;
  } else {
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      for (uint32_t j = 0; j < 4; j++) {
        rectData[i][j] = ng2::guest::LoadS32(rects + i * 16 + j * 4);
      }
    }
  }
  __imp__sub_8375E2E0(ctx, base);
  if (ng2::video::IsNativeRenderer()) {
    ng2::video::OnClear(device, count, rectData, flags, color, z, stencil);
  }
}

// Resolve(dev, flags, src rect, dest texture, dest point, level, slice,
// clear color, f1 clear z, [stack] stencil, params)
REX_EXTERN(__imp__sub_83762CF8);
REX_HOOK_RAW(sub_83762CF8) {
  g_counters.resolves++;
  uint32_t device = ctx.r3.u32, flags = ctx.r4.u32, rect = ctx.r5.u32, texture = ctx.r6.u32;
  uint32_t point = ctx.r7.u32, clearColor = ctx.r10.u32;
  float clearZ = float(ctx.f1.f64);
  // 10th argument on the caller's stack (the float takes the 9th slot).
  uint32_t clearStencil = ng2::guest::Load32(ctx.r1.u32 + 92);
  __imp__sub_83762CF8(ctx, base);
  if (ng2::video::IsNativeRenderer()) {
    ng2::video::OnResolve(device, flags, rect, texture, point, clearColor, clearZ, clearStencil);
  }
}

// InsertFence(dev, command buffer) -> command buffer
REX_EXTERN(__imp__sub_8375F810);
REX_HOOK_RAW(sub_8375F810) {
  if (ng2::video::IsNativeRenderer()) {
    ng2::gpu::OnInsertFence(ctx.r3.u32);
  }
  __imp__sub_8375F810(ctx, base);

// D3D's writers of dirty constants into its command stream (r3 device; the
// registers by mask from r6): runs of them copied as packets, the stream's
// write pointer (device +48) moved on. With no GPU emulation nothing reads the
// stream and the renderer reads the device's own copies: skipped.
REX_EXTERN(__imp__sub_83767670);
REX_HOOK_RAW(sub_83767670) {
  if (!ng2::video::IsNativeRenderer()) {
    __imp__sub_83767670(ctx, base);
  }
}
REX_EXTERN(__imp__sub_83767A10);
REX_HOOK_RAW(sub_83767A10) {
  if (!ng2::video::IsNativeRenderer()) {
    __imp__sub_83767A10(ctx, base);
  }

// Swap: the frame is done.
//
// sub_8376E028, a D3D loop the game runs on another thread while it waits
// (the Game Over screen: there the game makes a frame every 2 vblanks), swaps
// the last front buffer again each time round (returning to 8376E0C4). On the
// console that shows the same picture; here each is a present of its own, on
// a clock of its own between the game's frames: frame times of 3 ms, then 30,
// and with V-Sync On refreshes taken from the game's frames (#13). Those are
// left to the guest while the game is presenting its own frames, and only
// reach the screen after a wait of over 100 ms without one.
REX_EXTERN(__imp__sub_8376AA48);
REX_HOOK_RAW(sub_8376AA48) {
  constexpr uint32_t kKeepAlive = 0x8376E0C4;
  static std::atomic<int64_t> lastGameSwapNs{0};
  g_counters.swaps++;
  uint32_t device = ctx.r3.u32, frontBuffer = ctx.r4.u32;
  int64_t now = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::nanoseconds>(
                    std::chrono::steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch())
                    .count();
  bool repeat = uint32_t(ctx.lr) == kKeepAlive &&
                now - lastGameSwapNs.load(std::memory_order_relaxed) < 100'000'000;
  if (uint32_t(ctx.lr) != kKeepAlive) {
    lastGameSwapNs.store(now, std::memory_order_relaxed);
  }
  __imp__sub_8376AA48(ctx, base);
  if (ng2::video::IsNativeRenderer() && !repeat) {
    ng2::video::OnSwap(device, frontBuffer);
  }
  if (StatsEnabled()) {
    ReportStats();
  }
}

// The D3D library's waits for the GPU: each fills a wait block (with the
// time base at +20 when it starts) and calls sub_8375E588 until the GPU's
// read pointer passes a fence (1: still waiting). The console spins here; on
// a PC that's a whole core busy until the next vblank, so once a wait has
// spun a while each step sleeps a little. The count starts again with each
// wait, told apart by that time stamp (they end on the read pointer, not on
// a step's 0).
REX_EXTERN(__imp__sub_8375E588);
REX_HOOK_RAW(sub_8375E588) {
  thread_local uint32_t spins = 0, lastStamp = 0;
  uint32_t stamp = ng2::guest::Load32(ctx.r3.u32 + 20);
  if (stamp != lastStamp) {
    lastStamp = stamp;
    spins = 0;
  }
  __imp__sub_8375E588(ctx, base);
  if (ctx.r3.u32 != 0 && ++spins > 64) {
#if defined(_WIN32)
    std::this_thread::yield();  // a sleep there is a millisecond or more
#else
    std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::microseconds(100));
#endif
  }
}

// A wait at the barrier over 2 ms, logged when it happens (at most one line a
// second; the ones in between are counted into the next line): a thread kept
// waiting that long is a pass the sound can't afford (one is ~5 ms of audio).
static void NoteBarrierWait(std::chrono::steady_clock::duration waited) {
  using namespace std::chrono;
  static std::atomic<uint32_t> skipped{0};
  static std::atomic<int64_t> last_report_ns{0};
  const double ms = duration<double, std::milli>(waited).count();
  if (ms < 2.0) {
    return;
  }
  const int64_t now = duration_cast<nanoseconds>(steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch()).count();
  int64_t last = last_report_ns.load();
  if (now - last >= 1'000'000'000 && last_report_ns.compare_exchange_strong(last, now)) {
    REXLOG_WARN("audio barrier: waited {:.1f} ms ({} more over 2 ms since the last line)", ms,
                skipped.exchange(0));
  } else {
    skipped++;
  }
}

// The audio engine's barrier (XAudio2's voice processing, sub_83774800): each
// thread taking part sets its processor's byte in an 8-byte mask and waits
// until the mask holds all of them; the first to see that cleared it, and a
// waiting thread only left on seeing the mask whole or cleared. If the OS
// paused it right then, the other thread could clear the mask and set its
// byte again for the next pass first, leaving both waiting for good (the
// sound stops; on the console the hardware threads aren't paused). Here only
// the lowest-numbered thread taking part clears the mask, a byte at a time and
// its own last, and the others leave once their own byte is cleared: a byte is
// only cleared by a completed barrier and only set again by its own thread
// after that. Byte accesses only: the mask needn't be 8-byte aligned, and an
// 8-byte lock across a cache line would be a split lock.
REX_EXTERN(__imp__sub_83774800);
REX_HOOK_RAW(sub_83774800) {
  // NG2_GAME_AUDIO_BARRIER=1: the game's own barrier (for comparisons).
  static const bool original = [] {
    const char* v = std::getenv("NG2_GAME_AUDIO_BARRIER");
    return v && v[0] == '1';
  }();
  if (original) {
    __imp__sub_83774800(ctx, base);
    return;
  }
  uint32_t engine = ctx.r3.u32;
  if (ng2::guest::Load32(engine + 0x130) == 0) {
    return;
  }
  uint8_t cpu = *ng2::guest::Virtual(ctx.r13.u32 + 0x10C);
  if (cpu >= 6) {
    __imp__sub_83774800(ctx, base);  // not a processor that takes part
    return;
  }
  uint8_t* mask = ng2::guest::Virtual(ctx.r4.u32);
  auto load = [&](uint32_t i) { return __atomic_load_n(mask + i, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE); };
  auto store = [&](uint32_t i, uint8_t v) { __atomic_store_n(mask + i, v, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST); };
  // Who takes part, read once as the game does: one byte per processor.
  bool expected[6];
  int clearer = -1;
  for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
    expected[i] = ng2::guest::Load32(engine + 0x134 + 4 * i) != 0;
    if (expected[i] && clearer < 0) {
      clearer = int(i);
    }
  }
  store(cpu, 1);
  // Timed from the first yield on (a few hundred microseconds in): a normal
  // pass never gets there.
  std::chrono::steady_clock::time_point slow_since{};
  for (uint32_t spins = 0;; spins++) {
    if (load(cpu) == 0) {
      if (spins > 4096) {
        NoteBarrierWait(std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - slow_since);
      }
      return;  // completed
    }
    if (int(cpu) == clearer) {
      bool whole = true;
      for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
        whole &= (load(i) != 0) == expected[i];
      }
      if (whole) {
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
          if (i != cpu) {
            store(i, 0);
          }
        }
        store(cpu, 0);
        if (spins > 4096) {
          NoteBarrierWait(std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - slow_since);
        }
        return;
      }
    }
    if (spins == 4096) {
      slow_since = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
    }
    if (spins >= 4096) {
      std::this_thread::yield();
    } else {
      __builtin_ia32_pause();
    }
  }
}
```
