```h
// ng2 - Ninja Gaiden II static recompilation
//
// Native renderer: the game's D3D calls are hooked and drawn with Vulkan
// through plume, after Unleashed Recompiled's gpu/video.cpp. It draws by
// default; with NG2_RENDERER=xenos ReXGlue's xenos plugin emulates the GPU.

#pragma once

#include <filesystem>

#include <cstdint>

namespace ng2::video {

// True unless NG2_RENDERER=xenos: no GPU plugin, this renderer draws.
bool IsNativeRenderer();

// Creates the Vulkan device and swapchain on the game window (Wayland or X11).
bool CreateHostDevice();

void DestroyHostDevice();
// Where the pipelines made are listed, to make them early next time.
void SetPipelineListPath(const std::filesystem::path& path);
// The game starting a frame (for NG2_LATENCY_LOG).
void MarkFrameStart();

// A full-screen movie's frame (Y, U, V planes, 4:2:0), shown instead of the
// game's picture while frames keep coming.
void ShowMovieFrame(const uint8_t* const planes[3], const uint32_t pitches[3], uint32_t width,
                    uint32_t height);
// The full-screen movie is still playing (no new frame this time): its last
// frame stays up.
void KeepMovieShown();

// Called from the D3D hooks on the game's D3D thread, after the original
// function ran (guest addresses; docs/d3d-map-*.md has the signatures).
// The most rects a Clear passes on (D3D's has no limit; more are dropped).
constexpr uint32_t kMaxClearRects = 64;
void OnClear(uint32_t device, uint32_t rectCount, const int32_t (*rects)[4], uint32_t flags,
             uint32_t color, float z, uint32_t stencil);
void OnResolve(uint32_t device, uint32_t flags, uint32_t sourceRect, uint32_t destTexture,
               uint32_t destPoint, uint32_t clearColor, float clearZ, uint32_t clearStencil);
void OnSwap(uint32_t device, uint32_t frontBuffer);
void OnCreateShader(uint32_t object, uint32_t container, bool pixel);
void OnDraw(uint32_t device, uint32_t primitive, uint32_t startVertex, uint32_t count,
            bool indexed, uint32_t startIndex);
// Immediate-mode draws: the game writes the data into the returned memory
// after the call; the draw is recorded at the next hooked call.
void OnBeginVertices(uint32_t device, uint32_t primitive, uint32_t vertexCount, uint32_t stride,
                     uint32_t vertexData);
void OnBeginIndexedVertices(uint32_t device, uint32_t primitive, uint32_t baseVertex,
                            uint32_t vertexCount, uint32_t indexCount, bool wideIndices,
                            uint32_t stride, uint32_t indexData, uint32_t vertexData);

// The draw worker (NG2_DRAW_WORKER=1, video.cpp): the calls recorded so far
// (0 when it's off), and a wait until the worker has replayed that many. The
// GPU steps (native_gpu.cpp) run after the calls before them were drawn.
uint64_t RecordedCalls();

void WaitForRecordedCalls(uint64_t records);

// Under gamescope, where frames' times on screen are reported unevenly (video.cpp).
bool UnderGamescope();
// The game a frame ahead of the display and held up by it each frame: the vblank
// timer should skip a step (video.cpp, NoteFrameWait).
bool DrainRequested();
// The display's last refresh and period (steady_clock ns), from the
// presents reaching the screen; false unless steady and recent.
bool DisplayRefresh(int64_t* lastNs, int64_t* periodNs);
int64_t DisplayClockNow();
// NG2_LATENCY_LOG: the main thread read the pad; the render thread took the
// frame (the handoff).
void NoteInputRead();
void NoteFrameTaken();

}  // namespace ng2::video
```

`src/mods.cpp`:

```cpp
// ng2 - Ninja Gaiden II static recompilation
//
// Mods: a mod is a folder in the mods folder. Its files/ holds game files by
// their path in the game (files/char/ryu_b/ryu_b.gmd stands for the game's
// char\ryu_b\ryu_b.gmd), loaded in place of the game's own. Its optional
// mod.toml names it (name, version), can turn it off (enabled = false), and
// can load one of the game's own files in place of another:
//
//   [replace]
//   'char/ryu_b/ryu_b.gmd' = 'char/ryu_c/ryu_c.gmd'
//
// Mods are taken in their folders' name order; when two replace the same
// file, the first one's is loaded.
//
// How a game file is loaded, and where a mod's goes in (TU3 addresses):
// - Every file has an id: the executable's table at 0x83B01718 gives its path
//   ("char\ryu_b\ryu_b.gmd"), 5219 of them (5099 on the disc, the rest the
//   Mission Mode DLC's). load_img.bin has the disc files' sizes, pack_img.bin
//   where each sits in the .ng2 archives.
// - The loader's request for a file (sub_823D61D8) carries a byte that, when
//   set, has the file loaded loose (sub_823D69F8), from D:\databin\<its path>
//   or D:\<its path>: the developers' way to try a file outside the archives.
//   For a mod's file that byte is set, and the loose open is given the mod's
//   file instead (on a read-only device of the mods folder), so the game loads
//   it through its own file calls.
// - The game asks a file's size (sub_823D6428) before it makes room for it: a
//   mod's file larger than the game's gets its own size there, and in
//   load_img.bin's table once that is loaded (sub_8366C178).

#include "mods.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <atomic>
#include <cctype>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstring>
#include <fstream>
#include <iterator>
#include <memory>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <vector>

#include <toml++/toml.hpp>

#include <rex/cvar.h>
#include <rex/filesystem.h>
#include <rex/filesystem/devices/host_path_device.h>
#include <rex/filesystem/vfs.h>
#include <rex/logging.h>
#include <rex/ppc/context.h>
#include <rex/runtime.h>
#include <rex/system/kernel_state.h>
#include <rex/system/xmemory.h>

#include "gpu/guest.h"

REXCVAR_DEFINE_BOOL(log_file_loads, false, "Mods",
                    "Log every file the game loads, by id and path (to find the file to mod)");

namespace fs = std::filesystem;

namespace ng2::mods {
namespace {

constexpr uint32_t kFileNames = 0x83B01718;  // a path string per file id
constexpr uint32_t kFileCount = 5219;        // the loader's (0x1463)
constexpr uint32_t kDiscFileCount = 5099;    // load_img.bin's
constexpr uint32_t kLoadImg = 0x84F59208;    // load_img.bin as loaded: its buffer
// pack_img.bin's first slots and their archives (slots 6 on hold the chapters
// again, one each).
const std::vector<std::vector<std::string>>& SlotArchives() {
  static const std::vector<std::vector<std::string>> slots = [] {
    std::vector<std::vector<std::string>> s = {{"cmn.ng2"}, {"char.ng2"}, {}, {"rtm.ng2"},
                                               {"other.ng2"}, {"other_rtm.ng2"}};
    for (int c = 1; c <= 14; ++c) {
      char name[24];
      std::snprintf(name, sizeof(name), "s_chap_%02d.ng2", c);
      s[2].push_back(name);
    }
    return s;
  }();
  return slots;
}

// A path as the game writes it, for comparing: backslashes, lower case, no
// leading separator.
std::string Key(std::string_view path) {
  std::string k;
  k.reserve(path.size());
  for (char ch : path) {
    if (ch == '/') ch = '\\';
    if (k.empty() && ch == '\\') continue;
    k.push_back(char(std::tolower(static_cast<unsigned char>(ch))));
  }
  return k;
}

uint32_t Be32(const uint8_t* p) {
  return uint32_t(p[0]) << 24 | uint32_t(p[1]) << 16 | uint32_t(p[2]) << 8 | p[3];
}

std::vector<uint8_t> ReadAll(const fs::path& p) {
  std::ifstream f(p, std::ios::binary);
  return std::vector<uint8_t>((std::istreambuf_iterator<char>(f)), std::istreambuf_iterator<char>());
}

// Where a disc file sits in the archives: pack_img.bin has four tables (ids,
// counts, offsets, sizes), each a word per slot pointing at a word per archive.
struct Located {
  std::string archive;
  uint32_t offset = 0, size = 0;
};
bool Locate(const std::vector<uint8_t>& pack, uint32_t id, Located* out) {
  auto word = [&](uint32_t at, uint32_t* v) {
    if (size_t(at) + 4 > pack.size()) return false;
    *v = Be32(pack.data() + at);
    return true;
  };
  uint32_t table[4];
  for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
    if (!word(i * 4, &table[i])) return false;
  }
  const auto& slots = SlotArchives();
  for (uint32_t slot = 0; slot < slots.size(); ++slot) {
    uint32_t p[4];
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
      if (!word(table[i] + 4 * slot, &p[i])) return false;
    }
    for (uint32_t a = 0; a < slots[slot].size(); ++a) {
      uint32_t ids, count, offsets, sizes;
      if (!word(p[0] + 4 * a, &ids) || !word(p[1] + 4 * a, &count) ||
          !word(p[2] + 4 * a, &offsets) || !word(p[3] + 4 * a, &sizes) || count > kFileCount) {
        return false;
      }
      for (uint32_t k = 0; k < count; ++k) {
        uint32_t fid;
        if (!word(ids + 4 * k, &fid)) return false;
        if (fid == id) {
          out->archive = slots[slot][a];
          return word(offsets + 4 * k, &out->offset) && word(sizes + 4 * k, &out->size);
        }
      }
    }
  }
  return false;
}

// A NUL-ended guest string of at most max bytes, or null.
const char* GuestString(uint32_t va, size_t max, size_t* len) {
  if (va < 0x10000u || va > 0xFFFFFFFFu - max) return nullptr;  // (the game's stacks are at 0x7...)
  const char* s = reinterpret_cast<const char*>(ng2::guest::Virtual(va));
  size_t n = 0;
  while (n < max && s[n]) ++n;
  if (n == max) return nullptr;
  *len = n;
  return s;
}

bool Mount(const char* device, const char* link, const fs::path& root) {
  auto* vfs = REX_KERNEL_FS();
  auto d = std::make_unique<rex::filesystem::HostPathDevice>(device, root, true);
  if (!vfs || !d->Initialize() || !vfs->RegisterDevice(std::move(d)) ||
      !vfs->RegisterSymbolicLink(link, device)) {
    REXLOG_WARN("mods: can't read {}", rex::path_to_utf8(root));
    return false;
  }
  return true;
}

struct Entry {
  uint32_t id = 0;
  uint32_t size = 0;
  uint32_t guestPath = 0;  // the file to the game's CreateFile
  std::string mod;
};

// Set up by Activate before the game runs; read-only after.
struct State {
  std::atomic<bool> active{false};
  bool logLoads = false;
  std::vector<std::string> names;  // the game's path per file id
  std::vector<Entry> entries;
  std::vector<int32_t> byId;  // entry per file id, or -1
  std::unordered_map<std::string, size_t> byKey;
  std::atomic<uint32_t> loaded{0};
} g;

std::vector<std::string> ReadNames() {
  std::vector<std::string> names;
  names.reserve(kFileCount);
  for (uint32_t id = 0; id < kFileCount; ++id) {
    size_t len = 0;
    const char* s = GuestString(ng2::guest::Load32(kFileNames + 4 * id), 256, &len);
    if (!s || !len) {
      REXLOG_WARN("mods: the game's file table ends early, at {}: mods off", id);
      return {};
    }
    names.emplace_back(s, len);
  }
  return names;
}

struct Mod {
  std::string folder, name, version;
  fs::path dir;
  bool enabled = true;
  std::vector<std::pair<std::string, std::string>> replace;  // game file, file loaded instead
};

bool ReadManifest(Mod& mod) {
  const fs::path file = mod.dir / "mod.toml";
  std::error_code ec;
  if (!fs::exists(file, ec)) return true;
  try {
    const toml::table root = toml::parse_file(rex::path_to_utf8(file));  // (UTF-8, on Windows too)
    const toml::table* t = root["mod"].as_table() ? root["mod"].as_table() : &root;
    if (auto v = (*t)["name"].value<std::string>()) mod.name = *v;
    if (auto v = (*t)["version"].value<std::string>()) mod.version = *v;
    if (auto v = (*t)["enabled"].value<bool>()) mod.enabled = *v;
    if (const toml::table* r = root["replace"].as_table()) {
      for (const auto& [target, source] : *r) {
        if (auto s = source.value<std::string>()) {
          mod.replace.emplace_back(std::string(target.str()), *s);
        }
      }
    }
  } catch (const toml::parse_error& e) {
    REXLOG_WARN("mods: {}: mod.toml can't be read ({}): left out", mod.folder,
                std::string(e.description()));
    return false;
  }
  return true;
}

}  // namespace

void Activate(const fs::path& folder, const fs::path& gameRoot, const fs::path& cacheDir) {
  g.logLoads = REXCVAR_GET(log_file_loads);
  std::error_code ec;
  std::vector<Mod> mods;
  if (fs::is_directory(folder, ec)) {
    for (auto it = fs::directory_iterator(folder, ec); !ec && it != fs::directory_iterator();
         it.increment(ec)) {  // (increment(ec): an error mid-scan ends it, never throws)
      const auto& item = *it;
      if (!item.is_directory(ec)) continue;
      Mod mod;
      mod.dir = item.path();
      mod.folder = rex::path_to_utf8(item.path().filename());
      mod.name = mod.folder;
      if (ReadManifest(mod)) mods.push_back(std::move(mod));
    }
  }
  std::sort(mods.begin(), mods.end(), [](const Mod& a, const Mod& b) {
    return Key(a.folder) < Key(b.folder);
  });
  const bool any = std::any_of(mods.begin(), mods.end(), [](const Mod& m) { return m.enabled; });
  if (!any && !g.logLoads) {
    if (!mods.empty()) REXLOG_INFO("mods: {} in {}, none on", mods.size(), rex::path_to_utf8(folder));
    return;
  }
  g.names = ReadNames();
  if (g.names.size() != kFileCount) return;
  std::unordered_map<std::string, uint32_t> ids;
  for (uint32_t id = 0; id < kFileCount; ++id) ids.emplace(Key(g.names[id]), id);
  g.byId.assign(kFileCount, -1);

  struct Pending {
    uint32_t id;
    uint32_t size;
    std::string guestPath;
    std::string mod;
  };
  std::vector<Pending> pending;
  auto add = [&](const Mod& mod, const std::string& target, const fs::path& host,
                 const std::string& guestPath) {
    auto id = ids.find(Key(target));
    if (id == ids.end()) {
      REXLOG_WARN("mods: {}: {} isn't one of the game's files: left out", mod.name, target);
      return false;
    }
    if (g.byId[id->second] >= 0) {
      REXLOG_INFO("mods: {}: {} is another mod's already", mod.name, target);
      return false;
    }
    std::error_code e;
    const uint64_t size = fs::file_size(host, e);
    if (e || size == 0 || size > 0x7FFFFFFF) {
      REXLOG_WARN("mods: {}: {} is empty or too large: left out", mod.name, target);
      return false;
    }
    g.byId[id->second] = int32_t(pending.size());
    pending.push_back({id->second, uint32_t(size), guestPath, mod.name});
    return true;
  };

  std::vector<uint8_t> pack, loadImg;  // (read when a [replace] needs them)
  bool cacheUsed = false;
  int modsOn = 0;
  for (const Mod& mod : mods) {
    if (!mod.enabled) continue;
    int brought = 0;
    const fs::path files = mod.dir / "files";
    if (fs::is_directory(files, ec)) {
      for (auto it = fs::recursive_directory_iterator(files, ec);
           !ec && it != fs::recursive_directory_iterator(); it.increment(ec)) {
        if (!it->is_regular_file(ec)) continue;
        // (UTF-8: the guest path below goes back to a host path as UTF-8)
        std::string rel = rex::path_to_utf8(fs::relative(it->path(), files, ec));
        std::replace(rel.begin(), rel.end(), '\\', '/');
        std::string guest = rel;
        std::replace(guest.begin(), guest.end(), '/', '\\');
        brought += add(mod, rel, it->path(), "ng2mods:\\" + mod.folder + "\\files\\" + guest);
      }
    }
    for (const auto& [target, source] : mod.replace) {
      auto src = ids.find(Key(source));
      if (src == ids.end() || src->second >= kDiscFileCount) {
        REXLOG_WARN("mods: {}: [replace] {}: {} isn't one of the disc's files", mod.name, target,
                    source);
        continue;
      }
      if (pack.empty()) pack = ReadAll(gameRoot / "pack_img.bin");
      if (loadImg.empty()) loadImg = ReadAll(gameRoot / "load_img.bin");
      Located at;
      // The file's own size (load_img.bin, after a 16-byte header, 8 bytes a
      // file); the archive's is padded.
      const size_t entry = 16 + 8 * size_t(src->second);
      const uint32_t size = loadImg.size() >= entry + 4 ? Be32(loadImg.data() + entry) : 0;
      if (!Locate(pack, src->second, &at) || size == 0 || size > at.size) {
        REXLOG_WARN("mods: {}: [replace] {}: {} isn't in the game's archives", mod.name, target,
                    source);
        continue;
      }
      const std::string leaf = std::to_string(src->second) + ".bin";
      const fs::path cached = cacheDir / leaf;
      std::error_code e;
      if (fs::file_size(cached, e) != size) {
        fs::create_directories(cacheDir, e);
        std::ifstream in(gameRoot / at.archive, std::ios::binary);
        std::vector<char> bytes(size);
        in.seekg(at.offset);
        in.read(bytes.data(), std::streamsize(size));
        std::ofstream out(cached, std::ios::binary | std::ios::trunc);
        out.write(bytes.data(), std::streamsize(size));
        out.close();  // (flushed and checked: a full disk mustn't leave a short copy in use)
        if (!in || !out) {
          fs::remove(cached, e);
          REXLOG_WARN("mods: {}: [replace] {}: can't copy {} from {}", mod.name, target, source,
                      at.archive);
          continue;
        }
      }
      cacheUsed = true;
      brought += add(mod, target, cached, "ng2modcache:\\" + leaf);
    }
    if (brought) {
      ++modsOn;
      REXLOG_INFO("mods: on: {}{}{}, {} file(s)", mod.name, mod.version.empty() ? "" : " ",
                  mod.version, brought);
    }
  }

  // The paths the game's CreateFile is given instead, in guest memory.
  if (!pending.empty()) {
    auto* memory = rex::Runtime::instance()->memory();
    size_t total = 0;
    for (const Pending& p : pending) total += p.guestPath.size() + 1;
    const uint32_t base = memory->SystemHeapAlloc(uint32_t(total));
    if (!base || !Mount("\\Device\\Ng2Mods", "ng2mods:", folder) ||
        (cacheUsed && !Mount("\\Device\\Ng2ModCache", "ng2modcache:", cacheDir))) {
      REXLOG_ERROR("mods: can't set up the mods' files: mods off");
      g.byId.assign(kFileCount, -1);
      if (!g.logLoads) return;
      pending.clear();
    }
    uint32_t va = base;
    for (const Pending& p : pending) {
      std::memcpy(memory->TranslateVirtual<char*>(va), p.guestPath.c_str(), p.guestPath.size() + 1);
      g.entries.push_back({p.id, p.size, va, p.mod});
      g.byKey.emplace(Key(g.names[p.id]), g.entries.size() - 1);
      va += uint32_t(p.guestPath.size() + 1);
    }
  }
  REXLOG_INFO("mods: {} on, {} game file(s) replaced{}", modsOn, g.entries.size(),
              g.logLoads ? "; every file the game loads is logged" : "");
  g.active.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
}

}  // namespace ng2::mods

using ng2::mods::g;

// The loader's request for a file (sub_823D61D8): r3 the file id, r10 its
// load-loose byte, just before it is tested. ng2_codegen.toml places it.
void Ng2ModFileRequest(PPCRegister& r3, PPCRegister& r10) {
  if (!g.active.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) return;
  const uint32_t id = r3.u32 & 0xFFFF;
  const bool modded = id < g.byId.size() && g.byId[id] >= 0;
  if (g.logLoads && id < g.names.size()) {
    REXLOG_INFO("mods: the game loads {} {}{}", id, g.names[id], modded ? " (a mod's)" : "");
  }
  if (!modded) return;
  r10.u64 = 1;
  if (g.loaded.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed) < 64 && !g.logLoads) {
    REXLOG_INFO("mods: {} from {}", g.names[id], g.entries[size_t(g.byId[id])].mod);
  }
}

// The loose load (sub_823D69F8) just before its CreateFile: r3 the path it
// made, D:\databin\<path> or D:\<path>. A mod's file is opened instead.
void Ng2ModOpenPath(PPCRegister& r3) {
  if (!g.active.load(std::memory_order_acquire) || g.entries.empty()) return;
  size_t len = 0;
  const char* path = ng2::mods::GuestString(r3.u32, 300, &len);
  if (!path) return;
  std::string_view p(path, len);
  for (std::string_view prefix : {std::string_view("d:\\databin\\"), std::string_view("d:\\")}) {
    if (p.size() > prefix.size() && ng2::mods::Key(p.substr(0, prefix.size())) == prefix) {
      auto it = g.byKey.find(ng2::mods::Key(p.substr(prefix.size())));
      if (it != g.byKey.end()) r3.u64 = g.entries[it->second].guestPath;
      return;
    }
  }
}

// A file's size (sub_823D6428), r11 before its rounding to 2 KB, r31 the id:
// at least the mod's file's.
void Ng2ModFileSize(PPCRegister& r11, PPCRegister& r31) {
  if (!g.active.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) return;
  const uint32_t id = r31.u32 & 0xFFFF;
  if (id >= g.byId.size() || g.byId[id] < 0) return;
  const uint32_t size = g.entries[size_t(g.byId[id])].size;
  if (size > r11.u32) r11.u64 = size;
}

// load_img.bin loaded and its offsets made pointers (sub_8366C178): the mods'
// larger files' sizes in its table, for what reads it directly.
void Ng2ModFileTable(PPCRegister& /*r1*/) {
  if (!g.active.load(std::memory_order_acquire) || g.entries.empty()) return;
  const uint32_t buffer = ng2::guest::Load32(ng2::mods::kLoadImg);
  if (!buffer) return;
  const uint32_t sizes = ng2::guest::Load32(buffer);
  if (!sizes || ng2::guest::Load32(buffer + 4) != ng2::mods::kDiscFileCount) {
    REXLOG_WARN("mods: load_img.bin isn't as expected: its sizes left as they are");
    return;
  }
  for (const auto& e : g.entries) {
    if (e.id >= ng2::mods::kDiscFileCount) continue;
    uint8_t* p = ng2::guest::Virtual(sizes + 8 * e.id);
    uint32_t old;
    std::memcpy(&old, p, 4);
    if (e.size > rex::byte_swap(old)) {
      const uint32_t v = rex::byte_swap(e.size);
      std::memcpy(p, &v, 4);
    }
  }
}
```

`src/movie/host_movie.cpp`:

```cpp
// ng2 - Ninja Gaiden II static recompilation
//
// See host_movie.h.

#include "host_movie.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <atomic>
#include <chrono>
#include <condition_variable>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <deque>
#include <mutex>
#include <thread>
#include <vector>

#include <SDL3/SDL.h>
#include <rex/filesystem.h>
#include <rex/logging.h>

extern "C" {
#include <libavcodec/avcodec.h>
#include <libavformat/avformat.h>
#include <libavutil/channel_layout.h>
#include <libavutil/imgutils.h>
#include <libswresample/swresample.h>
#include <libswscale/swscale.h>
}

namespace ng2::movie {

namespace {

// Frames decoded ahead of the one on screen.
constexpr size_t kQueuedFrames = 6;

struct Frame {
  double time = 0.0;  // seconds from the start of the movie
  int width = 0, height = 0;
  std::vector<uint8_t> planes[3];  // tightly packed Y, U, V (4:2:0)
};

std::string AvError(int error) {
  char text[AV_ERROR_MAX_STRING_SIZE] = {};
  av_strerror(error, text, sizeof(text));
  return text;
}

bool AudioEnabled() {
  const char* v = std::getenv("NG2_AUDIO");
  return !(v && v[0] == '0');
}

}  // namespace

struct HostMovie::State {
  std::string name;
  AVFormatContext* format = nullptr;
  AVCodecContext* video = nullptr;
  AVCodecContext* audio = nullptr;
  // Audio reads its own handle to the file on its own thread, keeping about
  // half a second queued for SDL: paced by the video queue it starved
  // whenever the game hitched.
  AVFormatContext* audioFormat = nullptr;
  std::thread audioThread;
  int videoStream = -1, audioStream = -1;
  SwsContext* scaler = nullptr;
  SwrContext* resampler = nullptr;
  SDL_AudioStream* audioOut = nullptr;
  int outputChannels = 2;
  double startTime = 0.0;  // the first video frame's timestamp
  double decodedTime = 0.0;  // the latest decoded frame's time
  bool loop = false;
  double loopOffset = 0.0;  // added to frame times after each pass
  double frameDuration = 1.0 / 30.0;
  bool constantRate = false;
  uint64_t passStartFrame = 0;  // framesDecoded when the current pass began
  uint64_t framesDecoded = 0;
  int width = 0, height = 0;

  std::thread thread;
  std::mutex mutex;
  std::condition_variable wake;
  std::deque<Frame> queue;
  bool endOfFile = false;
  bool quit = false;

  // Owned by the game's thread.
  bool started = false;
  std::chrono::steady_clock::time_point start;
  bool finished = false;
  double lastShown = -1.0;

  ~State() {
    {
      std::lock_guard lock(mutex);
      quit = true;
    }
    wake.notify_all();
    if (thread.joinable()) {
      thread.join();
    }
    if (audioThread.joinable()) {
      audioThread.join();
    }
    if (audioOut) {
      SDL_DestroyAudioStream(audioOut);
    }
    swr_free(&resampler);
    sws_freeContext(scaler);
    avcodec_free_context(&audio);
    avcodec_free_context(&video);
    avformat_close_input(&audioFormat);
    avformat_close_input(&format);
  }

  AVCodecContext* OpenDecoder(AVFormatContext* source, int stream) {
    const AVCodecParameters* parameters = source->streams[stream]->codecpar;
    const AVCodec* codec = avcodec_find_decoder(parameters->codec_id);
    if (!codec) {
      REXLOG_ERROR("movie: {}: no decoder for {}", name, avcodec_get_name(parameters->codec_id));
      return nullptr;
    }
    AVCodecContext* context = avcodec_alloc_context3(codec);
    avcodec_parameters_to_context(context, parameters);
    context->thread_count = 2;
    if (int error = avcodec_open2(context, codec, nullptr); error < 0) {
      REXLOG_ERROR("movie: {}: cannot open the {} decoder: {}", name, codec->name, AvError(error));
      avcodec_free_context(&context);
    }
    return context;
  }

  bool OpenAudioOutput() {
    if (!SDL_InitSubSystem(SDL_INIT_AUDIO)) {
      REXLOG_WARN("movie: {}: no audio ({})", name, SDL_GetError());
      return false;
    }
    // Mono, stereo and 5.1 go out as they are (SDL's channel order matches
    // FFmpeg's), so the system mixes them for its speakers; anything else
    // becomes stereo.
    AVChannelLayout layout = AV_CHANNEL_LAYOUT_STEREO;
    AVChannelLayout mono = AV_CHANNEL_LAYOUT_MONO, surround = AV_CHANNEL_LAYOUT_5POINT1_BACK;
    if (!av_channel_layout_compare(&audio->ch_layout, &mono) ||
        !av_channel_layout_compare(&audio->ch_layout, &surround)) {
      layout = audio->ch_layout;
    } else if (audio->ch_layout.nb_channels == 1) {
      layout = mono;  // an unspecified single channel
    }
    outputChannels = layout.nb_channels;
    if (swr_alloc_set_opts2(&resampler, &layout, AV_SAMPLE_FMT_FLT, 48000, &audio->ch_layout,
                            audio->sample_fmt, audio->sample_rate, 0, nullptr) < 0 ||
        swr_init(resampler) < 0) {
      REXLOG_WARN("movie: {}: cannot convert its audio", name);
      return false;
    }
    SDL_AudioSpec spec{SDL_AUDIO_F32, outputChannels, 48000};
    audioOut =
        SDL_OpenAudioDeviceStream(SDL_AUDIO_DEVICE_DEFAULT_PLAYBACK, &spec, nullptr, nullptr);
    if (!audioOut) {
      REXLOG_WARN("movie: {}: no audio device ({})", name, SDL_GetError());
      return false;
    }
    return true;
  }

  void PushAudio(const AVFrame* frame) {
    int samples = swr_get_out_samples(resampler, frame->nb_samples);
    if (samples <= 0) {
      return;
    }
    std::vector<float> buffer(size_t(samples) * outputChannels);
    uint8_t* out = reinterpret_cast<uint8_t*>(buffer.data());
    int converted = swr_convert(resampler, &out, samples,
                                const_cast<const uint8_t**>(frame->extended_data),
                                frame->nb_samples);
    if (converted > 0) {
      SDL_PutAudioStreamData(audioOut, buffer.data(),
                             converted * outputChannels * int(sizeof(float)));
    }
  }

  // Converts a decoded picture to packed 4:2:0 planes.
  Frame MakeFrame(const AVFrame* picture) {
    Frame frame;
    frame.width = picture->width;
    frame.height = picture->height;
    int64_t timestamp = picture->best_effort_timestamp;
    AVRational base = format->streams[videoStream]->time_base;
    // Without a timestamp: one frame after the previous one.
    // Constant-rate movies are timed by frame count: the files' timestamps
    // are whole milliseconds (60 fps frames 16 or 17 ms apart), and movies
    // shown side by side then changed frames at different moments.
    if (constantRate) {
      frame.time = double(framesDecoded - passStartFrame) * frameDuration + loopOffset;
    } else {
      frame.time = timestamp == AV_NOPTS_VALUE
                       ? (framesDecoded ? decodedTime + frameDuration : loopOffset)
                       : timestamp * av_q2d(base) - startTime + loopOffset;
    }
    framesDecoded++;
    decodedTime = frame.time;

    int chromaWidth = (frame.width + 1) / 2, chromaHeight = (frame.height + 1) / 2;
    frame.planes[0].resize(size_t(frame.width) * frame.height);
    frame.planes[1].resize(size_t(chromaWidth) * chromaHeight);
    frame.planes[2].resize(size_t(chromaWidth) * chromaHeight);
    uint8_t* dst[4] = {frame.planes[0].data(), frame.planes[1].data(), frame.planes[2].data()};
    int dstPitch[4] = {frame.width, chromaWidth, chromaWidth};
    if (picture->format == AV_PIX_FMT_YUV420P) {
      av_image_copy(dst, dstPitch, const_cast<const uint8_t**>(picture->data),
                    picture->linesize, AV_PIX_FMT_YUV420P, frame.width, frame.height);
    } else {
      scaler = sws_getCachedContext(scaler, frame.width, frame.height,
                                    AVPixelFormat(picture->format), frame.width, frame.height,
                                    AV_PIX_FMT_YUV420P, SWS_POINT, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr);
      if (scaler) {
        sws_scale(scaler, picture->data, picture->linesize, 0, frame.height, dst, dstPitch);
      }
    }
    return frame;
  }

  bool Quitting() {
    std::lock_guard lock(mutex);
    return quit;
  }

  void DecodeAudio() {
    const int kAhead = 48000 / 2 * outputChannels * int(sizeof(float));  // 0.5 s
    AVPacket* packet = av_packet_alloc();
    AVFrame* samples = av_frame_alloc();
    auto drain = [&] {
      while (avcodec_receive_frame(audio, samples) == 0) {
        PushAudio(samples);
      }
    };
    bool decodedAny = false;
    while (!Quitting()) {
      if (SDL_GetAudioStreamQueued(audioOut) > kAhead) {
        std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(20));
        continue;
      }
      if (av_read_frame(audioFormat, packet) < 0) {
        avcodec_send_packet(audio, nullptr);
        drain();
        if (!loop || !decodedAny || av_seek_frame(audioFormat, -1, 0, AVSEEK_FLAG_BACKWARD) < 0) {
          break;
        }
        avcodec_flush_buffers(audio);
        decodedAny = false;
        continue;
      }
      if (packet->stream_index == audioStream && avcodec_send_packet(audio, packet) == 0) {
        decodedAny = true;
        drain();
      }
      av_packet_unref(packet);
    }
    av_frame_free(&samples);
    av_packet_free(&packet);
  }

  static bool SamePicture(const AVFrame* a, const AVFrame* b) {
    if (a->width != b->width || a->height != b->height || a->format != b->format ||
        a->format != AV_PIX_FMT_YUV420P) {
      return false;
    }
    for (int p = 0; p < 3; p++) {
      int width = p ? (a->width + 1) / 2 : a->width;
      int height = p ? (a->height + 1) / 2 : a->height;
      for (int y = 0; y < height; y++) {
        if (std::memcmp(a->data[p] + size_t(y) * a->linesize[p],
                        b->data[p] + size_t(y) * b->linesize[p], width) != 0) {
          return false;
        }
      }
    }
    return true;
  }

  void Decode() {
    AVPacket* packet = av_packet_alloc();
    AVFrame* picture = av_frame_alloc();
    // FFmpeg's VC-1 decoder emits the opening picture twice (the title's
    // side panels), which puts the movie a frame behind others started with
    // it. The first picture is held until the second shows whether it is a
    // repeat; the clock starts at the first picture kept.
    AVFrame* held = nullptr;
    int decoded = 0;
    auto push = [&](AVFrame* source) {
      if (framesDecoded == 0) {
        int64_t timestamp = source->best_effort_timestamp;
        startTime = timestamp == AV_NOPTS_VALUE
                        ? 0.0
                        : timestamp * av_q2d(format->streams[videoStream]->time_base);
      }
      Frame frame = MakeFrame(source);
      std::unique_lock lock(mutex);
      wake.wait(lock, [&] { return quit || queue.size() < kQueuedFrames; });
      if (quit) {
        return false;
      }
      queue.push_back(std::move(frame));
      return true;
    };
    auto drain = [&](AVCodecContext* context) {
      while (avcodec_receive_frame(context, picture) == 0) {
        decoded++;
        if (decoded == 1) {
          held = av_frame_clone(picture);
          continue;
        }
        if (held) {
          bool repeat = SamePicture(held, picture);
          bool ok = repeat || push(held);
          av_frame_free(&held);
          if (!ok) {
            return false;
          }
        }
        if (!push(picture)) {
          return false;
        }
      }
      return true;
    };

    bool running = true;
    uint64_t framesAtPassStart = 0;
    while (running) {
      {
        std::lock_guard lock(mutex);
        if (quit) {
          break;
        }
      }
      int error = av_read_frame(format, packet);
      if (error < 0) {
        // End of file: flush the decoders.
        avcodec_send_packet(video, nullptr);
        running = drain(video);
        // A pass without a frame would loop forever.
        if (!running || !loop || framesDecoded == framesAtPassStart) {
          break;
        }
        framesAtPassStart = framesDecoded;
        passStartFrame = framesDecoded;
        // Start over, one frame after the last one shown.
        loopOffset = decodedTime + frameDuration;
        if (av_seek_frame(format, -1, 0, AVSEEK_FLAG_BACKWARD) < 0) {
          break;
        }
        avcodec_flush_buffers(video);
        continue;
      }
      AVCodecContext* context = packet->stream_index == videoStream ? video : nullptr;
      if (context && avcodec_send_packet(context, packet) == 0) {
        running = drain(context);
      }
      av_packet_unref(packet);
    }
    if (held && running) {
      push(held);  // a one-frame movie
    }
    av_frame_free(&held);
    av_frame_free(&picture);
    av_packet_free(&packet);
    std::lock_guard lock(mutex);
    endOfFile = true;
  }
};

HostMovie::HostMovie() : state_(std::make_unique<State>()) {}

HostMovie::~HostMovie() = default;

std::unique_ptr<HostMovie> HostMovie::Open(const std::filesystem::path& path, bool audio,
                                           bool loop) {
  std::unique_ptr<HostMovie> movie(new HostMovie());
  State& s = *movie->state_;
  s.loop = loop;
  // UTF-8, as FFmpeg takes file names on Windows too (path::string() there is
  // the ANSI code page, and throws for a name it can't hold).
  const std::string file = rex::path_to_utf8(path);
  s.name = rex::path_to_utf8(path.filename());
  if (int error = avformat_open_input(&s.format, file.c_str(), nullptr, nullptr); error < 0) {
    REXLOG_ERROR("movie: cannot open {}: {}", file, AvError(error));
    return nullptr;
  }
  avformat_find_stream_info(s.format, nullptr);
  s.videoStream = av_find_best_stream(s.format, AVMEDIA_TYPE_VIDEO, -1, -1, nullptr, 0);
  if (s.videoStream < 0 || !(s.video = s.OpenDecoder(s.format, s.videoStream))) {
    REXLOG_ERROR("movie: {}: no playable video stream", s.name);
    return nullptr;
  }
  s.width = s.video->width;
  s.height = s.video->height;
  AVRational rate = s.format->streams[s.videoStream]->avg_frame_rate;
  if (rate.num > 0 && rate.den > 0) {
    s.frameDuration = av_q2d(av_inv_q(rate));
    s.constantRate = av_cmp_q(rate, s.format->streams[s.videoStream]->r_frame_rate) == 0;
  }
  if (audio && AudioEnabled() &&
      avformat_open_input(&s.audioFormat, file.c_str(), nullptr, nullptr) >= 0 &&
      avformat_find_stream_info(s.audioFormat, nullptr) >= 0) {
    s.audioStream = av_find_best_stream(s.audioFormat, AVMEDIA_TYPE_AUDIO, -1, -1, nullptr, 0);
    if (s.audioStream >= 0 && (s.audio = s.OpenDecoder(s.audioFormat, s.audioStream)) &&
        !s.OpenAudioOutput()) {
      SDL_DestroyAudioStream(s.audioOut);
      s.audioOut = nullptr;
    }
  }
  REXLOG_INFO("movie: {} {}x{} {}{}{}", s.name, s.video->width, s.video->height,
              avcodec_get_name(s.video->codec_id), s.audioOut ? " with audio" : "",
              loop ? ", looping" : "");
  s.thread = std::thread([&s] { s.Decode(); });
  if (s.audioOut) {
    s.audioThread = std::thread([&s] { s.DecodeAudio(); });
  }
  return movie;
}

bool HostMovie::CopyFrame(const Planes& planes) {
  State& s = *state_;
  // Movies shown together (the title's three panels) are asked one after
  // another within a game frame: they share one clock reading so they can't
  // fall on different sides of a frame boundary.
  static std::mutex clockMutex;
  static std::chrono::steady_clock::time_point shared;
  auto now = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
  {
    std::lock_guard lock(clockMutex);
    if (now - shared < std::chrono::milliseconds(4)) {
      now = shared;
    } else {
      shared = now;
    }
  }
  if (!s.started) {
    s.started = true;
    s.start = now;
    if (s.audioOut) {
      SDL_ResumeAudioStreamDevice(s.audioOut);
    }
  }
  double time = std::chrono::duration<double>(now - s.start).count();

  std::unique_lock lock(s.mutex);
  // Drop frames whose successor is already due.
  bool dropped = false;
  while (s.queue.size() >= 2 && s.queue[1].time <= time) {
    s.queue.pop_front();
    dropped = true;
  }
  if (dropped) {
    s.wake.notify_all();
  }
  if (s.queue.empty()) {
    if (s.endOfFile) {
      s.finished = true;
    }
    return !s.finished;
  }
  const Frame& frame = s.queue.front();
  int widths[3] = {frame.width, (frame.width + 1) / 2, (frame.width + 1) / 2};
  int heights[3] = {frame.height, (frame.height + 1) / 2, (frame.height + 1) / 2};
  for (int p = 0; p < 3; p++) {
    if (!planes.data[p] || !planes.pitch[p]) {
      continue;
    }
    uint32_t rows = std::min<uint32_t>(heights[p], planes.size[p] / planes.pitch[p]);
    uint32_t bytes = std::min<uint32_t>(widths[p], planes.pitch[p]);
    for (uint32_t y = 0; y < rows; y++) {
      std::memcpy(planes.data[p] + size_t(y) * planes.pitch[p],
                  frame.planes[p].data() + size_t(y) * widths[p], bytes);
    }
  }
  s.lastShown = frame.time;
  // The last frame stays up until the movie's end time has passed.
  if (s.endOfFile && s.queue.size() == 1) {
    double duration = s.format->duration > 0 ? double(s.format->duration) / AV_TIME_BASE : 0.0;
    if (time > std::max(frame.time + 0.1, duration)) {
      s.queue.clear();
      s.finished = true;
    }
  }
  return !s.finished;
}

double HostMovie::ShownTime() const {
  std::lock_guard lock(state_->mutex);
  return state_->lastShown;
}

bool HostMovie::Finished() const {
  return state_->finished;
}

int HostMovie::Width() const {
  return state_->width;
}

int HostMovie::Height() const {
  return state_->height;
}

void HostMovie::SetVolume(float volume) {
  if (state_->audioOut) {
    SDL_SetAudioStreamGain(state_->audioOut, std::clamp(volume, 0.0f, 1.0f));
  }
}

}  // namespace ng2::movie
```

```h
// ng2 - Ninja Gaiden II static recompilation
//
// Movies decoded on the host with FFmpeg, standing in for the XDK's XMedia2
// player (whose WMV decoder needs GPU work the recompilation doesn't
// provide). One HostMovie per player the game creates: a thread decodes the
// file ahead into a short frame queue, and the game pulls the frame that is
// due when it asks (wall clock from its first request) into its own Y/U/V
// textures. Audio, when the game asks for it, goes to its own SDL stream.

#pragma once

#include <cstdint>
#include <filesystem>
#include <memory>

namespace ng2::movie {

class HostMovie {
 public:
  // Opens path; null (and logged) if it can't be played. A looping movie
  // starts over at its end and never finishes.
  static std::unique_ptr<HostMovie> Open(const std::filesystem::path& path, bool audio,
                                         bool loop);
  ~HostMovie();

  struct Planes {
    uint8_t* data[3];     // Y, U, V
    uint32_t pitch[3];    // bytes
    uint32_t size[3];     // bytes available
  };
  // Copies the frame due now into planes. False once the movie has ended.
  bool CopyFrame(const Planes& planes);

  bool Finished() const;
  // The time of the last frame CopyFrame copied (seconds; negative before
  // the first).
  double ShownTime() const;
  int Width() const;
  int Height() const;
  void SetVolume(float volume);

  HostMovie(const HostMovie&) = delete;
  HostMovie& operator=(const HostMovie&) = delete;

 private:
  HostMovie();
  struct State;
  std::unique_ptr<State> state_;
};

}  // namespace ng2::movie
```

`src/movie/movie_hooks.cpp`:

```cpp
// ng2 - Ninja Gaiden II static recompilation
//
// The game's movie player is the XDK's XMedia2 XMV player (library at
// 0x8386xxxx). Its WMV decoder runs part of its work on the GPU and reads
// the results back, which neither renderer provides: movies end at once or
// stall the game (the opening's billboard). So by default the player is
// replaced: creating one opens a HostMovie (FFmpeg) and returns a small
// guest object standing for it, and the method wrappers the game calls (it
// never calls the player's vtable itself) are answered on the host.
// NG2_MOVIES=xmedia keeps the original player; NG2_MOVIE_TRACE=1 logs calls.
//
// What the game uses (from its calls and a trace of the original):
//   create(device, params, &player): params +4 flags (0x8: loop, the
//     opening's billboard), +24 audio stream (-1 none), +32 path
//     ("game:\x.wmv")
//   +72 frame(player, desc): desc +12/+16/+20 Y/U/V addresses (linear L8
//     textures the game created), +24/+28/+32 sizes, +36/+40/+44 pitches;
//     S_OK, or 0x16660026 once the movie has ended
//   +80 render(player, 0, 0): draw the frame to the screen (full-screen
//     movies)
//   +112 status via 83888190(player, out): out[0] < 6 playing
//   +120 audio(player, &voice): the game sets voice+140 to the volume and
//     calls voice->vtbl[+92]
//   +8 release, +96 stop, +92 and 838880A8 at the start of full-screen
//     movies
//
// The original player also allocates physical memory for its frames when
// it is created, before the game creates the textures the frames go to.
// The game depends on that layout: its title movie setup clears a texture
// that, without those allocations, lands on the archive's table of contents
// (0xEBEB0000), and the title's font and sprites then never load. So the
// stand-in makes the same physical allocations (ReservePhysical) and holds
// them until the game releases the player.

#include <atomic>
#include <chrono>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cctype>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <filesystem>
#include <memory>
#include <mutex>
#include <optional>
#include <string_view>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>

#include <rex/hook.h>
#include <rex/logging.h>
#include <rex/runtime.h>
#include <rex/system/xmemory.h>

#include "../gpu/guest.h"
#include "../gpu/video.h"
#include "host_movie.h"
#include "movie.h"
#include "../gameplay.h"

REX_EXTERN(__imp__sub_83835960);  // XMemAlloc(size, attributes)
REX_EXTERN(__imp__sub_838359F8);  // XMemFree(address, attributes)

namespace {

using ng2::guest::Load32;
using ng2::guest::LoadFloat;
using ng2::guest::Virtual;

constexpr uint32_t kEndOfMovie = 0x16660026;
constexpr uint32_t kFail = 0x80004005;  // E_FAIL
// A guest function that returns 0 (li r3,0; blr): every slot of the
// stand-in audio voice's vtable.
constexpr uint32_t kReturnZero = 0x8242C148;
constexpr uint32_t kVoiceVtableSlots = 64;
constexpr uint32_t kVoiceSize = 256;
constexpr uint32_t kObjectSize = 64;

bool TraceEnabled() {
  static const bool enabled = [] {
    const char* v = std::getenv("NG2_MOVIE_TRACE");
    return v && v[0] == '1';
  }();
  return enabled;
}

bool HostMovies() {
  static const bool enabled = [] {
    const char* v = std::getenv("NG2_MOVIES");
    return !(v && std::string_view(v) == "xmedia");
  }();
  return enabled;
}

void Store32(uint32_t address, uint32_t value) {
  *reinterpret_cast<uint32_t*>(Virtual(address)) = rex::byte_swap(value);
}

rex::memory::Memory* GuestMemory() {
  return rex::Runtime::instance()->memory();
}

// Calls a guest function with r3/r4 on the caller's guest stack, leaving
// the caller's registers as they were.
uint32_t CallGuest(PPCContext& ctx, uint8_t* base, void (*function)(PPCContext&, uint8_t*),
                   uint32_t r3, uint32_t r4) {
  PPCContext saved = ctx;
  ctx.r3.u64 = r3;
  ctx.r4.u64 = r4;
  function(ctx, base);
  uint32_t result = ctx.r3.u32;
  ctx = saved;
  return result;
}

struct Player {
  std::unique_ptr<ng2::movie::HostMovie> movie;  // null if the file didn't open
  uint32_t voice = 0;                             // guest stand-in audio voice
  std::vector<std::pair<uint32_t, uint32_t>> reserved;  // (address, attributes)
  bool reportedEnd = false;
  bool blanked = false;  // its planes cleared to black
  std::vector<uint8_t> fullScreen[3];  // a full-screen movie's Y, U, V
};

std::mutex g_mutex;
std::unordered_map<uint32_t, Player> g_players;  // by guest object address
std::filesystem::path g_gameDataRoot;

// "game:\dir\name.wmv" -> <game data root>/dir/name.wmv, each component
// matched case-insensitively like the SDK's host path device (the disc has
// both .wmv and .WMV). Empty if the path leaves the root or isn't found.
std::filesystem::path HostPath(const char* guestPath) {
  std::string_view path(guestPath);
  if (auto colon = path.find(":\\"); colon != std::string_view::npos) {
    path.remove_prefix(colon + 2);
  }
  auto lower = [](std::string text) {
    std::transform(text.begin(), text.end(), text.begin(),
                   [](unsigned char c) { return char(std::tolower(c)); });
    return text;
  };
  std::filesystem::path result = g_gameDataRoot;
  while (!path.empty()) {
    size_t slash = path.find('\\');
    std::string part(path.substr(0, slash));
    path = slash == std::string_view::npos ? std::string_view() : path.substr(slash + 1);
    if (part.empty() || part == ".") {
      continue;
    }
    if (part == "..") {
      return {};
    }
    std::error_code ec;
    std::filesystem::path match;
    for (const auto& entry : std::filesystem::directory_iterator(result, ec)) {
      if (lower(entry.path().filename().string()) == lower(part)) {
        match = entry.path();
        break;
      }
    }
    if (match.empty()) {
      return {};
    }
    result = match;
  }
  return result;
}

// The physical allocations the original player makes when created (traced
// for the 320x580 title movies): control blocks, then three frames of Y, U
// and V with 256-byte aligned pitches. Made even when the movie can't be
// played, since the game's memory layout depends on them.
constexpr int kDefaultWidth = 320, kDefaultHeight = 580;
void ReservePhysical(PPCContext& ctx, uint8_t* base, Player& player, int width, int height) {
  auto align = [](uint32_t value) { return (value + 255) & ~255u; };
  std::vector<std::pair<uint32_t, uint32_t>> blocks = {
      {0x0C, 0xB2800000}, {0x78, 0xB2800000}, {0x60, 0xB5800000},
      {0xB8, 0xB5800000}, {0xB8, 0xB5800000},
  };
  uint32_t lumaSize = align(uint32_t(width)) * uint32_t(height);
  uint32_t chromaSize = align(uint32_t(width + 1) / 2) * uint32_t((height + 1) / 2);
  for (int frame = 0; frame < 3; frame++) {
    blocks.push_back({lumaSize, 0xBC800000});
    blocks.push_back({chromaSize, 0xBC800000});
    blocks.push_back({chromaSize, 0xBC800000});
  }
  for (auto [size, attributes] : blocks) {
    uint32_t address = CallGuest(ctx, base, __imp__sub_83835960, size, attributes);
    if (address) {
      player.reserved.push_back({address, attributes});
    }
  }
}

void FreeReserved(PPCContext& ctx, uint8_t* base, Player& player) {
  for (auto it = player.reserved.rbegin(); it != player.reserved.rend(); ++it) {
    CallGuest(ctx, base, __imp__sub_838359F8, it->first, it->second);
  }
  player.reserved.clear();
}

uint32_t CreateVoice() {
  uint32_t vtable = GuestMemory()->SystemHeapAlloc(kVoiceVtableSlots * 4);
  uint32_t voice = GuestMemory()->SystemHeapAlloc(kVoiceSize);
  if (!vtable || !voice) {
    if (vtable) {
      GuestMemory()->SystemHeapFree(vtable);
    }
    if (voice) {
      GuestMemory()->SystemHeapFree(voice);
    }
    return 0;
  }
  for (uint32_t i = 0; i < kVoiceVtableSlots; i++) {
    Store32(vtable + i * 4, kReturnZero);
  }
  std::memset(Virtual(voice), 0, kVoiceSize);
  Store32(voice, vtable);
  return voice;
}

void FreeVoice(uint32_t voice) {
  if (voice) {
    GuestMemory()->SystemHeapFree(Load32(voice));
    GuestMemory()->SystemHeapFree(voice);
  }
}

// The host player for a guest object, or null if it isn't one.
Player* Find(uint32_t object) {
  auto it = g_players.find(object);
  return it != g_players.end() ? &it->second : nullptr;
}

}  // namespace

namespace ng2::movie {

void SetGameDataRoot(const std::filesystem::path& root) {
  g_gameDataRoot = root;
}

bool AnyPlaying() {
  std::lock_guard lock(g_mutex);
  for (const auto& [object, player] : g_players) {
    if (player.movie && !player.reportedEnd) {
      return true;
    }
  }
  return false;
}

// XMedia2CreateXmvPlayer(device, parameters, &player)
REX_EXTERN(__imp__sub_838886D8);
REX_HOOK_RAW(sub_838886D8) {
  uint32_t params = ctx.r4.u32, out = ctx.r5.u32;
  uint32_t pathAddress = Load32(params) == 1 ? Load32(params + 32) : 0;
  const char* path = pathAddress ? reinterpret_cast<const char*>(Virtual(pathAddress)) : "";
  // Only movies from files are replaced.
  if (!HostMovies() || !pathAddress) {
    __imp__sub_838886D8(ctx, base);
    if (TraceEnabled()) {
      REXLOG_INFO("movie: create '{}' -> {:#x} player {:#x}", path, ctx.r3.u32, Load32(out));
    }
    return;
  }
  uint32_t object = GuestMemory()->SystemHeapAlloc(kObjectSize);
  if (!object) {
    ctx.r3.u64 = kFail;
    return;
  }
  std::memset(Virtual(object), 0, kObjectSize);
  Player player;
  std::filesystem::path hostPath = HostPath(path);
  // Skip Intro: the boot movie's three streams (NinjaVI, _Left, _Right),
  // the first time each opens, aren't opened: they end at their first frame.
  static std::vector<std::string> introOpened;
  std::string name = hostPath.filename().string();
  bool intro = name.starts_with("NinjaVI") &&
               std::find(introOpened.begin(), introOpened.end(), name) == introOpened.end();
  if (intro) {
    introOpened.push_back(name);
  }
  if (intro && ng2::gameplay::SkipIntro()) {
    REXLOG_INFO("movie: '{}' skipped (Skip Intro)", path);
  } else if (hostPath.empty()) {
    REXLOG_ERROR("movie: '{}' not found", path);
  } else {
    player.movie = ng2::movie::HostMovie::Open(hostPath, Load32(params + 24) != 0xFFFFFFFF,
                                               (Load32(params + 4) & 0x8) != 0);
  }
  ReservePhysical(ctx, base, player, player.movie ? player.movie->Width() : kDefaultWidth,
                  player.movie ? player.movie->Height() : kDefaultHeight);
  player.voice = CreateVoice();
  std::lock_guard lock(g_mutex);
  if (TraceEnabled()) {
    REXLOG_INFO("movie: create '{}' -> host player {:#x} ({} reserved blocks)", path, object,
                player.reserved.size());
  }
  g_players[object] = std::move(player);
  Store32(out, object);
  ctx.r3.u64 = 0;
}

// The planes frames were written to lately (physical addresses), for
// IsFrameTexture: a few movies' worth, each with when a frame last went to it
// (a playing movie writes one every frame; a freed plane's address may be a
// later texture's, so an entry counts only while its movie plays).
constexpr size_t kFrameTextures = 12;
constexpr int64_t kFrameTextureMs = 1000;
std::atomic<uint32_t> g_frameTextures[kFrameTextures];
std::atomic<int64_t> g_frameTextureMs[kFrameTextures];
std::atomic<uint32_t> g_frameTextureNext{0};
int64_t NowMs() {
  return std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(
             std::chrono::steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch())
      .count();
}
void NoteFrameTexture(uint32_t address) {
  if (!address) {
    return;
  }
  uint32_t physical = (address & 0x1FFFFFFF) + (address >= 0xE0000000u ? 0x1000u : 0u);
  int64_t now = NowMs();
  for (size_t i = 0; i < kFrameTextures; i++) {
    if (g_frameTextures[i].load(std::memory_order_relaxed) == physical) {
      g_frameTextureMs[i].store(now, std::memory_order_relaxed);
      return;
    }
  }
  size_t i = g_frameTextureNext++ % kFrameTextures;
  g_frameTextureMs[i].store(now, std::memory_order_relaxed);
  g_frameTextures[i].store(physical, std::memory_order_relaxed);
}

namespace ng2::movie {
bool IsFrameTexture(uint32_t physical) {
  int64_t now = NowMs();
  for (size_t i = 0; i < kFrameTextures; i++) {
    if (g_frameTextures[i].load(std::memory_order_relaxed) == physical &&
        now - g_frameTextureMs[i].load(std::memory_order_relaxed) < kFrameTextureMs) {
      return true;
    }
  }
  return false;
}
}  // namespace ng2::movie

// +72: the frame due now into the caller's Y/U/V planes
REX_EXTERN(__imp__sub_836A41A8);
REX_HOOK_RAW(sub_836A41A8) {
  uint32_t object = ctx.r3.u32, desc = ctx.r4.u32;
  {
    std::lock_guard lock(g_mutex);
    if (Player* player = Find(object)) {
      bool playing = false;
      // Black until the first frame (the game's textures start zeroed,
      // which is green in YUV): a movie skipped at once, or not opened.
      if (!player->blanked) {
        player->blanked = true;
        for (int p = 0; p < 3; p++) {
          uint32_t address = Load32(desc + 12 + p * 4);
          if (address) {
            std::memset(Virtual(address), p == 0 ? 16 : 128, Load32(desc + 24 + p * 4));
          }
        }
      }
      for (int p = 0; p < 3; p++) {
        NoteFrameTexture(Load32(desc + 12 + p * 4));
      }
      if (player->movie) {
        ng2::movie::HostMovie::Planes planes;
        for (int p = 0; p < 3; p++) {
          uint32_t address = Load32(desc + 12 + p * 4);
          planes.data[p] = address ? Virtual(address) : nullptr;
          planes.size[p] = Load32(desc + 24 + p * 4);
          planes.pitch[p] = Load32(desc + 36 + p * 4);
        }
        playing = player->movie->CopyFrame(planes);
        if (player->voice) {
          player->movie->SetVolume(LoadFloat(player->voice + 140));
        }
      }
      if (!playing && !player->reportedEnd) {
        player->reportedEnd = true;
        if (TraceEnabled()) {
          REXLOG_INFO("movie: {:#x} ended", object);
        }
      }
      ctx.r3.u64 = playing ? 0 : kEndOfMovie;
      return;
    }
  }
  __imp__sub_836A41A8(ctx, base);
}

// +80: draw the frame to the screen (full-screen movies, such as the attract
// trailer): the renderer shows it instead of the game's picture.
REX_EXTERN(__imp__sub_836A41B8);
REX_HOOK_RAW(sub_836A41B8) {
  {
    std::lock_guard lock(g_mutex);
    if (Player* player = Find(ctx.r3.u32)) {
      bool playing = false;
      if (player->movie) {
        // Decoded into host planes of ours, and shown by the renderer in
        // place of the game's picture.
        uint32_t width = uint32_t(player->movie->Width()), height = uint32_t(player->movie->Height());
        uint32_t pitches[3] = {width, (width + 1) / 2, (width + 1) / 2};
        uint32_t rows[3] = {height, (height + 1) / 2, (height + 1) / 2};
        ng2::movie::HostMovie::Planes planes;
        for (int p = 0; p < 3; p++) {
          player->fullScreen[p].resize(size_t(pitches[p]) * rows[p]);
          planes.data[p] = player->fullScreen[p].data();
          planes.pitch[p] = pitches[p];
          planes.size[p] = uint32_t(player->fullScreen[p].size());
        }
        double before = player->movie->ShownTime();
        playing = player->movie->CopyFrame(planes);
        if (playing && player->movie->ShownTime() != before) {
          const uint8_t* data[3] = {planes.data[0], planes.data[1], planes.data[2]};
          ng2::video::ShowMovieFrame(data, pitches, width, height);
        } else if (playing && player->movie->ShownTime() >= 0.0) {
          ng2::video::KeepMovieShown();
        }
        if (player->voice) {
          player->movie->SetVolume(LoadFloat(player->voice + 140));
        }
      }
      ctx.r3.u64 = playing ? 0 : kEndOfMovie;
      return;
    }
  }
  __imp__sub_836A41B8(ctx, base);
}

// status(player, out): out[0] = state (6 and up: finished), out[1]
REX_EXTERN(__imp__sub_83888190);
REX_HOOK_RAW(sub_83888190) {

// +8: release
REX_EXTERN(__imp__sub_83888098);
REX_HOOK_RAW(sub_83888098) {
  uint32_t object = ctx.r3.u32;
  {
    std::optional<Player> player;
    {
      std::lock_guard lock(g_mutex);
      if (auto it = g_players.find(object); it != g_players.end()) {
        player = std::move(it->second);
        g_players.erase(it);
      }
    }
    if (player) {
      if (TraceEnabled()) {
        REXLOG_INFO("movie: release {:#x}", object);
      }
      player->movie.reset();  // joins the decoder
      FreeReserved(ctx, base, *player);
      FreeVoice(player->voice);
      GuestMemory()->SystemHeapFree(object);
      ctx.r3.u64 = 0;
      return;
    }
  }
  __imp__sub_83888098(ctx, base);
}
```

```h
// ng2 - Ninja Gaiden II static recompilation
//
// Customize your app by overriding virtual hooks from rex::ReXApp.

#pragma once

#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <utility>

#include <rex/cvar.h>
#include <rex/filesystem.h>
#include <rex/input/input_system.h>
#include <rex/rex_app.h>
#include <rex/system.h>
#include <rex/system/gpu_plugin.h>
#include <rex/system/xmemory.h>

#include "controls.h"
#include "aspect.h"
#include "dlc.h"
#include "gameplay.h"
#include "mods.h"
#include "gpu/native_gpu.h"
#include "gpu/video.h"
#include "movie/movie.h"
#include "null_audio.h"
#include "recomp_settings.h"
#include "script_input.h"
#include "stderr_log.h"
#include "windows_setup.h"

class Ng2App : public rex::ReXApp {
 public:
  // Title Update 3's default.xexp, for the World disc (the installers also
  // check its SHA-1: the Japanese release's TU3 has the same size).
  static constexpr uintmax_t kTitleUpdate3Size = 2416640;

  using rex::ReXApp::ReXApp;

  static std::unique_ptr<rex::ui::WindowedApp> Create(
      rex::ui::WindowedAppContext& ctx) {
    return std::unique_ptr<Ng2App>(new Ng2App(ctx, "ng2",
        PPCImageConfig));
  }

  // NG2_CONFIG=<file>: settings file instead of <exe_dir>/ng2.toml (test
  // runs keep away from the player's settings).
  void OnConfigurePaths(rex::PathConfig& paths) override {
#ifdef _WIN32
    // The game folder and Title Update 3 (asked for once), settings and
    // saves in %LOCALAPPDATA%: what the AppImage's launcher does on Linux.
    if (!ng2::windows_setup::ConfigurePaths(paths)) {
      std::_Exit(0);
    }
#endif
    const char* config = std::getenv("NG2_CONFIG");
    if (config && *config) {
      paths.config_path = config;
    }
    ng2::recomp_settings::SetConfigPath(paths.config_path);
    ng2::video::SetPipelineListPath(paths.config_path.parent_path() / "ng2-pipelines.bin");
    ng2::recomp_settings::SetAppContext(&app_context());
    ng2::controls::SetAppContext(&app_context());
  }

  // Game-specific defaults, unless the user set them: the game reads the
  // zero page (from Xenia's compatibility notes for 544307D5), and its
  // system link socket stays off the network (no LAN play here; on Windows
  // it would bring up a firewall prompt).
  void OnPostInitLogging() override {
    ng2::stderr_log::Start();  // the libraries' and the driver's errors into ng2.log
    for (auto [name, value] : {std::pair{"protect_zero", "false"}, {"net_bind_loopback", "true"}}) {
      const auto* info = rex::cvar::GetFlagInfo(name);
      if (info && info->source == rex::cvar::Source::kDefault) {
        rex::cvar::SetFlagByName(name, value);
      }
    }
    ng2::controls::ApplyDefaults();  // keyboard and mouse
  }

  void OnPreSetup(rex::RuntimeConfig& config) override {
    // The native renderer (unless NG2_RENDERER=xenos) draws and presents, and
    // native_gpu.cpp does the rest of what the game's D3D asks of a GPU: no GPU
    // emulation, no GPU plugin.
    if (ng2::video::IsNativeRenderer()) {
      config.gpu_plugin.clear();
      config.graphics = ng2::gpu::CreateNativeGraphicsSystem();
    }

    // Which of the package's two builds runs (src/cpu_handover.cpp), for bug reports.
#if defined(__AVX2__)
    REXLOG_INFO("Ninja Gaiden II Recompiled {}, build: x86-64-v3 (AVX2)", NG2_VERSION);
#else
    REXLOG_INFO("Ninja Gaiden II Recompiled {}, build: x86-64-v2 (SSE4.2)", NG2_VERSION);
#endif

    // NG2_AUDIO=0: run the audio pipeline without an output device.
    const char* audio = std::getenv("NG2_AUDIO");
    if (audio && audio[0] == '0') {
      config.audio_factory = REX_AUDIO_BACKEND(ng2::NullAudioSystem);
      REXLOG_INFO("NG2_AUDIO=0: sound off (no output device)");
    }

    // NG2_PAD_SCRIPT / NG2_PAD_LIVE: a scripted controller for player one.
    if (std::getenv("NG2_PAD_SCRIPT") || std::getenv("NG2_PAD_LIVE")) {
      config.input_factory = [](bool tool_mode) -> std::unique_ptr<rex::system::IInputSystem> {
        auto input = rex::input::CreateDefaultInputSystem(tool_mode);
        if (auto script = ng2::ScriptInputDriver::FromEnvironment()) {
          input->AddDriver(std::move(script));
        }
        return input;
      };
    }
  }

  void OnPostSetup() override {
    // The recompiled code is Title Update 3's. With another update (or none)
    // next to default.xex the game's data wouldn't fit that code.
    std::error_code ec;
    if (std::filesystem::file_size(game_data_root() / "default.xexp", ec) != kTitleUpdate3Size) {
      REXLOG_ERROR("No Title Update 3 default.xexp in {}", rex::path_to_utf8(game_data_root()));
      rex::ShowSimpleMessageBox(rex::SimpleMessageBoxType::Error,
                                "Title Update 3 is missing: its default.xexp must be next to "
                                "default.xex in the game folder.");
      std::_Exit(1);
    }
    ng2::movie::SetGameDataRoot(game_data_root());
    if (ng2::video::IsNativeRenderer() && !ng2::video::CreateHostDevice()) {
      // (half made, nothing could draw: stopped here rather than at the first draw)
      REXLOG_ERROR("native renderer: cannot create the Vulkan device");
      rex::ShowSimpleMessageBox(rex::SimpleMessageBoxType::Error,
                                "Vulkan can't be started on this GPU (the log, ng2.log, says why). "
                                "The game needs a GPU with Vulkan 1.3 drivers.");
      std::_Exit(1);
    }
    ng2::recomp_settings::ApplyWindowAtStart();
  }

  void OnShutdown() override {
    if (ng2::video::IsNativeRenderer()) {
      ng2::video::DestroyHostDevice();
    }
  }

  // Downloadable content from the game folder's dlc/ (installed once).
  void OnPreLaunchModule() override {
    ng2::dlc::InstallPackages(runtime()->kernel_state(), game_data_root(), user_data_root());
  }

  // NG2_DUMP_IMAGE=<path>: write the loaded (decrypted, decompressed) XEX
  // image for offline analysis, e.g. finding code reached only by pointer.
  void OnPostLoadXexImage() override {
    // Aspect Ratio (aspect.cpp) writes the game's 16:9 constant, which sits
    // in read-only image data: its page is made writable.
    auto* heap = runtime()->memory()->LookupHeap(ng2::aspect::kConstantAddress);
    if (!heap || !heap->Protect(ng2::aspect::kConstantAddress, 4,
                                rex::memory::kMemoryProtectRead |
                                    rex::memory::kMemoryProtectWrite)) {
      REXLOG_ERROR("aspect ratio: the game's aspect constant can't be made writable");
    } else {
      ng2::aspect::SetConstantWritable(true);
    }
    // Mods: the folder next to the saves' (the data folder, or userdata/ in
    // portable mode).
    const std::filesystem::path data = user_data_root().parent_path();
    ng2::mods::Activate(data / "mods", game_data_root(), data / "mods-cache");
    const char* path = std::getenv("NG2_DUMP_IMAGE");
    if (!path || !*path) {
      return;
    }
    const uint8_t* image =
        runtime()->memory()->TranslateVirtual<const uint8_t*>(REX_IMAGE_BASE);
    FILE* f = std::fopen(path, "wb");
    if (!f) {
      REXLOG_ERROR("NG2_DUMP_IMAGE: cannot open {}", path);
      return;
    }
    size_t written = std::fwrite(image, 1, REX_IMAGE_SIZE, f);
    std::fclose(f);
    REXLOG_INFO("NG2_DUMP_IMAGE: wrote {} of {} bytes to {}", written,
                REX_IMAGE_SIZE, path);
  }
};
```

`src/null_audio.h`:

```h
// ng2 - Ninja Gaiden II static recompilation
//
// Audio backend with no output device. The game's XAudio engine needs a
// render client that consumes frames at the hardware rate; the SDK's nop
// backend refuses to create one (and its SDL build has no dummy driver), so
// silent runs (NG2_AUDIO=0) use this: frames are dropped and the client
// semaphore is released every 256 samples at 48 kHz, like a sound card would.

#pragma once

#include <atomic>
#include <chrono>
#include <memory>
#include <thread>

#include <rex/audio/audio_driver.h>
#include <rex/audio/audio_system.h>
#include <rex/thread.h>

namespace ng2 {

using rex::X_STATUS;

class NullAudioDriver : public rex::audio::AudioDriver {
 public:
  NullAudioDriver(rex::memory::Memory* memory, rex::thread::Semaphore* semaphore)
      : AudioDriver(memory), semaphore_(semaphore) {
    thread_ = std::thread([this] { Run(); });
  }

  ~NullAudioDriver() override {
    running_ = false;
    thread_.join();
  }

  void SubmitFrame(uint32_t) override {
    // Bounded like the SDL driver's queue; extra frames are dropped.
    if (queued_.load() < kMaxQueued) {
      queued_.fetch_add(1);
    }
  }

 private:
  static constexpr int kMaxQueued = 64;
  // 256 samples per channel at 48 kHz.
  static constexpr auto kFramePeriod = std::chrono::microseconds(5333);

  void Run() {
    auto next = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
    while (running_) {
      next += kFramePeriod;
      std::this_thread::sleep_until(next);
      int queued = queued_.load();
      while (queued > 0 && !queued_.compare_exchange_weak(queued, queued - 1)) {
      }
      if (queued > 0) {
        semaphore_->Release(1, nullptr);
      }
    }
  }

  rex::thread::Semaphore* semaphore_;
  std::atomic<int> queued_{0};
  std::atomic<bool> running_{true};
  std::thread thread_;
};

class NullAudioSystem : public rex::audio::AudioSystem {
 public:
  explicit NullAudioSystem(rex::runtime::FunctionDispatcher* function_dispatcher)
      : AudioSystem(function_dispatcher) {}

  static std::unique_ptr<rex::audio::AudioSystem> Create(
      rex::runtime::FunctionDispatcher* function_dispatcher) {
    return std::make_unique<NullAudioSystem>(function_dispatcher);
  }

 protected:
  X_STATUS CreateDriver(size_t, rex::thread::Semaphore* semaphore,
                        rex::audio::AudioDriver** out_driver) override {
    *out_driver = new NullAudioDriver(memory(), semaphore);
    return X_STATUS_SUCCESS;
  }

  void DestroyDriver(rex::audio::AudioDriver* driver) override { delete driver; }
};

}  // namespace ng2
```

`src/perf_overlay.cpp`:

```cpp
// ng2 - Ninja Gaiden II static recompilation
//
// show_fps: the frame rate and frame time in a corner, drawn as the game's
// own menu text; and the port's version in the title menu's bottom right
// corner, the same way. A text item like the ones on the Options pages (a
// sprite, then a text part: docs/menus.md) lives in guest memory and is
// queued into each frame's 2D lists right after the game starts the frame
// (sub_822F0EF8, which empties them).

#include <algorithm>
#include <atomic>
#include <chrono>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstring>
#include <initializer_list>
#include <string>

#include <fmt/format.h>

#include <rex/cvar.h>
#include <rex/hook.h>
#include <rex/logging.h>

#include "controls.h"
#include "aspect.h"
#include "gpu/guest.h"
#include "gpu/video.h"
#include "recomp_settings.h"

REXCVAR_DEFINE_BOOL(show_fps, false, "Video",
                    "Show the frame rate and frame time in the top left corner");

namespace {

constexpr uint32_t kItemSize = 0x100;   // sprite (0x90), then the text part
constexpr uint32_t kTextPart = 0x90;
constexpr uint32_t kText = 0xC4;        // the part's UTF-16 string
constexpr uint32_t kTextScale = 0xC8;   // x, y
constexpr uint32_t kTextPosition = 0xD0;  // x, y
constexpr uint32_t kTextChars = 32;
constexpr uint32_t kMenuFontSize = 0x1C;  // as the Options rows ask sub_836CEDE8
// From the frame's anchor (about 953, 650 in the 1280x720 UI) to the top
// left corner (left edge, line center).
constexpr float kX = 32.0f - 953.0f, kY = 16.0f - 650.0f;
constexpr uint32_t kLayer = 0x15;  // aspect.cpp keeps this layer's text in the top left corner
constexpr uint32_t kAllocAttributes = 0xB2800000;
// A text frame like the one the Options pages' arrow lists show their value
// in (UI package 0x78's resource 0x2A), from package 0, which is always
// loaded: resource 0xA.
constexpr uint32_t kPackages = 0x85324808;  // 8 bytes per id, +4 the loaded package
constexpr uint32_t kTextPackage = 0, kTextFrame = 0xA;
constexpr uint32_t kTextColor = 0x85371760;  // a focused row's (16 bytes)

uint32_t g_item = 0;  // 0 until made
uint32_t g_resource = 0;  // the item sprite's
// The version in the title menu's bottom right corner, the same kind of item.
uint32_t g_versionItem = 0;
uint32_t g_versionResource = 0;
// (atomic: the title menu's update may run on another thread than the frame start)
std::atomic<uint64_t> g_frameNumber{0};
std::atomic<uint64_t> g_titleMenuFrame{~0ull};  // the last frame the title menu updated in
constexpr float kVersionX = 1150.0f - 953.0f, kVersionY = 684.0f - 650.0f;
std::chrono::steady_clock::time_point g_last;
double g_seconds = 0.0;  // frame times since the text last changed
uint32_t g_frames = 0;
std::u16string g_shown = u"";

void Store32(uint32_t address, uint32_t value) {
  *reinterpret_cast<uint32_t*>(ng2::guest::Virtual(address)) = rex::byte_swap(value);
}
void StoreFloat(uint32_t address, float value) {
  uint32_t bits;
  std::memcpy(&bits, &value, sizeof(bits));
  Store32(address, bits);
}

// Calls a guest function with r3-r6 below the caller's guest stack, leaving
// the caller's registers as they were; returns r3, or f1 through *f1.
uint32_t CallGuest(PPCContext& ctx, uint8_t* base, void (*function)(PPCContext&, uint8_t*),
                   std::initializer_list<uint32_t> args, double* f1 = nullptr) {
  PPCContext saved = ctx;
  ctx.r1.u64 = saved.r1.u32 - 0x200;
  uint64_t* registers[] = {&ctx.r3.u64, &ctx.r4.u64, &ctx.r5.u64, &ctx.r6.u64};
  size_t i = 0;
  for (uint32_t arg : args) {
    *registers[i++] = arg;
  }
  function(ctx, base);
  uint32_t result = ctx.r3.u32;
  if (f1) {
    *f1 = ctx.f1.f64;
  }
  ctx = saved;
  return result;
}

}  // namespace

REX_EXTERN(__imp__sub_83835960);  // XMemAlloc(size, attributes)
REX_EXTERN(__imp__sub_83704630);  // a sprite's constructor
REX_EXTERN(__imp__sub_8242C048);  // a text part's constructor
REX_EXTERN(__imp__sub_836CEDE8);  // the menu font's scale for a size -> f1
REX_EXTERN(__imp__sub_83691AD8);  // a text item into this frame's 2D lists: (item, layer)
REX_EXTERN(__imp__sub_837047E0);  // a sprite's resource: (sprite, resource)
REX_EXTERN(__imp__sub_83704978);  // a sprite's update

namespace {

// A text item at (x, y) from the frame's anchor, or 0.
uint32_t NewTextItem(PPCContext& ctx, uint8_t* base, float x, float y) {
  uint32_t item = CallGuest(ctx, base, __imp__sub_83835960,
                            {kItemSize + kTextChars * 2, kAllocAttributes});
  if (!item) {
    return 0;
  }
  std::memset(ng2::guest::Virtual(item), 0, kItemSize + kTextChars * 2);
  CallGuest(ctx, base, __imp__sub_83704630, {item});
  CallGuest(ctx, base, __imp__sub_8242C048, {item + kTextPart});
  Store32(item + kText, item + kItemSize);
  // Left aligned and centered on its line; +0xF0: placed by its measured size
  // (as the lists' value text is).
  Store32(item + kTextPart + 8, (ng2::guest::Load32(item + kTextPart + 8) & 0xFFFC3FFF) | 0x4000);
  Store32(item + 0xF0, 1);
  StoreFloat(item + kTextPosition, x);
  StoreFloat(item + kTextPosition + 4, y);
  return item;
}

bool MakeItem(PPCContext& ctx, uint8_t* base) {
  g_item = NewTextItem(ctx, base, kX, kY);
  return g_item != 0;
}

// The item's text (ASCII, up to kTextChars - 1).
void SetText(uint32_t item, const std::string& text) {
  uint8_t* chars = ng2::guest::Virtual(item + kItemSize);
  std::memset(chars, 0, kTextChars * 2);
  for (size_t i = 0; i < text.size() && i + 1 < kTextChars; i++) {
    chars[2 * i + 1] = uint8_t(text[i]);
  }
}

// The text frame, while its package is loaded.
uint32_t FindTextFrame() {
  using ng2::guest::Load32;
  uint32_t loaded = Load32(kPackages + 8 * kTextPackage + 4);
  if (!loaded || Load32(loaded + 0x14) < 3) {
    return 0;
  }
  uint32_t list = Load32(Load32(loaded + 0x20) + 8);
  if (!list || Load32(list + 0x14) <= kTextFrame) {
    return 0;
  }
  return Load32(Load32(list + 0x20) + 4 * kTextFrame);
}

// The item queued for this frame in the menu font: its sprite on the text
// frame (while that package is loaded), scaled, coloured as a focused row.
// *resource is the frame the sprite was last set to.
void QueueText(PPCContext& ctx, uint8_t* base, uint32_t item, uint32_t* resource) {
  uint32_t frame = FindTextFrame();
  if (!frame) {
    return;
  }
  if (frame != *resource) {
    *resource = frame;
    CallGuest(ctx, base, __imp__sub_837047E0, {item, frame});
  }
  // The menu font's scale, once its font is loaded.
  double scale = 0.0;
  CallGuest(ctx, base, __imp__sub_836CEDE8, {kMenuFontSize}, &scale);
  if (!std::isfinite(scale) || scale <= 0.0) {
    return;
  }
  StoreFloat(item + kTextScale, float(scale));
  StoreFloat(item + kTextScale + 4, float(scale));
  std::memcpy(ng2::guest::Virtual(item + 0x40), ng2::guest::Virtual(kTextColor), 16);
  CallGuest(ctx, base, __imp__sub_83704978, {item});
  CallGuest(ctx, base, __imp__sub_83691AD8, {item, kLayer});
}

// The version, while the title menu is up.
void VersionFrame(PPCContext& ctx, uint8_t* base) {
  uint64_t menu = g_titleMenuFrame.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
  if (menu == ~0ull || menu + 1 < g_frameNumber.load(std::memory_order_relaxed)) {
    return;
  }
  if (!g_versionItem) {
    g_versionItem = NewTextItem(ctx, base, kVersionX, kVersionY);
    if (!g_versionItem) {
      return;
    }
    SetText(g_versionItem, "v" NG2_VERSION);
  }
  QueueText(ctx, base, g_versionItem, &g_versionResource);
}

}  // namespace

// From the title menu's per-frame update (recomp_settings.cpp's hook of
// sub_8366FBC0): the version is shown while it runs.
void TitleMenuFrame() {
  g_titleMenuFrame.store(g_frameNumber.load(std::memory_order_relaxed), std::memory_order_relaxed);
}

void CheatsFrame();  // cheats.cpp

// The game starting a frame: time it, and queue the text for it.
REX_EXTERN(__imp__sub_822F0EF8);
REX_HOOK_RAW(sub_822F0EF8) {
  __imp__sub_822F0EF8(ctx, base);
  ng2::video::MarkFrameStart();
  CheatsFrame();
  ng2::controls::Frame();
  ng2::recomp_settings::WindowFrame();
  auto now = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
  static const bool logFps = [] {
    const char* v = std::getenv("NG2_FPS_LOG");
    return v && v[0] == '1';
  }();
  static double logSeconds = 0.0;
  static uint32_t logFrames = 0;
  if (g_last != std::chrono::steady_clock::time_point()) {
    double frame = std::chrono::duration<double>(now - g_last).count();
    g_seconds += frame;
    g_frames++;
    // NG2_FPS_LOG=1: the game's frame rate in the log once a second.
    if (logFps) {
      logSeconds += frame;
      logFrames++;
      if (logSeconds >= 1.0) {
        REXLOG_INFO("fps {:.1f}", logFrames / logSeconds);
        logSeconds = 0.0;
        logFrames = 0;
      }
    }
  }
  g_last = now;
  g_frameNumber.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);
  VersionFrame(ctx, base);
  // In gameplay only (the HUD up), not on loading screens and menus.
  if (!REXCVAR_GET(show_fps) || !ng2::aspect::HudShown() || (!g_item && !MakeItem(ctx, base))) {
    return;
  }
  // Averaged over half a second, so it can be read.
  if (g_seconds >= 0.5 || g_shown.empty()) {
    double frameTime = g_frames ? g_seconds / g_frames : 0.0;
    std::string text = frameTime > 0.0 ? fmt::format("{:.0f} FPS  {:.1f} ms", 1.0 / frameTime,
                                                     frameTime * 1000.0)
                                       : std::string("-- FPS");
    g_shown.assign(text.begin(), text.end());
    g_shown.resize(std::min<size_t>(g_shown.size(), kTextChars - 1));
    SetText(g_item, text);
    g_seconds = 0.0;
    g_frames = 0;
  }
  QueueText(ctx, base, g_item, &g_resource);
}

```

`src/recomp_settings.cpp`:

```cpp
// ng2 - Ninja Gaiden II static recompilation
//
// RECOMP SETTINGS: the title menu's Xbox LIVE Marketplace entry opens the
// game's own Options screen as a screen of the recomp's settings
// (docs/menus.md). While it is open:
//
// - The category list holds our categories (their names written over the
//   game's in the loaded string table, the rest blanked) and is run by us:
//   Confirm opens a category's page, Back leaves Options.
// - Each category is one of the game's pages. Its builder runs with its own
//   rows left out, then we append ours: arrow lists for settings with more
//   than two choices (made in place where the page has none), two-choice
//   rows for the others, and Restore Defaults. Our texts go in spare slots
//   of the string table (the Music Test's track names).
// - The pages' handlers are replaced by one that edits our settings, using
//   the game's own input, sound and menu-model functions.
//
// Everything is restored and the settings are saved when Options closes.
// The title menu also loses LEADERBOARDS and gains EXIT GAME here.

uint32_t ShownPage(uint32_t page) {
  for (const Page& p : kPages) {
    if (p.page == page) {
      return ViewOf(p);
    }
  }
  return page;
}

  for (const Page& p : kPages) {
    if (p.page == page) {
      return &p;

  }
  return nullptr;

void PutBack(std::vector<std::pair<uint32_t, std::vector<uint8_t>>>& saved) {
  for (auto it = saved.rbegin(); it != saved.rend(); ++it) {
    std::memcpy(guest::Virtual(it->first), it->second.data(), it->second.size());
  }
  saved.clear();
}
```
