`src/script_input.h`:

```h
// ng2 - Ninja Gaiden II static recompilation
//
// A scripted controller, for driving the game through its menus in test runs
// with nobody at it (the syntax is the NGB test rig's):
//
//   NG2_PAD_SCRIPT=20000:start,24000:a,26000:down,27000:a:400
//
// Each entry is <ms>:<button>[+<button>...][:<hold ms>], with times measured
// from the first time the game reads the pad and a default hold of 150 ms.
// NG2_PAD_SCRIPT=@file reads the same syntax from a file, one entry per line
// or comma separated.
//
// NG2_PAD_LIVE=<file> drives it while the game runs: each line appended to
// the file (<button>[+<button>...][:<hold ms>], no time) is pressed as soon
// as it is read, one after another with a 200 ms release between, so "down"
// then "a" never land in the same poll. Use a regular file appended with >>
// (not a FIFO); what it holds when the game starts is skipped, and it may be
// truncated to start over.
//
// Buttons: up down left right start back lthumb rthumb lb rb a b x y, lt rt
// (triggers fully pressed), lleft lright lup ldown / rleft rright rup rdown
// (a stick at full throw). Times are decimal. Every step is logged as it
// fires; a step whose window passed while the game wasn't reading the pad
// (a load) is pressed late for one read rather than dropped.
//
// The device is synthetic, so it feeds player one alongside any real pad.

#pragma once

#include <algorithm>
#include <cctype>
#include <chrono>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <filesystem>
#include <fstream>
#include <mutex>
#include <sstream>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

#include <rex/input/input.h>
#include <rex/input/input_driver.h>
#include <rex/logging.h>

namespace ng2 {

using rex::X_RESULT;
using rex::X_STATUS;

class ScriptInputDriver : public rex::input::InputDriver {
 public:
  ScriptInputDriver(std::string script, std::string livePath)
      : InputDriver(nullptr, 0), livePath_(std::move(livePath)) {
    Parse(script, nullptr);
    // Lines left from an earlier run are not this run's input.
    std::error_code ec;
    if (!livePath_.empty()) {
      auto size = std::filesystem::file_size(livePath_, ec);
      consumed_ = ec ? 0 : size_t(size);
    }
  }

  // NG2_PAD_SCRIPT / NG2_PAD_LIVE, or nullptr when neither is set.
  static std::unique_ptr<ScriptInputDriver> FromEnvironment() {
    const char* spec = std::getenv("NG2_PAD_SCRIPT");
    const char* live = std::getenv("NG2_PAD_LIVE");
    if ((!spec || !*spec) && (!live || !*live)) {
      return nullptr;
    }
    std::string script = spec ? spec : "";
    if (!script.empty() && script[0] == '@') {
      std::ifstream file(script.substr(1), std::ios::binary);
      if (!file) {
        REXLOG_ERROR("pad: cannot open script {}", script.substr(1));
        script.clear();
      } else {
        std::stringstream text;
        text << file.rdbuf();
        script = text.str();
      }
    }
    auto driver = std::make_unique<ScriptInputDriver>(script, live ? live : "");
    REXLOG_INFO("pad: script of {} step(s){}{}", driver->steps_.size(),
                driver->livePath_.empty() ? "" : ", live input from ",
                driver->livePath_);
    return driver;
  }

  X_STATUS Setup() override { return X_STATUS_SUCCESS; }

  void EnumerateDevices(std::vector<rex::input::DeviceInfo>& out) override {
    rex::input::DeviceInfo info;
    info.id = kDevice;
    info.name = "Script";
    info.synthetic = true;
    out.push_back(info);
  }

  X_RESULT GetDeviceCapabilities(rex::input::DeviceId id, uint32_t,
                                 rex::input::X_INPUT_CAPABILITIES* out) override {
    if (id != kDevice) {
      return X_ERROR_DEVICE_NOT_CONNECTED;
    }
    if (out) {
      std::memset(out, 0, sizeof(*out));
      out->type = 0x01;      // XINPUT_DEVTYPE_GAMEPAD
      out->sub_type = 0x01;  // XINPUT_DEVSUBTYPE_GAMEPAD
      out->gamepad.buttons = 0xFFFF;
      out->gamepad.left_trigger = 0xFF;
      out->gamepad.right_trigger = 0xFF;
      out->gamepad.thumb_lx = int16_t(0x7FFF);
      out->gamepad.thumb_ly = int16_t(0x7FFF);
      out->gamepad.thumb_rx = int16_t(0x7FFF);
      out->gamepad.thumb_ry = int16_t(0x7FFF);
    }
    return X_ERROR_SUCCESS;
  }

  X_RESULT GetDeviceState(rex::input::DeviceId id, rex::input::X_INPUT_STATE* out) override {
    if (id != kDevice) {
      return X_ERROR_DEVICE_NOT_CONNECTED;
    }
    std::lock_guard lock(mutex_);
    auto now = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
    if (!started_) {
      started_ = true;
      start_ = now;
    }
    uint64_t t = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(now - start_).count();
    PollLive(t);

    Pad pad;
    for (auto& step : steps_) {
      bool late = t >= step.at + step.hold;
      // Steps missed in a stall go one at a time, with a release between.
      if (t < step.at || (late && (step.announced || t < lateResume_))) {
        continue;
      }
      if (late) {
        lateResume_ = t + 350;
      }
      if (!step.announced) {
        step.announced = true;
        REXLOG_INFO("pad: t={} ms \"{}\"{}", t, step.text, late ? " (late)" : "");
      }
      pad.buttons |= step.buttons;
      pad.lt = std::max(pad.lt, step.lt);
      pad.rt = std::max(pad.rt, step.rt);
      for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        if (step.axes[i]) {
          pad.axes[i] = step.axes[i];
        }
      }
    }
    // Finished steps go, so a long live session never grows the list.
    std::erase_if(steps_, [t](const Step& s) { return s.announced && t >= s.at + s.hold; });

    if (pad != last_) {
      last_ = pad;
      packet_++;
    }
    if (out) {
      out->packet_number = packet_;
      out->gamepad.buttons = pad.buttons;
      out->gamepad.left_trigger = pad.lt;
      out->gamepad.right_trigger = pad.rt;
      out->gamepad.thumb_lx = pad.axes[0];
      out->gamepad.thumb_ly = pad.axes[1];
      out->gamepad.thumb_rx = pad.axes[2];
      out->gamepad.thumb_ry = pad.axes[3];
    }
    return X_ERROR_SUCCESS;
  }

  X_RESULT SetDeviceVibration(rex::input::DeviceId id, rex::input::X_INPUT_VIBRATION*) override {
    return id == kDevice ? X_ERROR_SUCCESS : X_ERROR_DEVICE_NOT_CONNECTED;
  }

  X_RESULT GetDeviceKeystroke(rex::input::DeviceId id, uint32_t,
                              rex::input::X_INPUT_KEYSTROKE*) override {
    // NG2 only reads XamInputGetState.
    return id == kDevice ? X_ERROR_EMPTY : X_ERROR_DEVICE_NOT_CONNECTED;
  }

 private:
  static constexpr auto kDevice = static_cast<rex::input::DeviceId>(0x4E473250);  // "NG2P"

  struct Pad {
    uint16_t buttons = 0;
    uint8_t lt = 0, rt = 0;
    int16_t axes[4] = {};  // LX LY RX RY, up positive
    bool operator!=(const Pad& o) const {
      return buttons != o.buttons || lt != o.lt || rt != o.rt ||
             std::memcmp(axes, o.axes, sizeof(axes)) != 0;
    }
  };

  // A decimal millisecount, at most ~11 days so sums cannot wrap.
  static bool ParseMs(std::string_view text, uint64_t& out) {
    text = Trim(text);
    if (text.empty() || text.size() > 9) {
      return false;
    }
    uint64_t value = 0;
    for (char c : text) {
      if (c < '0' || c > '9') {
        return false;
      }
      value = value * 10 + uint64_t(c - '0');
    }
    out = value;
    return true;
  }

  static std::string_view Trim(std::string_view text) {
    while (!text.empty() && std::isspace(static_cast<unsigned char>(text.front()))) {
      text.remove_prefix(1);
    }
    while (!text.empty() && std::isspace(static_cast<unsigned char>(text.back()))) {
      text.remove_suffix(1);
    }
    return text;
  }

  struct Step : Pad {
    uint64_t at = 0, hold = 150;
    std::string text;
    bool announced = false;
  };

  static bool AddButton(std::string_view name, Step& step) {
    static constexpr struct {
      const char* name;
      uint16_t bit;
    } kButtons[] = {
        {"up", 0x0001},     {"down", 0x0002},   {"left", 0x0004}, {"right", 0x0008},
        {"start", 0x0010},  {"back", 0x0020},   {"lthumb", 0x0040}, {"rthumb", 0x0080},
        {"lb", 0x0100},     {"rb", 0x0200},     {"a", 0x1000},    {"b", 0x2000},
        {"x", 0x4000},      {"y", 0x8000},
    };
    static constexpr struct {
      const char* name;
      int axis;
      int16_t value;
    } kSticks[] = {
        {"lleft", 0, -32767}, {"lright", 0, 32767}, {"lup", 1, 32767},  {"ldown", 1, -32767},
        {"rleft", 2, -32767}, {"rright", 2, 32767}, {"rup", 3, 32767},  {"rdown", 3, -32767},
    };
    auto same = [name](const char* word) {
      return std::strlen(word) == name.size() &&
             std::equal(name.begin(), name.end(), word, [](char a, char b) {
               return std::tolower(static_cast<unsigned char>(a)) == b;
             });
    };
    for (const auto& b : kButtons) {
      if (same(b.name)) {
        step.buttons |= b.bit;
        return true;
      }
    }
    for (const auto& s : kSticks) {
      if (same(s.name)) {
        step.axes[s.axis] = s.value;
        return true;
      }
    }
    if (same("lt")) {
      step.lt = 0xFF;
      return true;
    }
    if (same("rt")) {
      step.rt = 0xFF;
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  }

  // Entries "<ms>:<buttons>[:<hold>]"; with timeless set, "<buttons>[:<hold>]"
  // scheduled at *timeless. Returns the end of the last parsed step.
  uint64_t Parse(std::string_view text, uint64_t* timeless) {
    uint64_t end = 0;
    size_t pos = 0;
    while (pos < text.size()) {
      size_t next = text.find_first_of(",\r\n", pos);
      if (next == std::string_view::npos) {
        next = text.size();
      }
      std::string_view entry = Trim(text.substr(pos, next - pos));
      pos = next + 1;
      if (entry.empty()) {
        continue;
      }

      Step step;
      step.text = std::string(entry);
      if (timeless) {
        step.at = *timeless;
      } else {
        size_t colon = entry.find(':');
        if (colon == std::string_view::npos || !ParseMs(entry.substr(0, colon), step.at)) {
          REXLOG_WARN("pad: script entry without <ms>: \"{}\"", entry);
          continue;
        }
        entry.remove_prefix(colon + 1);
      }
      size_t colon = entry.find(':');
      if (colon != std::string_view::npos) {
        if (!ParseMs(entry.substr(colon + 1), step.hold) || step.hold == 0) {
          REXLOG_WARN("pad: bad hold time in \"{}\"", step.text);
          continue;
        }
        entry = entry.substr(0, colon);
      }
      bool ok = !Trim(entry).empty();
      while (ok && !entry.empty()) {
        size_t plus = entry.find('+');
        std::string_view name = Trim(entry.substr(0, plus));
        if (!AddButton(name, step)) {
          REXLOG_WARN("pad: unknown button \"{}\"", name);
          ok = false;
        }
        entry = plus == std::string_view::npos ? std::string_view() : entry.substr(plus + 1);
      }
      if (!ok) {
        REXLOG_WARN("pad: step \"{}\" skipped", step.text);
        continue;
      }
      end = step.at + step.hold;
      if (timeless) {
        *timeless = end + 200;
      }
      steps_.push_back(std::move(step));
    }
    return end;
  }

  // Schedule whatever complete lines were appended to the live file since the
  // last poll (at most every 50 ms).
  void PollLive(uint64_t t) {
    if (livePath_.empty() || (lastPoll_ && t - lastPoll_ < 50)) {
      return;
    }
    lastPoll_ = t ? t : 1;
    FILE* file = std::fopen(livePath_.c_str(), "rb");
    if (!file) {
      return;
    }
    // Truncated or replaced by a shorter file: start over from its beginning.
    if (std::fseek(file, 0, SEEK_END) == 0 && size_t(std::ftell(file)) < consumed_) {
      consumed_ = 0;
      pending_.clear();
    }
    if (std::fseek(file, long(consumed_), SEEK_SET) == 0) {
      char buffer[4096];
      size_t n;
      while ((n = std::fread(buffer, 1, sizeof(buffer), file)) > 0) {
        pending_.append(buffer, n);
        consumed_ += n;
      }
    }
    std::fclose(file);
    size_t lineEnd = pending_.find_last_of("\r\n");
    if (lineEnd == std::string::npos) {
      return;
    }
    uint64_t at = std::max(t, liveFree_);
    Parse(std::string_view(pending_).substr(0, lineEnd), &at);
    liveFree_ = at;
    pending_.erase(0, lineEnd + 1);
  }

  std::mutex mutex_;
  std::vector<Step> steps_;
  bool started_ = false;
  std::chrono::steady_clock::time_point start_;
  Pad last_;
  uint32_t packet_ = 1;
  uint64_t lateResume_ = 0;

  std::string livePath_;
  size_t consumed_ = 0;
  uint64_t lastPoll_ = 0;
  uint64_t liveFree_ = 0;
  std::string pending_;
};

}  // namespace ng2
```

`src/stderr_log.cpp`:

```cpp
// ng2 - Ninja Gaiden II static recompilation
//
// Windows: what the libraries print to stderr (plume's Vulkan errors, a failed
// pipeline or image, the GPU driver's, FFmpeg's) goes into ng2.log too: a game
// window has no console, so it would otherwise be lost. stderr becomes a pipe
// read by a thread that logs each line. An identical line is logged 5 times at
// most. (On Linux stderr stays as it is: a terminal or the journal has it, and
// a crash's last message, written just before the process ends, mustn't wait
// in a pipe.)

#include "stderr_log.h"

#include <cerrno>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <thread>
#include <unordered_map>

#include <fcntl.h>

#if defined(_WIN32)
#include <io.h>
#define ng2_pipe(fds) _pipe(fds, 65536, _O_BINARY)
#define ng2_dup _dup
#define ng2_dup2 _dup2
#define ng2_read _read
#define ng2_write _write
#define ng2_close _close
#define ng2_fileno _fileno
#else
#include <unistd.h>
#define ng2_pipe(fds) pipe(fds)
#define ng2_dup dup
#define ng2_dup2 dup2
#define ng2_read read
#define ng2_write write
#define ng2_close close
#define ng2_fileno fileno
#endif

#include <rex/logging.h>
#include <spdlog/spdlog.h>

namespace ng2::stderr_log {

void Start() {
#if !defined(_WIN32)
  return;
#else
  // The logger's own errors (ng2.log can't be written) would go to stderr,
  // into this pipe, from the thread that reads it: dropped instead.
  spdlog::set_error_handler([](const std::string&) {});
  // A window program's stderr has no file behind it: given one first, so its
  // descriptor can be pointed at the pipe.
  if (ng2_fileno(stderr) < 0) {
    if (!std::freopen("NUL", "w", stderr)) {
      return;
    }
  }
  int fd = ng2_fileno(stderr);
  int fds[2];
  if (fd < 0 || ng2_pipe(fds) != 0) {
    return;
  }
  int previous = ng2_dup(fd);  // (the terminal, or nothing)
  std::fflush(stderr);
  if (ng2_dup2(fds[1], fd) < 0) {  // (-1 on failure, on both)
    ng2_close(fds[0]);
    ng2_close(fds[1]);
    if (previous >= 0) {
      ng2_close(previous);
    }
    return;
  }
  ng2_close(fds[1]);
  std::setvbuf(stderr, nullptr, _IONBF, 0);
  int reader = fds[0];
  std::thread([reader, previous] {
    std::unordered_map<std::string, int> seen;
    std::string line;
    char buffer[4096];
    for (;;) {
      int n = int(ng2_read(reader, buffer, sizeof(buffer)));
      if (n < 0 && errno == EINTR) {
        continue;
      }
      if (n <= 0) {
        ng2_close(reader);  // (writers then fail at once instead of blocking)
        return;
      }
      if (previous >= 0) {
        (void)ng2_write(previous, buffer, unsigned(n));
      }
      for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        char c = buffer[i];
        if (c != '\n' && c != '\r') {
          if (line.size() < 2000) {
            line += c;
          }
          continue;
        }
        if (seen.size() >= 4096) {
          seen.clear();  // (lines with addresses or counts in them: counted afresh)
        }
        if (!line.empty() && line.rfind("[*** LOG ERROR", 0) != 0 && ++seen[line] <= 5) {
          REXLOG_WARN("stderr: {}", line);
        }
        line.clear();
      }
    }
  }).detach();  // (runs for the whole game; nothing to join at exit)
#endif
}

}  // namespace ng2::stderr_log
```

`src/storage_prompt.cpp`:

```cpp
// ng2 - Ninja Gaiden II static recompilation
//
// The game's text lookup (sub_837578C8: language, id), hooked:
// - The PC has one storage device, so the game's "Change Storage Device"
//   prompts (Load Game's button line, the Options pages' hints, NINJA
//   CINEMA's) are left out, in every language: for each id the English text
//   is looked at once, and where it holds "@[pad:..] Change Storage Device",
//   that button's segment (from its tag to the next tag) is cut out of the
//   string handed out, where it lies (the table's own copy, so once). Untagged
//   labels of the same words are left alone.
// - RECOMP SETTINGS' texts are given for the ids it uses (recomp_settings.cpp),
//   and its description line's id is replaced.

#include <atomic>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstring>
#include <mutex>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <unordered_map>

#include <rex/hook.h>
#include <rex/ppc/context.h>

#include "gpu/guest.h"

namespace ng2::recomp_settings {
uint32_t RecompText(uint32_t id);
}

namespace {

constexpr uint32_t kEnglish = 1;  // the lookup's languages: 0 Japanese, 1 English, ...
constexpr std::u16string_view kPrompt = u"Change Storage Device";
constexpr std::u16string_view kTag = u"@[";           // any tag
constexpr std::u16string_view kButton = u"@[pad:";    // a button's
constexpr uint32_t kMaxChars = 1024;

char16_t At(const uint8_t* p) {
  return char16_t(p[0] << 8 | p[1]);
}

bool Matches(const uint8_t* p, std::u16string_view text) {
  for (size_t i = 0; i < text.size(); i++) {
    if (At(p + 2 * i) != text[i]) {
      return false;
    }
  }
  return true;
}

// A UTF-16 BE string's length, or kMaxChars if it doesn't end in time.
uint32_t Length(const uint8_t* s) {
  uint32_t length = 0;
  while (length < kMaxChars && At(s + 2 * length) != 0) {
    length++;
  }
  return length;
}

// The button tag ("@[pad:..]") before the prompt in an English string, or
// empty if it has none.
std::u16string PromptTag(const uint8_t* s) {
  uint32_t length = Length(s);
  if (length == kMaxChars) {
    return {};
  }
  for (uint32_t tag = 0; tag + kButton.size() < length; tag++) {
    if (!Matches(s + 2 * tag, kButton)) {
      continue;
    }
    uint32_t close = tag + uint32_t(kButton.size());
    while (close < length && At(s + 2 * close) != u']') {
      close++;
    }
    uint32_t text = close + 1;
    while (text < length && At(s + 2 * text) == u' ') {
      text++;
    }
    if (text + kPrompt.size() <= length && Matches(s + 2 * text, kPrompt)) {
      std::u16string found;
      for (uint32_t i = tag; i <= close && i < length; i++) {
        found += At(s + 2 * i);
      }
      return found;
    }
  }
  return {};
}

// That button's segment cut out of a string at a guest address: from its
// tag to the next tag, a line break or the end.
void CutSegment(uint32_t address, std::u16string_view tag) {
  // (heap only: the image's read-only data can't be written)
  if (address < 0x40000000u || address >= 0xF0000000u ||
      (address >= 0x82000000u && address < 0x90000000u)) {
    return;
  }
  uint8_t* s = ng2::guest::Virtual(address);
  uint32_t length = Length(s);
  if (length == kMaxChars) {
    return;
  }
  for (uint32_t at = 0; at + tag.size() <= length; at++) {
    if (!Matches(s + 2 * at, tag)) {
      continue;
    }
    uint32_t end = at + uint32_t(tag.size());
    while (end < length && At(s + 2 * end) != u'\n' &&
           !(end + kTag.size() <= length && Matches(s + 2 * end, kTag))) {
      end++;
    }
    if (end == length || At(s + 2 * end) == u'\n') {
      // (the last segment: the spaces before it go instead)
      while (at > 0 && At(s + 2 * (at - 1)) == u' ') {
        at--;
      }
    }
    std::memmove(s + 2 * at, s + 2 * end, 2 * (length - end));
    std::memset(s + 2 * (at + length - end), 0, 2 * (end - at));
    return;
  }
}

// Per id: the prompt's button tag in its English text ("": none), found once.
std::mutex g_tagsMutex;
std::unordered_map<uint32_t, std::u16string> g_tags;

}  // namespace

// RECOMP SETTINGS' description line (recomp_settings.cpp): the text id the
// hints' selector asks for instead of its page's (its two description
// lookups, by return address); 0: the game's. (The game's thread only.)
std::atomic<uint32_t> g_descriptionText{0};
void SetDescriptionText(uint32_t id) {
  g_descriptionText.store(id, std::memory_order_relaxed);
}

REX_EXTERN(__imp__sub_837578C8);
REX_HOOK_RAW(sub_837578C8) {
  uint32_t from = uint32_t(ctx.lr);
  if (from == 0x836D6B68 || from == 0x836D6C24) {
    if (uint32_t id = g_descriptionText.load(std::memory_order_relaxed)) {
      ctx.r4.u64 = id;
    }
  }
  uint32_t id = ctx.r4.u32;
  // The English text first (once per id, once it's loaded), for the prompt's
  // tag. (Map nodes stay put: the pointer outlives the lock.)
  const std::u16string* tag = nullptr;
  {
    std::lock_guard lock(g_tagsMutex);
    if (auto it = g_tags.find(id); it != g_tags.end()) {
      tag = &it->second;
    }
  }
  if (!tag) {
    PPCContext saved = ctx;
    ctx.r1.u64 = saved.r1.u32 - 0x200;
    ctx.r3.u64 = kEnglish;
    ctx.r4.u64 = id;
    __imp__sub_837578C8(ctx, base);
    uint32_t english = ctx.r3.u32;
    ctx = saved;
    if (english) {
      std::lock_guard lock(g_tagsMutex);
      tag = &g_tags.try_emplace(id, PromptTag(ng2::guest::Virtual(english))).first->second;
    }
  }
  __imp__sub_837578C8(ctx, base);
  if (tag && !tag->empty() && ctx.r3.u32) {
    CutSegment(ctx.r3.u32, *tag);
  }
  if (uint32_t ours = ng2::recomp_settings::RecompText(id)) {
    ctx.r3.u64 = ours;  // RECOMP SETTINGS' texts, in every language
  }
}
```

`src/windows_setup.cpp`:

```cpp
// ng2 - Ninja Gaiden II static recompilation

#include "windows_setup.h"

#ifdef _WIN32

#include <windows.h>
#include <bcrypt.h>
#include <shlobj.h>
#include <shobjidl.h>

#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <fstream>
#include <memory>
#include <string>
#include <system_error>
#include <vector>

#include <SDL3/SDL.h>
#include <rex/cvar.h>
#include <rex/rex_app.h>

#include "dlc.h"

namespace ng2::windows_setup {
namespace fs = std::filesystem;

namespace {

constexpr const char* kTitle = "Ninja Gaiden II";
// Title Update 3's default.xexp for the World disc (media ID 69F555CB): its
// size (ng2_app.h checks the same) and SHA-1 (the Japanese release's TU3 has
// the same size, and doesn't apply to this disc).
constexpr uintmax_t kTitleUpdate3Size = 2416640;
constexpr uint8_t kTitleUpdate3Sha1[20] = {0xe9, 0xdf, 0x57, 0x87, 0x81, 0x35, 0x5d,
                                           0x9a, 0x25, 0xe1, 0xc0, 0xad, 0xba, 0x8f,
                                           0xbb, 0x85, 0x93, 0x33, 0x45, 0x6a};
constexpr const char* kTitleUpdatePackage = "TU_1A461UL_000000G000000.00000000000O4";

// UTF-8 for SDL and the settings (path::string() is the ANSI code page on
// Windows, and throws for characters it can't hold).
std::string Utf8(const fs::path& path, bool generic = false) {
  std::u8string text = generic ? path.generic_u8string() : path.u8string();
  return std::string(text.begin(), text.end());
}

void Message(const std::string& text, bool error) {
  SDL_ShowSimpleMessageBox(error ? SDL_MESSAGEBOX_ERROR : SDL_MESSAGEBOX_INFORMATION, kTitle,
                           text.c_str(), nullptr);
}

// A question with two buttons: true for the first.
bool Ask(const std::string& text, const char* yes, const char* no) {
  const SDL_MessageBoxButtonData buttons[] = {
      {SDL_MESSAGEBOX_BUTTON_RETURNKEY_DEFAULT, 1, yes},
      {SDL_MESSAGEBOX_BUTTON_ESCAPEKEY_DEFAULT, 0, no},
  };
  SDL_MessageBoxData box = {};
  box.flags = SDL_MESSAGEBOX_INFORMATION | SDL_MESSAGEBOX_BUTTONS_LEFT_TO_RIGHT;
  box.title = kTitle;
  box.message = text.c_str();
  box.numbuttons = 2;
  box.buttons = buttons;
  int chosen = 0;
  return SDL_ShowMessageBox(&box, &chosen) && chosen == 1;
}

fs::path KnownFolder(REFKNOWNFOLDERID id) {
  PWSTR path = nullptr;
  fs::path result;
  if (SUCCEEDED(SHGetKnownFolderPath(id, 0, nullptr, &path))) {
    result = path;
  }
  CoTaskMemFree(path);
  return result;
}

// The shell's file dialog: a folder, or a file; empty if cancelled.
fs::path Pick(bool folder, const wchar_t* title) {
  fs::path result;
  IFileOpenDialog* dialog = nullptr;
  if (FAILED(CoCreateInstance(CLSID_FileOpenDialog, nullptr, CLSCTX_INPROC_SERVER,
                              IID_PPV_ARGS(&dialog)))) {
    return result;
  }
  FILEOPENDIALOGOPTIONS options = 0;
  dialog->GetOptions(&options);
  dialog->SetOptions(options | FOS_FORCEFILESYSTEM | (folder ? FOS_PICKFOLDERS : 0));
  dialog->SetTitle(title);
  IShellItem* item = nullptr;
  if (SUCCEEDED(dialog->Show(nullptr)) && SUCCEEDED(dialog->GetResult(&item))) {
    PWSTR path = nullptr;
    if (SUCCEEDED(item->GetDisplayName(SIGDN_FILESYSPATH, &path))) {
      result = path;
    }
    CoTaskMemFree(path);
    item->Release();
  }
  dialog->Release();
  return result;
}

std::vector<uint8_t> ReadFile(const fs::path& path) {
  std::ifstream file(path, std::ios::binary);
  return std::vector<uint8_t>(std::istreambuf_iterator<char>(file), {});
}

// One file from an STFS package (LIVE, PIRS, CON) at its root, as
// tools/stfs_extract.py does; empty if it isn't there.
std::vector<uint8_t> ExtractFromPackage(const std::vector<uint8_t>& d, const std::string& wanted) {
  constexpr uint32_t kBlock = 0x1000, kPerTable = 0xAA, kPerL1 = 0x70E4;
  if (d.size() < 0x3A0 || (std::memcmp(d.data(), "LIVE", 4) && std::memcmp(d.data(), "PIRS", 4) &&
                           std::memcmp(d.data(), "CON ", 4))) {
    return {};
  }
  auto be32 = [&](size_t at) {
    return uint32_t(d[at]) << 24 | uint32_t(d[at + 1]) << 16 | uint32_t(d[at + 2]) << 8 | d[at + 3];
  };
  uint32_t headerSize = be32(0x340);
  const uint8_t* vd = d.data() + 0x379;
  uint32_t shift = (vd[2] & 1) ? 0 : 1;
  uint32_t tableBlocks = uint32_t(vd[3]) | uint32_t(vd[4]) << 8;
  uint32_t tableStart = uint32_t(vd[5]) | uint32_t(vd[6]) << 8 | uint32_t(vd[7]) << 16;
  uint64_t first = (uint64_t(headerSize) + 0xFFF) & ~uint64_t(0xFFF);
  auto backing = [&](uint32_t b) -> uint64_t {
    uint64_t r = (uint64_t((b + kPerTable) / kPerTable) << shift) + b;
    if (b < kPerTable) {
      return r;
    }
    if (b < kPerL1) {
      return r + (uint64_t((b + kPerL1) / kPerL1) << shift);
    }
    return (uint64_t(1) << shift) + r + (uint64_t((b + kPerL1) / kPerL1) << shift);
  };
  auto offset = [&](uint32_t b) { return first + backing(b) * kBlock; };
  auto hashTable = [&](uint32_t b) {
    uint64_t n = uint64_t(b / kPerTable) * (kPerTable + (1u << shift));
    if (b >= kPerTable) {
      n += uint64_t(b / kPerL1 + 1) << shift;
    }
    if (b >= kPerL1) {
      n += uint64_t(1) << shift;
    }
    return first + n * kBlock;
  };
  auto nextBlock = [&](uint32_t b) -> uint32_t {
    uint64_t e = hashTable(b) + (b % kPerTable) * 0x18;
    if (e + 0x18 > d.size()) {
      return 0xFFFFFF;
    }
    return uint32_t(d[e + 0x15]) << 16 | uint32_t(d[e + 0x16]) << 8 | d[e + 0x17];
  };
  uint32_t b = tableStart;
  for (uint32_t t = 0; t < tableBlocks; t++) {
    uint64_t table = offset(b);
    if (table + kBlock > d.size()) {
      return {};
    }
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < kBlock / 0x40; i++) {
      const uint8_t* e = d.data() + table + i * 0x40;
      uint8_t flags = e[0x28];
      std::string name(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(e), flags & 0x3F);
      bool atRoot = e[0x32] == 0xFF && e[0x33] == 0xFF;
      if (name.empty() || (flags & 0x80) || !atRoot || _stricmp(name.c_str(), wanted.c_str()) != 0) {
        continue;
      }
      if (shift && !(flags & 0x40)) {
        return {};  // fragmented in a two-table package: not supported
      }
      uint32_t size = uint32_t(e[0x34]) << 24 | uint32_t(e[0x35]) << 16 | uint32_t(e[0x36]) << 8 | e[0x37];
      if (size > d.size()) {
        return {};  // can't be in this package
      }
      uint32_t block = uint32_t(e[0x2F]) | uint32_t(e[0x30]) << 8 | uint32_t(e[0x31]) << 16;
      std::vector<uint8_t> data;
      while (data.size() < size) {
        uint64_t at = offset(block);
        if (at >= d.size()) {
          return {};  // truncated
        }
        size_t n = size_t(std::min<uint64_t>(kBlock, d.size() - at));
        data.insert(data.end(), d.begin() + at, d.begin() + at + n);
        block = (flags & 0x40) ? block + 1 : nextBlock(block);
      }
      data.resize(size);
      return data;
    }
    if (shift && tableBlocks > 1) {
      return {};  // a file table over blocks of a two-table package: not supported
    }
    b = nextBlock(b);
  }
  return {};
}

// The game's disc: a disc image (XDVDFS) or a Games on Demand package (the
// header file next to its <name>.data folder of Data#### files), read by
// 2048-byte sector as tools/xdvdfs_extract.py does.
class Disc {
 public:
  static constexpr uint32_t kSector = 2048;

  // Null (and why in *error) if the file is neither.
  static std::unique_ptr<Disc> Open(const fs::path& path, std::string* error) {
    auto disc = std::unique_ptr<Disc>(new Disc());
    std::ifstream file(path, std::ios::binary);
    char head[0x3A0] = {};
    file.read(head, sizeof(head));
    std::error_code ec;
    bool package = !std::memcmp(head, "LIVE", 4) || !std::memcmp(head, "PIRS", 4) ||
                   !std::memcmp(head, "CON ", 4);
    if (package) {
      const auto* h = reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t*>(head);
      fs::path folder = path;
      folder += ".data";
      if (file.gcount() < 0x3A0 || Be32(h + 0x344) != 0x7000 || Be32(h + 0x360) != 0x544307D5 ||
          !fs::is_directory(folder, ec)) {
        *error = "That package isn't Ninja Gaiden II. Choose the Games on Demand package (the "
                 "file next to its .data folder, in 544307D5\\00007000).";
        return nullptr;
      }
      disc->god_ = true;
      disc->enhanced_ = (h[0x379 + 0x18] & 0x40) != 0;
      disc->start_ = uint32_t(h[0x379 + 0x1C]) | uint32_t(h[0x379 + 0x1D]) << 8 |
                     uint32_t(h[0x379 + 0x1E]) << 16;
      // Data0000, Data0001, ...: by number, so a missing one isn't skipped over.
      std::vector<fs::path> names;
      for (auto it = fs::directory_iterator(folder, ec); !ec && it != fs::directory_iterator();
           it.increment(ec)) {
        const auto& entry = *it;
        std::string name = Utf8(entry.path().filename());
        if (name.size() == 8 && name.rfind("Data", 0) == 0 &&
            name.find_first_not_of("0123456789", 4) == std::string::npos) {
          size_t number = std::stoul(name.substr(4));
          names.resize(std::max(names.size(), number + 1));
          names[number] = entry.path();
        }
      }
      if (names.empty()) {
        *error = "The package's .data folder has no Data files.";
        return nullptr;
      }
      for (size_t i = 0; i < names.size(); i++) {
        if (names[i].empty()) {
          char missing[16];
          std::snprintf(missing, sizeof(missing), "Data%04zu", i);
          *error = std::string("The package's .data folder is missing ") + missing + ".";
          return nullptr;
        }
        disc->files_.emplace_back(names[i], std::ios::binary);
      }
      // Where the volume descriptor is tells the layout; a single file
      // carries the package header (0xB000) first.
      if (!disc->enhanced_ && !disc->MagicAt(0x12000) && !disc->MagicAt(0x2000)) {
        disc->extra_ = 0xB000;
      }
    } else {
      disc->files_.emplace_back(path, std::ios::binary);
      bool found = false;
      for (uint64_t base : {0ull, 0x18300000ull, 0xFD90000ull, 0x2080000ull}) {
        disc->base_ = base;
        if (disc->MagicAt(base + 32 * kSector)) {
          found = true;
          break;
        }
      }
      if (!found) {
        *error = "That file isn't a disc image of the game.";
        return nullptr;
      }
    }
    std::vector<uint8_t> volume;
    if (!disc->Read(32, 28, volume) || std::memcmp(volume.data(), kMagic, 20) != 0) {
      *error = "That disc or package can't be read (an unknown layout, or files missing).";
      return nullptr;
    }
    disc->root_sector_ = Le32(volume.data() + 20);
    disc->root_size_ = Le32(volume.data() + 24);
    return disc;
  }

  struct Entry {
    std::string path;  // with '/', UTF-8
    bool directory;
    uint32_t sector;
    uint32_t size;
  };

  // Every file and folder (directory tables are AVL trees of entries); false
  // if a table can't be read or a name isn't safe.
  bool List(std::vector<Entry>& out) {
    budget_ = 100000;  // a damaged directory can't make the walk endless
    table_bytes_ = 0;
    return Walk(root_sector_, root_size_, "", out, 0);
  }

  bool Read(uint32_t sector, size_t size, std::vector<uint8_t>& out) {
    out.resize(size);
    size_t done = 0;
    while (done < size) {
      size_t want = size - done;
      uint64_t at = base_ + uint64_t(sector) * kSector;
      size_t file = 0;
      if (god_) {
        // Sectors are contiguous up to the next hash table: one before
        // every 0x198 sectors, one more before every 0xA1C4 of those.
        constexpr uint64_t kPerL0 = 0x198, kPerL1 = 0xA1C4, kPerFile = 0x14388;
        constexpr uint64_t kFileSize = 0xA290000;
        if (uint64_t(sector) + (enhanced_ ? 2 : 0) < uint64_t(start_) * 2) {
          return false;
        }
        uint64_t block = uint64_t(sector) - uint64_t(start_) * 2 + (enhanced_ ? 2 : 0);
        want = std::min<size_t>(want, (kPerL0 - block % kPerL0) * kSector);
        file = size_t(block / kPerFile);
        block %= kPerFile;
        uint64_t l0 = block / kPerL0 + 1;
        at = block * kSector + (l0 + l0 / kPerL1 + 1) * 0x1000 + extra_;
        if (at >= kFileSize) {
          file += 1;
          at = at % kFileSize + 0x2000;
        }
      }
      if (file >= files_.size()) {
        return false;
      }
      auto& f = files_[file];
      f.clear();
      f.seekg(std::streamoff(at));
      if (!f.read(reinterpret_cast<char*>(out.data() + done), std::streamsize(want))) {
        return false;
      }
      done += want;
      sector += uint32_t((want + kSector - 1) / kSector);
    }
    return true;
  }

 private:
  static constexpr char kMagic[] = "MICROSOFT*XBOX*MEDIA";

  static uint32_t Be32(const uint8_t* p) {
    return uint32_t(p[0]) << 24 | uint32_t(p[1]) << 16 | uint32_t(p[2]) << 8 | p[3];
  }
  static uint32_t Le32(const uint8_t* p) {
    return uint32_t(p[0]) | uint32_t(p[1]) << 8 | uint32_t(p[2]) << 16 | uint32_t(p[3]) << 24;
  }

  bool MagicAt(uint64_t offset) {
    char magic[20] = {};
    auto& f = files_[0];
    f.clear();
    f.seekg(std::streamoff(offset));
    return f.read(magic, 20) && std::memcmp(magic, kMagic, 20) == 0;
  }

  // A name Windows can store as given (no device names, no trailing dot or space).
  static bool SafeName(const std::string& name) {
    if (name.empty() || name == "." || name == ".." || name.back() == '.' || name.back() == ' ' ||
        name.find_first_of("/\\:*?\"<>|") != std::string::npos ||
        std::any_of(name.begin(), name.end(), [](char c) { return (c & 0x80) || c < 0x20; })) {
      return false;
    }
    std::string stem = name.substr(0, name.find('.'));
    for (const char* device : {"CON", "PRN", "AUX", "NUL", "COM1", "COM2", "COM3", "COM4", "COM5",
                               "COM6", "COM7", "COM8", "COM9", "LPT1", "LPT2", "LPT3", "LPT4",
                               "LPT5", "LPT6", "LPT7", "LPT8", "LPT9"}) {
      if (_stricmp(stem.c_str(), device) == 0) {
        return false;
      }
    }
    return true;
  }

  bool Walk(uint32_t sector, uint32_t size, const std::string& prefix, std::vector<Entry>& out,
            int depth) {
    std::vector<uint8_t> table;
    table_bytes_ += size;
    if (depth > 32 || size > (64u << 20) || table_bytes_ > (256ull << 20) ||
        !Read(sector, size, table)) {
      return false;
    }
    // Subfolders are walked after this table is done with (and freed).
    std::vector<Entry> folders;
    std::vector<size_t> stack = {0};
    std::vector<bool> seen(table.size() / 4 + 1);
    while (!stack.empty()) {
      size_t off = stack.back();
      stack.pop_back();
      if (off + 14 > table.size() || seen[off / 4]) {
        continue;
      }
      seen[off / 4] = true;
      const uint8_t* e = table.data() + off;
      uint16_t left = uint16_t(e[0] | e[1] << 8), right = uint16_t(e[2] | e[3] << 8);
      if (left == 0xFFFF) {
        continue;  // padding
      }
      if (--budget_ < 0) {
        return false;
      }
      uint8_t attributes = e[12], length = e[13];
      if (off + 14 + length > table.size()) {
        return false;
      }
      std::string name(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(e + 14), length);
      if (!SafeName(name)) {
        return false;
      }
      Entry entry{prefix.empty() ? name : prefix + "/" + name, (attributes & 0x10) != 0, Le32(e + 4),
                  Le32(e + 8)};
      out.push_back(entry);
      if (entry.directory && entry.size) {
        folders.push_back(entry);
      }
      if (left) {
        stack.push_back(size_t(left) * 4);
      }
      if (right) {
        stack.push_back(size_t(right) * 4);
      }
    }
    table = {};
    for (const auto& folder : folders) {
      if (!Walk(folder.sector, folder.size, folder.path, out, depth + 1)) {
        return false;
      }
    }
    return true;
  }

  bool god_ = false, enhanced_ = false;
  uint32_t start_ = 0, root_sector_ = 0, root_size_ = 0;
  int budget_ = 0;
  uint64_t table_bytes_ = 0;
  uint64_t base_ = 0, extra_ = 0;
  std::vector<std::ifstream> files_;
};

// The shell's progress window, for the long copies.
class Progress {
 public:
  Progress(const wchar_t* title, const wchar_t* line) {
    if (SUCCEEDED(CoCreateInstance(CLSID_ProgressDialog, nullptr, CLSCTX_INPROC_SERVER,
                                   IID_PPV_ARGS(&dialog_)))) {
      dialog_->SetTitle(title);
      dialog_->SetLine(1, line, FALSE, nullptr);
      dialog_->StartProgressDialog(nullptr, nullptr, PROGDLG_NORMAL | PROGDLG_AUTOTIME, nullptr);
    }
  }
  ~Progress() {
    if (dialog_) {
      dialog_->StopProgressDialog();
      dialog_->Release();
    }
  }
  // False once the player pressed Cancel.
  bool Update(uint64_t done, uint64_t total) {
    if (!dialog_) {
      return true;
    }
    dialog_->SetProgress64(done, total);
    return !dialog_->HasUserCancelled();
  }

 private:
  IProgressDialog* dialog_ = nullptr;
};

// The disc's files into dest (a new folder, renamed into place when
// complete): an empty string, or what went wrong.
std::string ExtractDisc(const fs::path& image, const fs::path& dest) {
  std::string error;
  auto disc = Disc::Open(image, &error);
  if (!disc) {
    return error;
  }
  std::vector<Disc::Entry> entries;
  if (!disc->List(entries)) {
    return "That disc or package can't be read (a damaged directory).";
  }
  // The console's system update ($SystemUpdate) isn't the game's.
  std::erase_if(entries, [](const Disc::Entry& e) {
    return _strnicmp(e.path.c_str(), "$SystemUpdate", 13) == 0 &&
           (e.path.size() == 13 || e.path[13] == '/');
  });
  bool game = false;
  uint64_t total = 0;
  for (const auto& e : entries) {
    game |= !e.directory && _stricmp(e.path.c_str(), "default.xex") == 0;
    total += e.directory ? 0 : e.size;
  }
  if (!game) {
    return "There's no default.xex on that disc.";
  }
  std::error_code ec;
  fs::path part = dest;
  part += ".part";
  fs::remove_all(part, ec);
  fs::create_directories(part, ec);
  auto space = fs::space(part, ec);
  if (!ec && space.available < total + (256ull << 20)) {
    fs::remove_all(part, ec);
    return "Not enough free space in " + Utf8(dest.parent_path()) + ": the game needs " +
           std::to_string((total >> 30) + 1) + " GB.";
  }
  Progress progress(L"Ninja Gaiden II", L"Copying the game from the disc...");
  uint64_t done = 0;
  std::vector<uint8_t> chunk;
  std::ofstream out;
  auto fail = [&](std::string why) {
    out.close();  // an open file can't be removed
    fs::remove_all(part, ec);
    return why;
  };
  for (const auto& e : entries) {
    fs::path to = part / fs::path(std::u8string(e.path.begin(), e.path.end()));
    if (e.directory) {
      fs::create_directories(to, ec);
      continue;
    }
    fs::create_directories(to.parent_path(), ec);
    out.open(to, std::ios::binary);
    constexpr uint32_t kChunk = 4u << 20;
    for (uint64_t at = 0; at < e.size; at += kChunk) {
      uint32_t n = uint32_t(std::min<uint64_t>(kChunk, e.size - at));
      if (!disc->Read(e.sector + uint32_t(at / Disc::kSector), n, chunk)) {
        return fail("That disc or package can't be read (" + e.path + ").");
      }
      if (!out.write(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(chunk.data()), n)) {
        return fail("Can't write to " + Utf8(part) + ".");
      }
      done += n;
      if (!progress.Update(done, total)) {
        return fail("cancel");
      }
    }
    out.close();
    if (!out) {
      return fail("Can't write to " + Utf8(part) + ".");
    }
  }
  // The new copy replaces the old one, which is set aside first and only
  // deleted once its downloadable content and title update are moved over.
  fs::path old = dest;
  old += ".old";
  // One left by a swap that failed halfway: its content first.
  for (const char* keep : {"dlc", "default.xexp"}) {
    if (!fs::exists(dest / keep, ec) && fs::exists(old / keep, ec)) {
      fs::rename(old / keep, part / keep, ec);
    }
  }
  fs::remove_all(old, ec);
  if (fs::exists(dest, ec)) {
    fs::rename(dest, old, ec);
    if (ec) {
      return fail("Can't replace " + Utf8(dest) + ": close what has it open and try again.");
    }
  }
  fs::rename(part, dest, ec);
  if (ec) {
    std::error_code back;
    fs::rename(old, dest, back);
    return fail("Can't write to " + Utf8(dest) + ".");
  }
  bool kept = true;
  for (const char* keep : {"dlc", "default.xexp"}) {
    if (fs::exists(old / keep, ec)) {
      fs::rename(old / keep, dest / keep, ec);
      kept &= !ec;
    }
  }
  if (kept) {
    fs::remove_all(old, ec);
  }
  return {};
}

// Downloadable content, offered once: the packages in a chosen folder (at any
// depth, as the console keeps them) copied into the game folder's dlc\,
// which the game installs from at start.
void OfferDlc(const fs::path& data, const fs::path& game) {
  fs::path asked = data / "dlc_asked";
  std::error_code ec;
  if (fs::exists(asked, ec)) {
    return;
  }
  bool add = Ask("Add downloadable content? Choose the folder with the packages (for example "
                 "544307D5\\00000002). You can also put them in the dlc folder inside the game "
                 "folder later.",
                 "Add DLC", "Skip");
  std::ofstream(asked) << "1\n";  // answered: not asked again
  if (!add) {
    return;
  }
  fs::path from = Pick(true, L"The folder with the downloadable content");
  if (from.empty()) {
    return;
  }
  // One of each name, none from the game's own dlc folder. Only files that
  // can be packages are opened (no extension, 40 KB or more), and Windows'
  // own folders are passed over, so a whole drive is quick to search.
  std::vector<fs::path> packages;
  std::wstring target = fs::weakly_canonical(game / "dlc", ec).wstring() + L"\\";
  constexpr const wchar_t* kSkip[] = {L"Windows", L"Program Files", L"Program Files (x86)",
                                      L"ProgramData", L"AppData", L"$Recycle.Bin",
                                      L"System Volume Information", L"node_modules", L".git"};
  // Folder by folder: one that can't be listed (access denied, a drive with
  // no disc, a cloud placeholder) is passed over and the rest still searched.
  std::vector<fs::path> folders = {from};
  while (!folders.empty()) {
    fs::path folder = std::move(folders.back());
    folders.pop_back();
    std::error_code le;
    for (auto it = fs::directory_iterator(folder, le); !le && it != fs::directory_iterator();
         it.increment(le)) {
      std::error_code fe;
      const fs::path& path = it->path();
      if (it->is_directory(fe)) {
        std::wstring name = path.filename().wstring();
        bool skip = it->is_symlink(fe) || std::any_of(std::begin(kSkip), std::end(kSkip),
                                                      [&](const wchar_t* s) {
                                                        return _wcsicmp(name.c_str(), s) == 0;
                                                      });
        if (!skip) {
          folders.push_back(path);
        }
        continue;
      }
      if (!it->is_regular_file(fe) || path.has_extension() || it->file_size(fe) < 0xA000 ||
          !dlc::IsGameDlc(path)) {
        continue;
      }
      std::wstring where = fs::weakly_canonical(path, fe).wstring();
      if (_wcsnicmp(where.c_str(), target.c_str(), target.size()) == 0) {
        continue;
      }
      bool seen = std::any_of(packages.begin(), packages.end(), [&](const fs::path& p) {
        return _wcsicmp(p.filename().c_str(), path.filename().c_str()) == 0;
      });
      if (!seen) {
        packages.push_back(path);
      }
    }
  }
  if (packages.empty()) {
    Message("There's no downloadable content for this game in " + Utf8(from) + ".", true);
    return;
  }
  fs::create_directories(game / "dlc", ec);
  int copied = 0;
  for (const auto& package : packages) {
    if (fs::copy_file(package, game / "dlc" / package.filename(),
                      fs::copy_options::overwrite_existing, ec)) {
      copied++;
    }
  }
  if (copied < int(packages.size())) {
    Message("Can't copy the downloadable content to " + Utf8(game / "dlc") + ".", true);
  }
}

bool IsGameFolder(const fs::path& dir) {
  std::error_code ec;
  return !dir.empty() && fs::is_regular_file(dir / "default.xex", ec);
}

// Whether these bytes are Title Update 3's default.xexp (Windows' own SHA-1).
bool IsTitleUpdate3(const std::vector<uint8_t>& xexp) {
  if (xexp.size() != kTitleUpdate3Size) {
    return false;
  }
  uint8_t digest[20] = {};
  BCRYPT_ALG_HANDLE sha1 = nullptr;
  bool ok = BCRYPT_SUCCESS(BCryptOpenAlgorithmProvider(&sha1, BCRYPT_SHA1_ALGORITHM, nullptr, 0)) &&
            BCRYPT_SUCCESS(BCryptHash(sha1, nullptr, 0, const_cast<PUCHAR>(xexp.data()),
                                      ULONG(xexp.size()), digest, sizeof(digest)));
  if (sha1) {
    BCryptCloseAlgorithmProvider(sha1, 0);
  }
  return ok && std::memcmp(digest, kTitleUpdate3Sha1, sizeof(digest)) == 0;
}

// Title Update 3 next to default.xex: asked for once (its package, or an
// extracted default.xexp) and written there, over an older update.
bool EnsureTitleUpdate(const fs::path& game) {
  std::error_code ec;
  if (fs::file_size(game / "default.xexp", ec) == kTitleUpdate3Size &&
      IsTitleUpdate3(ReadFile(game / "default.xexp"))) {
    return true;
  }
  Message(std::string("This port runs the game with Title Update 3 (for the World release, media "
                      "ID 69F555CB). Choose the update: its package (") +
              kTitleUpdatePackage + ") or an extracted default.xexp.",
          false);
  fs::path update = Pick(false, L"Title Update 3 (package or default.xexp)");
  if (update.empty()) {
    return false;
  }
  constexpr uintmax_t kMaxPackage = 64ull << 20;  // the update is a few MB
  constexpr const char* kWrong =
      "That isn't Title Update 3 for this disc (the World release's: TU_1A461UL_000000G000000."
      "00000000000O4).";
  if (fs::file_size(update, ec) > kMaxPackage || ec) {
    Message(kWrong, true);
    return false;
  }
  std::vector<uint8_t> file = ReadFile(update);
  std::vector<uint8_t> xexp = file.size() >= 4 && std::memcmp(file.data(), "XEX2", 4) == 0
                                  ? file
                                  : ExtractFromPackage(file, "default.xexp");
  if (!IsTitleUpdate3(xexp)) {
    Message(kWrong, true);
    return false;
  }
  fs::path part = game / "default.xexp.part";
  bool written = false;
  {
    std::ofstream out(part, std::ios::binary);
    written = out.write(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(xexp.data()), std::streamsize(xexp.size())) &&
              out.flush();
  }
  if (written) {
    fs::rename(part, game / "default.xexp", ec);
  }
  if (!written || ec) {
    fs::remove(part, ec);
    Message("Can't write to " + Utf8(game) + ": copy default.xexp there yourself.", true);
    return false;
  }
  return true;
}

}  // namespace

bool ConfigurePaths(rex::PathConfig& paths) {
  // The file dialogs and progress window are COM objects.
  CoInitializeEx(nullptr, COINIT_APARTMENTTHREADED | COINIT_DISABLE_OLE1DDE);
  fs::path data = KnownFolder(FOLDERID_LocalAppData) / "NinjaGaiden2";
  std::error_code ec;
  // Portable mode: with portable.txt next to ng2.exe, everything (settings,
  // saves, the log, a copied game) goes in a userdata folder next to it. The
  // first start offers it when that folder can be written (not under
  // Program Files).
  wchar_t exe[MAX_PATH] = {};
  GetModuleFileNameW(nullptr, exe, MAX_PATH);
  fs::path beside = fs::path(exe).parent_path();
  // (a Normal answer is kept as portable_asked in the usual folder)
  bool firstStart = !fs::exists(data / "game_dir.txt", ec) && !fs::exists(data / "portable_asked", ec) &&
                    !fs::exists(beside / "portable.txt", ec);
  if (firstStart && !std::getenv("NG2_CONFIG")) {
    fs::path probe = beside / "portable.probe";
    bool writable = std::ofstream(probe).good();
    fs::remove(probe, ec);
    if (writable &&
        Ask("Keep the settings, saves and the installed game in a userdata folder next to ng2.exe ("
                + Utf8(beside) + "), instead of in your user folder?",
            "Portable", "Normal")) {
      std::ofstream(beside / "portable.txt");
    } else {
      fs::create_directories(data, ec);
      std::ofstream(data / "portable_asked");
    }
  }
  if (fs::exists(beside / "portable.txt", ec)) {
    data = beside / "userdata";
  }
  fs::create_directories(data / "user", ec);

  // Settings, saves and the log in %LOCALAPPDATA% (the program's folder may
  // not be writable), unless given.
  const char* config = std::getenv("NG2_CONFIG");
  if (!config || !*config) {
    paths.config_path = data / "ng2.toml";
  }
  auto given = [](const char* name) {
    const auto* info = rex::cvar::GetFlagInfo(name);
    return info && info->source != rex::cvar::Source::kDefault;
  };
  if (!given("user_data_root")) {
    paths.user_data_root = data / "user";
  }
  if (!given("cache_root")) {
    paths.cache_root = data / "cache";
  }
  const auto* logFile = rex::cvar::GetFlagInfo("log_file");
  if (logFile && logFile->source == rex::cvar::Source::kDefault) {
    // Forward slashes: the settings file is TOML, where a backslash escapes.
    rex::cvar::SetFlagByName("log_file", Utf8(data / "ng2.log", true));
  }

  // The game folder: given, remembered, or asked for. The setup's own folder
  // (remembered or chosen) gets the downloadable content question; one given
  // on the command line (a launcher, a test run) has its dlc folder for that.
  fs::path remembered = data / "game_dir.txt";
  bool from_setup = false;
  if (!given("game_data_root")) {
    std::ifstream in(remembered);
    std::string line;
    if (std::getline(in, line)) {
      paths.game_data_root = fs::path(std::u8string(line.begin(), line.end()));
      from_setup = true;
      // The copy in the data folder, where the remembered folder is gone (a
      // portable folder moved, a drive given another letter).
      if (!IsGameFolder(paths.game_data_root) && IsGameFolder(data / "game")) {
        paths.game_data_root = data / "game";
        std::ofstream(remembered, std::ios::trunc) << Utf8(paths.game_data_root) << '\n';
      }
    }
  }
  if (!IsGameFolder(paths.game_data_root)) {
    Message("Choose your copy of the game: a disc image (.iso), the Games on Demand package "
            "(the file in 544307D5\\00007000, next to its .data folder), or default.xex in an "
            "extracted copy. A disc image or package is copied into " +
                Utf8(data / "game") + ".",
            false);
    fs::path chosen = Pick(false, L"The game: disc image, Games on Demand package or default.xex");
    if (chosen.empty()) {
      return false;
    }
    if (_wcsicmp(chosen.filename().c_str(), L"default.xex") == 0) {
      chosen = chosen.parent_path();
    } else {
      std::string error = ExtractDisc(chosen, data / "game");
      if (error == "cancel") {
        return false;
      }
      if (!error.empty()) {
        Message(error, true);
        return false;
      }
      chosen = data / "game";
    }
    if (!IsGameFolder(chosen)) {
      Message("There's no default.xex in " + Utf8(chosen) + ".", true);
      return false;
    }
    paths.game_data_root = chosen;
    std::ofstream(remembered) << Utf8(chosen) << '\n';
    from_setup = true;
  }
  if (!EnsureTitleUpdate(paths.game_data_root)) {
    return false;
  }
  if (from_setup) {
    OfferDlc(data, paths.game_data_root);
  }
  return true;
}

}  // namespace ng2::windows_setup

#endif  // _WIN32
```

`tools/callgraph.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Query the call graph of the generated code.

usage: callgraph.py <generated_dir> callers <addr>...
       callgraph.py <generated_dir> callees <addr>...
       callgraph.py <generated_dir> imports <addr>...   (kernel imports called)
       callgraph.py <generated_dir> asm <addr>          (instruction comments)
       callgraph.py <generated_dir> users <import>      (functions calling an import)

Addresses are hex without 0x. The index is cached next to the generated code.
"""
import glob
import json
import os
import re
import sys

FN = re.compile(r"DEFINE_REX_FUNC\((?:sub|rexcrt)_([0-9A-Fa-f]{8})\)")
CALL = re.compile(r"\b(sub_[0-9A-F]{8}|__imp__\w+|rexcrt_\w+)\(ctx")


def build(gen_dir):
    funcs = {}
    for path in sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(gen_dir, "*_recomp.*.cpp"))):
        cur = None
        with open(path) as f:
            for i, line in enumerate(f, 1):
                m = FN.search(line)
                if m:
                    cur = m.group(1).upper()
                    funcs[cur] = {"file": os.path.basename(path), "line": i,
                                  "calls": [], "n": 0}
                    continue
                if cur is None:
                    continue
                s = line.strip()
                if s.startswith("// "):
                    funcs[cur]["n"] += 1
                for c in CALL.findall(line):
                    if c not in funcs[cur]["calls"]:
                        funcs[cur]["calls"].append(c)
    return funcs


def load(gen_dir):
    cache = os.path.join(gen_dir, ".callgraph.json")
    stamp = os.path.join(gen_dir, "codegen.stamp")
    if os.path.exists(cache) and (not os.path.exists(stamp) or
                                  os.path.getmtime(cache) > os.path.getmtime(stamp)):
        with open(cache) as f:
            return json.load(f)
    funcs = build(gen_dir)
    with open(cache, "w") as f:
        json.dump(funcs, f)
    return funcs


def asm(gen_dir, funcs, addr):
    info = funcs[addr]
    out = []
    with open(os.path.join(gen_dir, info["file"])) as f:
        for i, line in enumerate(f, 1):
            if i < info["line"]:
                continue
            if i > info["line"] and line.startswith("}"):
                break
            s = line.strip()
            if s.startswith("// ") or s.startswith("loc_"):
                out.append(s[3:] if s.startswith("// ") else s)
    return out


def main():
    if len(sys.argv) < 4:
        raise SystemExit(__doc__)
    gen_dir, cmd, args = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], [a.upper() for a in sys.argv[3:]]
    funcs = load(gen_dir)
    if cmd == "callees":
        for a in args:
            print(a, funcs[a]["n"], " ".join(funcs[a]["calls"]))
    elif cmd == "imports":
        for a in args:
            print(a, " ".join(c for c in funcs[a]["calls"] if c.startswith("__imp__")))
    elif cmd == "callers":
        for a in args:
            who = sorted(k for k, v in funcs.items() if "sub_" + a in v["calls"])
            print(a, len(who), " ".join(who))
    elif cmd == "users":
        name = "__imp__" + sys.argv[3]
        print(" ".join(sorted(k for k, v in funcs.items() if name in v["calls"])))
    elif cmd == "asm":
        print("\n".join(asm(gen_dir, funcs, args[0])))
    else:
        raise SystemExit(__doc__)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

`tools/collect_pipelines.sh`:

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# The packaged pipeline seed (packaging/ng2-pipelines-seed.bin): headless test runs through
# Chapter 1 and Mission Mode, fighting, each recording the pipelines it makes, merged.
#
# usage: tools/collect_pipelines.sh <out_dir> [missions, e.g. "1 2 3" (default 1-12)]
#   JOBS=<n>   runs at a time (default 3)
# Needs the DLC installed in game_files/dlc (Mission Mode). The seed is recorded at the default
# 2x antialiasing; the game moves its multisampled pipelines to the player's setting.
set -euo pipefail

root=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)
out=$(realpath -m "${1:?out dir}")
missions=${2:-$(seq 1 12)}
jobs=${JOBS:-3}
mkdir -p "$out"

# Fighting for <seconds> from <ms>: quick and strong attacks, shuriken, ninpo, jumps.
fight() {
  local from=$1 to=$2 s="" t i=0
  local buttons=(x x y x b y rb x a y)
  for ((t = from; t < to; t += 600)); do
    s="$s,$t:${buttons[i++ % ${#buttons[@]}]}"
  done
  printf '%s' "$s"
}

run() {  # run <name> <seconds> <pad script>
  local dir=$out/$1
  rm -rf "$dir"
  NG2_PAD_SCRIPT="${3#,}" "$root/tools/run-headless.sh" "$2" "$dir" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  echo "$1: $(( ($(stat -c %s "$dir/ng2-pipelines.bin" 2>/dev/null || echo 12) - 12) / 96 )) pipelines"
}

# Chapter 1: New Game to the first fight, fighting (AGENTS.md's route).
story="30000:start,34000:a,37000:a,40000:a,58000:a,63000:a,80000:a,262000:a,280000:a"
run chapter1 400 "$story$(fight 285000 395000)" &

# Mission Mode: title, MISSIONS (two down), the mission's place in the 4x3 grid, then A
# until it starts (its stage loads behind the costume choice), then fighting.
for m in $missions; do
  while [ "$(jobs -rp | wc -l)" -ge "$jobs" ]; do sleep 5; done
  i=$((m - 1)) s="30000:start,34000:down,35000:down,36000:a" t=39000
  for ((r = 0; r < (i % 12) / 4; r++)); do s="$s,$t:down"; t=$((t + 700)); done
  for ((c = 0; c < i % 4; c++)); do s="$s,$t:right"; t=$((t + 700)); done
  for ((t = t + 1000; t < 112000; t += 2000)); do s="$s,$t:a"; done
  run "mission$(printf %02d "$m")" 230 "$s$(fight 115000 225000)" &
done
wait

python3 -I "$root/tools/merge_pipelines.py" "$out/ng2-pipelines-seed.bin" "$out"/*/ng2-pipelines.bin
```

`tools/dump_image/main.cpp`:

```cpp
// ng2 - Ninja Gaiden II static recompilation
//
// Writes the loaded (decrypted, decompressed) image of a XEX, without running
// it. The build feeds it to XenosRecomp, which finds the shaders in it.
//
// usage: ng2_dump_image <game_dir> <xex file name> <output file>

#include <cstdio>
#include <string>

#include <rex/kernel/init.h>
#include <rex/runtime.h>
#include <rex/system/kernel_state.h>
#include <rex/system/user_module.h>
#include <rex/system/xex_module.h>
#include <rex/system/xmemory.h>

using rex::X_STATUS;

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
  if (argc != 4) {
    std::fprintf(stderr, "usage: %s <game_dir> <xex file name> <output file>\n", argv[0]);
    return 2;
  }

  auto runtime = std::make_unique<rex::Runtime>(argv[1]);
  auto status = runtime->Setup(rex::RuntimeConfig{
      .kernel_init = rex::kernel::InitializeKernel,
      .tool_mode = true,
  });
  if (status != X_STATUS_SUCCESS) {
    std::fprintf(stderr, "runtime setup failed: %08X\n", status);
    return 1;
  }

  status = runtime->LoadXexImage(std::string("game:\\") + argv[2]);
  if (status != X_STATUS_SUCCESS) {
    std::fprintf(stderr, "cannot load %s: %08X\n", argv[2], status);
    return 1;
  }

  auto* xex = runtime->kernel_state()->GetExecutableModule()->xex_module();
  uint32_t base = xex->base_address();
  uint32_t size = xex->image_size();
  const uint8_t* image = runtime->memory()->TranslateVirtual<const uint8_t*>(base);

  FILE* f = std::fopen(argv[3], "wb");
  if (!f || std::fwrite(image, 1, size, f) != size) {
    std::fprintf(stderr, "cannot write %s\n", argv[3]);
    return 1;
  }
  std::fclose(f);
  std::printf("%s: image %08X-%08X written to %s\n", argv[2], base, base + size, argv[3]);
  return 0;
}
```

`tools/extract_shaders.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Write each Xbox 360 shader container in an image to its own file.

usage: extract_shaders.py <image.bin> <out_dir>

Input is an image dumped with NG2_DUMP_IMAGE. Uses the same container test as
XenosRecomp's directory scan. Files are named <guest address>_<vs|ps>.bin.
"""
import os
import struct
import sys

IMAGE_BASE = 0x82000000


def containers(img):
    i = 0
    while i + 0x24 <= len(img):
        flags, virtual_size, physical_size = struct.unpack_from(">III", img, i)
        size = virtual_size + physical_size
        field1c, field20 = struct.unpack_from(">II", img, i + 0x1C)
        if ((flags & 0xFFFFFF00) == 0x102A1100 and 0 < size <= len(img) - i
                and field1c == 0 and field20 == 0):
            yield i, flags & 0xFF, img[i:i + size]
            i += size
        else:
            i += 4


def main():
    if len(sys.argv) != 3:
        raise SystemExit(__doc__)
    img = open(sys.argv[1], "rb").read()
    out = sys.argv[2]
    os.makedirs(out, exist_ok=True)
    count = {0: 0, 1: 0}
    for off, kind, data in containers(img):
        name = f"{IMAGE_BASE + off:08X}_{'vs' if kind == 1 else 'ps'}.bin"
        with open(os.path.join(out, name), "wb") as f:
            f.write(data)
        count[kind] = count.get(kind, 0) + 1
    print(f"{count[1]} vertex, {count[0]} pixel shaders -> {out}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

```

`tools/find_dlc.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Print this game's downloadable content packages under a folder, at any
depth (STFS LIVE/PIRS/CON packages of content type 2 for title 544307D5),
one path per line. Only files that can be packages are opened (no extension,
40 KB or more), and system folders are passed over, so a whole drive is quick
to search.

usage: find_dlc.py <folder>
"""
import os
import struct
import sys

TITLE_ID = 0x544307D5
MARKETPLACE_CONTENT = 2
# System folders at the top of a drive (/run and /var stay: USB drives mount
# under /run/media, and some systems keep home in /var/home), and anywhere.
SKIP_TOP = {"proc", "sys", "dev", "usr", "lib", "lib64", "bin", "sbin", "etc", "boot", "snap",
            "windows", "program files", "program files (x86)", "programdata"}
SKIP = {".cache", ".git", "node_modules", "$recycle.bin", "system volume information"}


def is_dlc(path):
    try:
        with open(path, "rb") as f:
            h = f.read(0x364)
    except OSError:
        return False
    return (len(h) == 0x364 and h[:4] in (b"LIVE", b"PIRS", b"CON ")
            and struct.unpack_from(">I", h, 0x344)[0] == MARKETPLACE_CONTENT
            and struct.unpack_from(">I", h, 0x360)[0] == TITLE_ID)


def main():
    if len(sys.argv) != 2:
        raise SystemExit(__doc__)
    top = os.path.realpath(sys.argv[1])
    for root, dirs, files in os.walk(top):
        drive = os.path.dirname(root) == root or os.path.ismount(root)
        dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if d.lower() not in SKIP and not (drive and d.lower() in SKIP_TOP)]
        for name in sorted(files):
            path = os.path.join(root, name)
            if "." in name or not os.path.isfile(path):
                continue
            try:
                if os.path.getsize(path) < 0xA000:
                    continue
            except OSError:
                continue
            if is_dlc(path):
                print(path)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

```

`tools/find_pointer_funcs.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""List code addresses that data points at but codegen did not make functions.

Indirect calls (vtables without RTTI, callback tables) to such addresses die at
runtime with "Call to invalid or unregistered function". This scans an image
dumped with NG2_DUMP_IMAGE for big-endian words outside the code range that
point into it, and keeps those that look like a function entry: not already a
function or a label inside one, and right after a terminator or padding.

usage: find_pointer_funcs.py <image.bin> <generated_dir> [--toml]
"""
import glob
import os
import re
import struct
import sys

IMAGE_BASE = 0x82000000
CODE_BASE = 0x822F0000
CODE_END = CODE_BASE + 0x1797D30  # Title Updates 2 and 3 (1.0: 0x1771D30)

BLR, BCTR = 0x4E800020, 0x4E800420
# mr r8,r8: the compiler brackets __try regions with these. SEH scope tables
# point at __except/__finally labels inside the parent, never at functions.
SEH_MARKER = 0x7D084378
# Primary opcodes whose rt field is a source (stores, branches, compares, traps).
STORE_OPS = {2, 3, 10, 11, 16, 17, 18, 19, 36, 37, 38, 39, 44, 45, 47, 52, 53, 54, 55, 62}
# Opcode 31 extended opcodes that store rt (stwx, stbx, sthx, stdx, ... ).
X_STORES = {149, 151, 150, 183, 215, 247, 407, 439, 662, 918, 181, 214, 0, 32, 4, 68}


def read_generated(gen_dir):
    funcs, labels = set(), set()
    fn = re.compile(r"DEFINE_REX_FUNC\((?:sub|rexcrt)_([0-9A-Fa-f]{8})\)")
    lab = re.compile(r"^loc_([0-9A-F]{8}):")
    for path in glob.glob(os.path.join(gen_dir, "*_recomp.*.cpp")):
        with open(path) as f:
            for line in f:
                m = fn.search(line)
                if m:
                    funcs.add(int(m.group(1), 16))
                    continue
                m = lab.match(line)
                if m:
                    labels.add(int(m.group(1), 16))
    # Registered names (named and rexcrt functions keep their address here).
    reg = os.path.join(gen_dir, "ng2_register.cpp")
    if os.path.exists(reg):
        with open(reg) as f:
            for m in re.finditer(r"SetFunction\(0x([0-9A-F]{8})", f.read()):
                funcs.add(int(m.group(1), 16))
    return funcs, labels


def word(img, addr):
    off = addr - IMAGE_BASE
    return struct.unpack_from(">I", img, off)[0]


def is_terminator(w):
    if w in (BLR, BCTR, 0):
        return True
    return (w >> 26) == 18 and (w & 1) == 0  # b / ba, not bl


def main():
    if len(sys.argv) < 3:
        raise SystemExit(__doc__)
    img = open(sys.argv[1], "rb").read()
    funcs, labels = read_generated(sys.argv[2])
    refs = {}
    # Addresses built in code: lis rX,hi then addi/ori rY,rX,lo.
    hi = {}
    for addr in range(CODE_BASE, CODE_END, 4):
        w = word(img, addr)
        op, rt, ra = w >> 26, (w >> 21) & 31, (w >> 16) & 31
        if op == 15 and ra == 0:  # lis rt,hi
            hi[rt] = (w & 0xFFFF) << 16
            continue
        # addi rt,ra,lo reads ra and writes rt; ori ra,rs,lo reads rs (rt field).
        src, dst = (ra, rt) if op == 14 else (rt, ra) if op == 24 else (None, None)
        if src is not None and src in hi:
            lo = w & 0xFFFF
            if op == 14 and lo & 0x8000:
                lo -= 0x10000
            v = (hi[src] + lo) & 0xFFFFFFFF
            if CODE_BASE <= v < CODE_END and not v & 3 and v not in funcs and v not in labels:
                refs.setdefault(v, []).append(addr)
        if w in (BLR, BCTR):
            hi.clear()
        elif dst is not None:
            hi.pop(dst, None)
        elif op not in STORE_OPS and op != 31:
            hi.pop(rt, None)  # D-form loads and arithmetic write rt
        elif op == 31 and ((w >> 1) & 0x3FF) not in X_STORES:
            hi.pop(rt, None)
    for off in range(0, len(img) - 3, 4):
        addr = IMAGE_BASE + off
        if CODE_BASE <= addr < CODE_END:
            continue
        v = struct.unpack_from(">I", img, off)[0]
        if not (CODE_BASE <= v < CODE_END) or v & 3:
            continue
        if v in funcs or v in labels:
            continue
        refs.setdefault(v, []).append(addr)
    found = []
    for t in sorted(refs):
        w = word(img, t)
        if w == 0 or not is_terminator(word(img, t - 4)):
            continue
        if CODE_BASE <= w < CODE_END:  # a jump table after its bctr
            continue
        if any(word(img, t - 4 * i) == SEH_MARKER for i in range(2, 8)):
            continue
        found.append(t)
    if "--toml" in sys.argv:
        for t in found:
            print(f"0x{t:08X} = {{}}  # from 0x{refs[t][0]:08X}")
    else:
        for t in found:
            print(f"{t:08X} refs={len(refs[t])} first=0x{refs[t][0]:08X} insn={word(img, t):08X}")
        print(f"{len(found)} candidates ({len(refs)} unmatched code pointers)", file=sys.stderr)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```
